sys_update_xml.payload: record_actiontrueVerarbeitet Antwort-E-Mails auf die Abnahme-Aufforderungen (Nicht-Portalkunden) für Bestellvorgänge. Die Aktion wird ausgelöst, wenn eine eingehende E-Mail im Betreff eine Order-Task-Nummer (OMTASK) in Verbindung mit dem Begriff „Abnahme" enthält. Sie wertet die erste Zeile des E-Mail-Inhalts aus: „Bestätigt" → setzt den Abnahme-Status auf „accepted". „Nicht bestätigt, weil [...]" → setzt den Abnahme-Status auf „rejected" und übernimmt die Begründung nach „weil" in das Feld für die Ablehnungsbegründung (u_rejection_reason). Die eigentliche Zustandsänderung und die weiteren Folgeprozesse (Statuswechsel, Benachrichtigungen) laufen über die bestehenden Business Rules und Notifications – diese Aktion setzt lediglich den Abnahme-Status und ggf. die Begründung.email.readsubjectLIKEOMTASK^subjectLIKEAbnahme^EQOrder Abnahme answer non portal customer100falsesysevent_in_email_actionIZEAC712026-09-21 10:22:52global/c3632c989cab4fd0b0e4a23b789883b63Order Abnahme answer non portal customer3c58f5d55b0310102dff5e92dc81c7113c58f5d55b0310102dff5e92dc81c711sysevent_in_email_action_c3632c989cab4fd0b0e4a23b789883b6IZEAC712026-09-21 13:01:52sn_ind_tmt_orm_order_task

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_ind_tmt_orm_order_task</collection><condition/><description>Legt auf dem Abnahme-Task fest, ob eine Teilabnahme vorliegt (mehr als eine Abnahmegruppe 1–5 unter den OLIs der Order).</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_ind_tmt_orm_order_task">u_task_type=Abnahmeprozess^EQ<item display_value="Abnahmeprozess" endquery="false" field="u_task_type" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value="Abnahmeprozess"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Order Task Set Teilabnahme Flag</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    var orderSysId = current.getValue('customer_order');
    if (gs.nil(orderSysId)) return;

    // Teil-Abnahme-Gruppen zählen
    var gr = new GlideRecord('sn_ind_tmt_orm_order_line_item');
    gr.addQuery('order', orderSysId);
    gr.query();
    var groups = {};
    var groupCount = 0;
    while (gr.next()) {
        var group = gr.getValue('u_som_acceptance_group');
        if (gs.nil(group) || group === '0') continue;
        if (!groups[group]) {
            groups[group] = true;
            groupCount++;
        }
    }
    var newVal = (groupCount > 1) ? 'true' : 'false';

    if (current.getValue('u_partial_acceptance') !== newVal) {
        current.setValue('u_partial_acceptance', newVal);
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-17 13:30:44</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>87c24d49f4fa43901f18b238e2e2386d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>10</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Order Task Set Teilabnahme Flag</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Order Management" source="sn_ind_tmt_orm">3c58f5d55b0310102dff5e92dc81c711</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Order Management">3c58f5d55b0310102dff5e92dc81c711</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_87c24d49f4fa43901f18b238e2e2386d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-22 13:12:56</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=87c24d49f4fa43901f18b238e2e2386d"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Category Picker">e0ed6b49e1ef87d41f189be3489f8dfb</macroponent><name>Set Category Picker Parameters</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function handler({
    api,
    event,
    imports
}) {
    const isEmpty = (value) => {
        return (
            value == null || (typeof value === 'object' && Object.keys(value).length === 0) || (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length === 0)
        );
    };

    var changes = JSON.parse(api.context.props.serializedChanges);
    var sysId = api.context.props.sysId;
    var value = api.context.props.value;
    var encodedRecord = api.context.props.encodedRecord;
    var hasValue = true;

    if (isEmpty(value)) {
        hasValue = false;
        value = '';
    }

    api.setState('hasValue', hasValue);
    api.setState('value', value);
    api.setState('sysId', '-1');

    if (changes.hasOwnProperty('kb_knowledge_base') && !isEmpty(changes.kb_knowledge_base)) {
        api.setState('parentId', changes.kb_knowledge_base);
    } else if (!isEmpty(sysId) && sysId.length == 32) {
        api.setState('sysId', sysId);
    } else if (!isEmpty(encodedRecord)) {
        api.setState('encodedRecord', encodedRecord);
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>1.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-24 08:45:19</sys_created_on><sys_id>e4edab49e1ef87d41f189be3489f8d47</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set Category Picker Parameters</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_e4edab49e1ef87d41f189be3489f8d47</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-24 08:45:19</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
async function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    const actionItems = event?.payload?.data?.GlideViewQuery_Query?.uiView?.glideLayoutItem?._query?.GlideUxActionLayout_Query?.getActionLayout?.actionLayoutItems;
    const length = actionItems.length;
    let shnActionItem = null;
    for(let i = 0;i < length;i++){
        const actionItem = actionItems[i];
        if(actionItem.name && actionItem.name.toLowerCase() === "special handling notes"){
            shnActionItem = actionItem;
            break;
        }
    }
    api.setState('shnActionSysId', shnActionItem?.sysId);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-24 08:45:10</sys_created_on><sys_id>26ddafc5f4e30f141f18b238e2e238ab</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>set shn actionSysId</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_26ddafc5f4e30f141f18b238e2e238ab</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-24 08:45:10</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Category Picker">e0ed6b49e1ef87d41f189be3489f8dfb</macroponent><name>Update Knowledge Categories</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function handler({
    api,
    event,
    imports
}) {
    const getStringPath = (path, tree) => {
        let actualPath = 'items';
        let tempTree = tree;

        for (let i = 0; i < path.length; i++) {
            let index = tempTree.findIndex(y => y.id == path[i]);
            tempTree = tempTree[index].children;
            if (index != -1)
                actualPath += `[${index}].children`;
        }

        return actualPath;
    };

    /**
     * Alternative method to lodash _.set()
     */
    const put = function(obj, path, val) {
        var stringToPath = function(path) {
            if (typeof path !== 'string') return path;
            var output = [];

            path.split('.').forEach(function(item, index) {
                item.split(/\[([^}]+)\]/g).forEach(function(key) {
                    if (key.length > 0) {
                        output.push(key);
                    }
                });
            });

            return output;
        };

        path = stringToPath(path);

        var length = path.length;
        var current = obj;

        path.forEach(function(key, index) {
            var isArray = key.slice(-2) === '[]';
            key = isArray ? key.slice(0, -2) : key;

            if (isArray && Object.prototype.toString.call(current[key]) !== '[object Array]') {
                current[key] = [];
            }

            if (index === length - 1) {
                if (isArray) {
                    current[key].push(val);
                } else {
                    current[key] = val;
                }
            } else {
                if (!current[key]) {
                    current[key] = {};
                }

                current = current[key];
            }
        });
    };

    /**
     * Alternative method to lodash _.has()
     */
    const has = function(object, property) {
        return object != null && object.hasOwnProperty(property);
    };

    const buildTree = (categories) => {
        var catTree = {};
        try {
            categories.forEach((x) => {
                if (has(catTree, x.id)) {
                    catTree[x.id].label = x.label;
                    catTree[x.id].id = x.id;
                    catTree[x.id].path.unshift(x.parentId);
                } else {
                    catTree[x.id] = {
                        id: x.id,
                        label: x.label,
                        children: [],
                        path: [x.parentId]
                    };
                    if (catTree[x.parentId] && catTree[x.parentId].path) {
                        catTree[x.id].path.unshift(...catTree[x.parentId].path);
                    }
                }

                if (has(catTree, x.parentId)) {
                    catTree[x.parentId].children.push(catTree[x.id]);
                } else {
                    catTree[x.parentId] = {
                        children: [catTree[x.id]]
                    };
                }
            });
            return catTree;
        } catch (e) {
            return {};
        }
    };

    const getExpandedPath = (path) => {
        let tempPath = [];
        path.forEach((element, i) => {
            if (i == 0)
                tempPath.push([element]);
            else
                tempPath.push([...tempPath[i - 1], element]);
        });
        return tempPath;
    };

    if (event.elementId == 'get_knowledge_categories_initial' || event.elementId == 'get_knowledge_categories_encoded_record') {
        if (event.name == 'DATA_FETCH_SUCCEEDED') {
            if (api.state.items.length <= 0) {
                let categories = null;

                if (api.data.get_knowledge_categories_initial.output.data) {
                    categories = api.data.get_knowledge_categories_initial.output.data.AppKnowledge_Query.first;
                } else {
                    categories = api.data.get_knowledge_categories_encoded_record.output.data.AppKnowledge_Query.first;
                }

                if (categories.length <= 0) {
                    api.setState('hideNoItemsMessage', false);
                }

                if (categories && categories.length > 0) {
                    api.setState('items', categories);

                    if (api.state.value) {
                        let flatCategories = null;

                        if (api.data.get_knowledge_categories_initial.output.data) {
                            flatCategories = api.data.get_knowledge_categories_initial.output.data.AppKnowledge_Query.second;
                        } else {
                            flatCategories = api.data.get_knowledge_categories_encoded_record.output.data.AppKnowledge_Query.second;
                        }

                        if (flatCategories && flatCategories.length > 0) {
                            let categoryTree = buildTree(flatCategories);

                            if (categoryTree[api.state.value]) {
                                let path = categoryTree[api.state.value].path;

                                if (path.length > 0) {
                                    path.shift();
                                    let index = categories.findIndex((y) => y.id == path[0]);

                                    if (index != -1) {
                                        categories[index].children = categoryTree[path[0]].children;
                                        api.setState('items', categories);
                                    }

                                    let expandedItems = getExpandedPath(path);
                                    path.push(api.state.value);

                                    if (expandedItems.length > 0) {
                                        api.setState('expandedItems', expandedItems);
                                    }

                                    api.setState('selectedItems', [path]);
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            let index = categories.findIndex(y => y.id == api.state.value);

                            if (index != -1) {
                                api.setState('selectedItems', [[api.state.value]]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (event.elementId == 'get_knowledge_categories_expand') {
        if (event.name == 'DATA_FETCH_SUCCEEDED') {
            var path = getStringPath(api.state.route, api.state.items);
            var items = {
                'items': api.state.items
            };

            put(items, path, api.data.get_knowledge_categories_expand.output.data.AppKnowledge_Query.first);

            api.setState('items', items.items);
            api.setState('loadingItems', []);
        }
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>1.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-24 08:45:19</sys_created_on><sys_id>e8edab49e1ef87d41f189be3489f8d21</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update Knowledge Categories</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_e8edab49e1ef87d41f189be3489f8d21</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-24 08:45:19</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="DELETE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="SOM Account Planning record 4">4eddafc5f4e30f141f18b238e2e2386f</macroponent><name>Shn Totalmsg count</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "No special handling notes available"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
async function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    if(api.data.get_special_handling_notes_1 && api.data.get_special_handling_notes_1.output){
        api.setState('Totalmsg', api.data.get_special_handling_notes_1.output.data.GlideSHN_Query.totalMsg);
    } 
    if(api.data.get_special_handling_notes_1.output.data.GlideSHN_Query.totalMsg == 0 && api.state.showSHNAlert){
        api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
                            items: [{
                                id: 'no_shn',
                                status: 'info',
                                icon: 'circle-exclamation-outline',
                                content: await helpers.translate('No special handling notes available'),
                                action: {
                                    type: 'dismiss'
                                }
                            }]
                        });
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-24 08:45:10</sys_created_on><sys_id>a6ddafc5f4e30f141f18b238e2e238c6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Shn Totalmsg count</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_a6ddafc5f4e30f141f18b238e2e238c6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-24 08:45:10</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

Rich text editor status doesnt matter\n\tif (!currentDisplayValue || currentDisplayValue.trim() === \"\") {\n\t\tupdatedDisplayValue = `[code]${articleTitle}: <a href=\"${fullUrl}\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" style=\"pointer-events: auto;\">${articleNumber}</a>[/code]`;\n\t} else {\n\t\tconst lastNbspIndex = currentDisplayValue.lastIndexOf(\"<p>&nbsp;</p>\");\n        // Case 2: Rich text editor is on, and we are adding the link in a new line\n        if (lastNbspIndex !== -1) {\n            updatedDisplayValue =\n                currentDisplayValue.slice(0, lastNbspIndex) +\n                `<p>${articleTitle}: <a href=\"${fullUrl}\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" style=\"pointer-events: auto;\">${articleNumber}</a>` +\n                currentDisplayValue.slice(lastNbspIndex + 13); \n        } else {\n            const lastClosingTagIndex = currentDisplayValue.lastIndexOf('</p>');\n            if (lastClosingTagIndex !== -1) {\n                // Case 3: Rich text editor is on, and are appending the link to a new line\n                updatedDisplayValue =\n                    currentDisplayValue.slice(0, lastClosingTagIndex) +\n                    `${articleTitle}: <a href=\"${fullUrl}\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" style=\"pointer-events: auto;\">${articleNumber}</a></p>` +\n                    currentDisplayValue.slice(lastClosingTagIndex + 4);\n            } else {\n                // Case 4: Rich text editor is off, and we are appending the link to the end\n                updatedDisplayValue = currentDisplayValue + ` ${articleTitle}: [code]<a href=\"${fullUrl}\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" style=\"pointer-events: auto;\">${articleNumber}</a>[/code]`;\n            }\n        }\n\t}\n\treturn {\n\t\tfieldName: \"comments\",\n\t\tvalue: updatedDisplayValue,\n\t\tdisplayValue: updatedDisplayValue\n\t};\n}",

	$scope.accessibilityModeEnabled = spAriaUtil.isAccessibilityEnabled();
}]]></client_script><controller_as/><css>.iconlink {
	padding: 3px 0;
}

.iconlink a label,h2 {
  display: block;
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  font-weight: 300;
  line-height: 1.1;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0 0 10px 0;
}

/* TOP ICON ---------- */

a.top_icon {
  display: block;
  padding: 20px;
  text-align: center;
}

a.top_icon .fa {
  display: block;
  text-align: center;
}

/* CIRCLE ICON ---------- */

a.circle_icon {
  display: block;
  padding: 20px 0px 20px 70px;
  position: relative;
}

a.circle_icon .fa {
  position:absolute;
  left: 0px;
  top: 10px;
}

/* COLOR BOX ---------- */

a.color_box {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  padding: 20px 20px 20px 82px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

a.color_box .fa {
  position:absolute;
  left: 20px;
  top: 20px;
  width:42px;
  text-align: center;
}

.icon-link-background-primary {
  background-color: $brand-primary;
}

.icon-link-background-info {
  background-color: $brand-info;
}

.icon-link-background-success {
  background-color: $brand-success;
}

.icon-link-background-warning {
  background-color: $brand-warning;
}

.icon-link-background-danger {
  background-color: $brand-danger;
}

.icon-link-background-default {
  background-color: $brand-primary;
}

.text-primary {
  color: $brand-primary;
  
  &amp;:hover {
    color: $brand-primary-dark;
  }
}

.text-info {
  color: $brand-info;
  
  &amp;:hover {
    color: darken($brand-info, 20%);
  }
}

.text-success {
  color: $brand-success;
  
  &amp;:hover {
    color: darken($brand-success, 20%);
  }
}

.text-warning {
  color: $brand-warning;
  
  &amp;:hover {
    color: darken($brand-warning, 20%);
  }
}

.text-danger {
  color: $brand-danger;
  
  &amp;:hover {
    color: darken($brand-danger, 20%);
  }
}

.text-default {
  color: $brand-primary;
  
  &amp;:hover {
    color: $brand-primary-dark;
  }
}

.text-muted {
  color: $text-secondary;
}

.high-contrast {
  .text-primary {
    color: darken($brand-primary, 10%);
  }

  .text-info {
    color: darken($brand-info, 10%);
  }

  .text-success {
    color: darken($brand-success, 10%);
  }

  .text-warning {
    color: darken($brand-warning, 10%);
  }

  .text-danger {
    color: darken($brand-danger, 10%);
  }

  .text-default {
    color: darken($brand-primary, 10%);
  }
}</css><data_table>sp_instance_link</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list>type,url,sc_category,sc_cat_item,kb_topic,kb_article,kb_category,sp_page,title,short_description,color,class_name,glyph</field_list><has_preview>false</has_preview><id/><internal>false</internal><link/><name>Icon Link</name><option_schema>[{"name":"link_template","section":"Presentation","label":"Template","type":"choice","choices":[{"label":"Top Icon","value":"Top Icon"},{"label":"Circle Icon","value":"Circle Icon"},{"label":"Color Box","value":"Color Box"}]}]</option_schema><public>true</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function(){

      <i class="fa fa-{{::options.glyph}} fa-stack-1x fa-inverse"></i>
    </span>
    <h2>{{::options.title}}</h2>
    <span class="text-muted">{{::options.short_description}}</span>
  </a>

  <!--// Color Box -->
  <a ng-if="::(options.link_template == 'Color Box')" ng-href="{{::data.href}}" class="color_box {{::options.class_name}} icon-link-background-{{::options.color}} text-white" target="{{::data.target}}">
    <div class="fa fa-{{::options.glyph}} fa-3x {{::options.class_name}}"></div>
    <h2>{{::options.title}}</h2>
    <span>{{::options.short_description}}</span>
  </a>
</div>]]></template></sp_widget></payload><sys_class_name>sp_rel_widget_clone</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE64</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-25 13:31:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>0ccf46ab10b2cf504699cdb60f0cc961</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>44cf46ab10b2cf504699cdb60f0cc95b</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_rel_widget_clone_0ccf46ab10b2cf504699cdb60f0cc961</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE64</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-25 13:31:45</sys_updated_on></sp_rel_widget_clone></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="SOM Account Planning record">a95e6ca1f4a74f141f18b238e2e2386a</macroponent><name>Shn Totalmsg count</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "No special handling notes available"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
async function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    if(api.data.get_special_handling_notes_1 && api.data.get_special_handling_notes_1.output){
        api.setState('Totalmsg', api.data.get_special_handling_notes_1.output.data.GlideSHN_Query.totalMsg);
    } 
    if(api.data.get_special_handling_notes_1.output.data.GlideSHN_Query.totalMsg == 0 && api.state.showSHNAlert){
        api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
                            items: [{
                                id: 'no_shn',
                                status: 'info',
                                icon: 'circle-exclamation-outline',
                                content: await helpers.translate('No special handling notes available'),
                                action: {
                                    type: 'dismiss'
                                }
                            }]
                        });
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-25 08:05:24</sys_created_on><sys_id>b95e6ca1f4a74f141f18b238e2e238cc</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Shn Totalmsg count</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CSM Workspace" source="sn_csm_workspace">8f8fa168735303001923054dfff6a799</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CSM Workspace">8f8fa168735303001923054dfff6a799</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_b95e6ca1f4a74f141f18b238e2e238cc</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-25 08:05:24</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
async function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    const actionItems = event?.payload?.data?.GlideViewQuery_Query?.uiView?.glideLayoutItem?._query?.GlideUxActionLayout_Query?.getActionLayout?.actionLayoutItems;
    const length = actionItems.length;
    let shnActionItem = null;
    for(let i = 0;i < length;i++){
        const actionItem = actionItems[i];
        if(actionItem.name && actionItem.name.toLowerCase() === "special handling notes"){
            shnActionItem = actionItem;
            break;
        }
    }
    api.setState('shnActionSysId', shnActionItem?.sysId);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-25 08:05:24</sys_created_on><sys_id>3d5e6ca1f4a74f141f18b238e2e238d9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>set shn actionSysId</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CSM Workspace" source="sn_csm_workspace">8f8fa168735303001923054dfff6a799</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CSM Workspace">8f8fa168735303001923054dfff6a799</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_3d5e6ca1f4a74f141f18b238e2e238d9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-25 08:05:24</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Category Picker">b25e6825e12f4fd41f189be3489f8d70</macroponent><name>Set Category Picker Parameters</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function handler({
    api,
    event,
    imports
}) {
    const isEmpty = (value) => {
        return (
            value == null || (typeof value === 'object' && Object.keys(value).length === 0) || (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length === 0)
        );
    };

    var changes = JSON.parse(api.context.props.serializedChanges);
    var sysId = api.context.props.sysId;
    var value = api.context.props.value;
    var encodedRecord = api.context.props.encodedRecord;
    var hasValue = true;

    if (isEmpty(value)) {
        hasValue = false;
        value = '';
    }

    api.setState('hasValue', hasValue);
    api.setState('value', value);
    api.setState('sysId', '-1');

    if (changes.hasOwnProperty('kb_knowledge_base') && !isEmpty(changes.kb_knowledge_base)) {
        api.setState('parentId', changes.kb_knowledge_base);
    } else if (!isEmpty(sysId) && sysId.length == 32) {
        api.setState('sysId', sysId);
    } else if (!isEmpty(encodedRecord)) {
        api.setState('encodedRecord', encodedRecord);
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>1.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-25 08:05:29</sys_created_on><sys_id>035e6825e12f4fd41f189be3489f8d86</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set Category Picker Parameters</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CSM Workspace" source="sn_csm_workspace">8f8fa168735303001923054dfff6a799</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CSM Workspace">8f8fa168735303001923054dfff6a799</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_035e6825e12f4fd41f189be3489f8d86</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-25 08:05:29</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Category Picker">b25e6825e12f4fd41f189be3489f8d70</macroponent><name>Update Knowledge Categories</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function handler({
    api,
    event,
    imports
}) {
    const getStringPath = (path, tree) => {
        let actualPath = 'items';
        let tempTree = tree;

        for (let i = 0; i < path.length; i++) {
            let index = tempTree.findIndex(y => y.id == path[i]);
            tempTree = tempTree[index].children;
            if (index != -1)
                actualPath += `[${index}].children`;
        }

        return actualPath;
    };

    /**
     * Alternative method to lodash _.set()
     */
    const put = function(obj, path, val) {
        var stringToPath = function(path) {
            if (typeof path !== 'string') return path;
            var output = [];

            path.split('.').forEach(function(item, index) {
                item.split(/\[([^}]+)\]/g).forEach(function(key) {
                    if (key.length > 0) {
                        output.push(key);
                    }
                });
            });

            return output;
        };

        path = stringToPath(path);

        var length = path.length;
        var current = obj;

        path.forEach(function(key, index) {
            var isArray = key.slice(-2) === '[]';
            key = isArray ? key.slice(0, -2) : key;

            if (isArray && Object.prototype.toString.call(current[key]) !== '[object Array]') {
                current[key] = [];
            }

            if (index === length - 1) {
                if (isArray) {
                    current[key].push(val);
                } else {
                    current[key] = val;
                }
            } else {
                if (!current[key]) {
                    current[key] = {};
                }

                current = current[key];
            }
        });
    };

    /**
     * Alternative method to lodash _.has()
     */
    const has = function(object, property) {
        return object != null && object.hasOwnProperty(property);
    };

    const buildTree = (categories) => {
        var catTree = {};
        try {
            categories.forEach((x) => {
                if (has(catTree, x.id)) {
                    catTree[x.id].label = x.label;
                    catTree[x.id].id = x.id;
                    catTree[x.id].path.unshift(x.parentId);
                } else {
                    catTree[x.id] = {
                        id: x.id,
                        label: x.label,
                        children: [],
                        path: [x.parentId]
                    };
                    if (catTree[x.parentId] && catTree[x.parentId].path) {
                        catTree[x.id].path.unshift(...catTree[x.parentId].path);
                    }
                }

                if (has(catTree, x.parentId)) {
                    catTree[x.parentId].children.push(catTree[x.id]);
                } else {
                    catTree[x.parentId] = {
                        children: [catTree[x.id]]
                    };
                }
            });
            return catTree;
        } catch (e) {
            return {};
        }
    };

    const getExpandedPath = (path) => {
        let tempPath = [];
        path.forEach((element, i) => {
            if (i == 0)
                tempPath.push([element]);
            else
                tempPath.push([...tempPath[i - 1], element]);
        });
        return tempPath;
    };

    if (event.elementId == 'get_knowledge_categories_initial' || event.elementId == 'get_knowledge_categories_encoded_record') {
        if (event.name == 'DATA_FETCH_SUCCEEDED') {
            if (api.state.items.length <= 0) {
                let categories = null;

                if (api.data.get_knowledge_categories_initial.output.data) {
                    categories = api.data.get_knowledge_categories_initial.output.data.AppKnowledge_Query.first;
                } else {
                    categories = api.data.get_knowledge_categories_encoded_record.output.data.AppKnowledge_Query.first;
                }

                if (categories.length <= 0) {
                    api.setState('hideNoItemsMessage', false);
                }

                if (categories && categories.length > 0) {
                    api.setState('items', categories);

                    if (api.state.value) {
                        let flatCategories = null;

                        if (api.data.get_knowledge_categories_initial.output.data) {
                            flatCategories = api.data.get_knowledge_categories_initial.output.data.AppKnowledge_Query.second;
                        } else {
                            flatCategories = api.data.get_knowledge_categories_encoded_record.output.data.AppKnowledge_Query.second;
                        }

                        if (flatCategories && flatCategories.length > 0) {
                            let categoryTree = buildTree(flatCategories);

                            if (categoryTree[api.state.value]) {
                                let path = categoryTree[api.state.value].path;

                                if (path.length > 0) {
                                    path.shift();
                                    let index = categories.findIndex((y) => y.id == path[0]);

                                    if (index != -1) {
                                        categories[index].children = categoryTree[path[0]].children;
                                        api.setState('items', categories);
                                    }

                                    let expandedItems = getExpandedPath(path);
                                    path.push(api.state.value);

                                    if (expandedItems.length > 0) {
                                        api.setState('expandedItems', expandedItems);
                                    }

                                    api.setState('selectedItems', [path]);
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            let index = categories.findIndex(y => y.id == api.state.value);

                            if (index != -1) {
                                api.setState('selectedItems', [[api.state.value]]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (event.elementId == 'get_knowledge_categories_expand') {
        if (event.name == 'DATA_FETCH_SUCCEEDED') {
            var path = getStringPath(api.state.route, api.state.items);
            var items = {
                'items': api.state.items
            };

            put(items, path, api.data.get_knowledge_categories_expand.output.data.AppKnowledge_Query.first);

            api.setState('items', items.items);
            api.setState('loadingItems', []);
        }
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>1.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-25 08:05:29</sys_created_on><sys_id>035e6825e12f4fd41f189be3489f8d80</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update Knowledge Categories</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CSM Workspace" source="sn_csm_workspace">8f8fa168735303001923054dfff6a799</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CSM Workspace">8f8fa168735303001923054dfff6a799</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_035e6825e12f4fd41f189be3489f8d80</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-25 08:05:29</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">50c1bc9791170314b96b4a673452a0e9</macroponent><name>alert_1/isHidden</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const configInstance = api.state.configInstance;
    if (Object.keys(configInstance).length > 0) {
        let ruleEngineError = configInstance.rule_engine_error;
        if (ruleEngineError && ruleEngineError != "") return true;
        let data = configInstance.product.attributes.cumulativeMessageCount;
        return data === 1 ? false : true;
    }
    return true;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:34:02</sys_created_on><sys_id>09c1b0d791170314b96b4a673452a0c7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>alert_1/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_09c1b0d791170314b96b4a673452a0c7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:34:02</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-catalog default">39b1749791170314b96b4a673452a065</macroponent><name>Update Catalog Hierarchy</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    if (event.payload.item.id == api.state.selectedCatalog)
        return;
    const selectedCatalog = event.payload.item.id;
    const selectedCatalogLabel = event.payload.item.label;
    if (selectedCatalog == "allCatalog") {
        var categoryList = [];
        var defaultList = api.state.catalogList[0].children;
        var alphaList = api.state.catalogList[1].children;
        for (let item of defaultList) {
            if (item.id == "allCatalog")
                continue;
            categoryList.push({
                id: item.id,
                label: item.label
            });
        }
        for (let item of alphaList) {
            categoryList.push({
                id: item.id,
                label: item.label
            });
        }
        categoryList.sort((a, b) => a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
        api.setState("selectedCatalogHierarchy", categoryList);
    } else
        api.setState('selectedCatalogHierarchy', null);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    api.setState("productSelectionSelected", [
        []
    ]);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState("resultsFound", true);
    api.setState("leafCategoryList", null);
    api.setState('pageIndex', 0);
    api.setState('selectedCatalog', selectedCatalog);
    api.setState('selectedCatalogLabel', selectedCatalogLabel);
    api.setState('selectedCategory', "showAll");
    api.setState('categorySelected', [
        ["showAll"]
    ]);
    api.setState("showSearch", true);
    let cdbInput = {
        selectedCatalog: selectedCatalog,
        selectedCategory: "showAll",
        pageIndex: 0,
        count: 0,
        searchTerm: api.state.searchTerm,
        transactionInput: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionInput,
        suppressPricing: api.state.requestEntityDetails.suppressPricing,
        catalogType: "PRODUCT_OFFERING",
        inputEntityDetails: api.state.requestEntityDetails.inputEntityDetails,
        contextFilterChanges: api.state.contextFilterChanges,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy
    };
    let requestEntityDetails = api.state.requestEntityDetails;
    requestEntityDetails.catalogType = "PRODUCT_OFFERING";
    api.setState("requestEntityDetails", requestEntityDetails);
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:49</sys_created_on><sys_id>02b1b49791170314b96b4a673452a006</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update Catalog Hierarchy</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_02b1b49791170314b96b4a673452a006</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:49</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    let data = api.data.transactioncatalogdatabroker.output;
    api.setState('requestEntityDetails', data);
    if (api.context.props.entityDetails.recommendation) {
        api.setState('showSearch', false);
        return;
    }
    api.setState('showSearch', true);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState('selectedCategory', 'showAll');
    api.setState('categorySelected', [["showAll"]]);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    api.setState('enableAISearchInCatalog', data.enableAISearchInCatalog);
    api.setState('catalogType', data.catalogType);
    api.setState('isTransactionManagerActive', data.isTransactionManagerActive);
    if(data.sortOptionsList){
        api.setState('sortOptionsList', data.sortOptionsList);
    }
    let cdbInput = {
        count: 0,
        pageIndex: 0,
        searchTerm: api.state.searchTerm,
        selectedCategory: "showAll",
        selectedCatalog: null,
        contextFilterChanges: api.state.contextFilterChanges,
        transactionInput: data.transactionInput,
        transactionType: data.transactionType,
        account: data.account,
        catalogType: data.catalogType,
        suppressPricing: data.suppressPricing,
        inputEntityDetails: data.inputEntityDetails,
        clearCatalogCache: true,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy,
        enableAdvanceConfiguration: data.enableAdvanceConfiguration
    };
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>42b1b49791170314b96b4a673452a0bc</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set fresh catalog data</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_42b1b49791170314b96b4a673452a0bc</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

            ON_CHAR_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED,
            OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED
        }
    } = constantsUtilInclude();
    let outputValue = {};
    let value = {
        configInstance: null,
        currentSelectionInstance: null,
        currentAppState: null,
        productHierarchy: null
    };
   
    const currentPayload = payload.payload;
    const additionalPayload = payload.additionalPayload;
    if(!payload.eventName)
        payload.eventName = name;        
    switch (payload.eventName) {
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CONFIG_LOADED':
            var configInstance = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            if (Object.keys(configInstance).length > 0) resetConfigInstance(api);
            else {
                value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
                value[CONFIG_SETTINGS] = currentPayload.configSettings;
                value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = createCurrentSelection(api, value);
                value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE]['parentQuantity'] = currentPayload.configInstance.product.attributes.quantity.value;
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = {
                    selectedProductDetails: {
                        selectedProductId: currentPayload.configInstance.product.id,
                        selectedProductPath: currentPayload.configInstance.product.path
                    },
                    appState: INITIAL_CONFIG_DATA_LOADED,
                    errorState: {}
                };
                const defaultSelectedProduct = [];
                defaultSelectedProduct.push(currentPayload.configInstance.product.id);
                value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = {
                    hierarchy: currentPayload.productHierarchy,
                    selectedItems: [defaultSelectedProduct],
                    expandedItems: [defaultSelectedProduct]
                };
                configLoaded(api, value);
            }
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails = {
                selectedProductId: currentPayload.id,
                selectedProductPath: currentPayload.path,
                isCharacteristicNode: currentPayload.is_char,
                isCharacteristicGroup: currentPayload.is_char_group
            };
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_MODIFIED;
            await productHierarchyModified(api, helpers, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION#SUMMARY_ACTION_INITIATED':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = payload.eventName;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = payload.payload.currentSelectionInstance;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            await userActionProductSelection(api, value, {
                payload: currentPayload,
                modifiedValue: additionalPayload
            }, helpers);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CHAR_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : userActionCharSelection,
                value : value,
                payload : {
                    currentPayload: currentPayload,
                    additionalPayload: additionalPayload
                    }});
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRICING_INITIATED':
            value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentPayload));
            value[PRICING_INSTANCE] = [prepareConfigInstanceForPricing(api, value)];
            initiatePricingCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRICING_SUCEEDED':
            value[PRICING_RESPONSE] = currentPayload.output;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_LOAD_PRICING_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == HIERARCHY_PRICING_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = HIERARCHY_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED) {
                await createAttributeAdjustments(api, value, helpers);
            } else {
                if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState != ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED)
                    value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHANGE_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
                await updateAttributeAdjustments(api, value, helpers);
            }
            updatePricesInCurrentSelection(api, value);
            receivePricingResponse(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_INITIATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = currentPayload.currentAppState;
            value[MODIFIED_NODES] = currentPayload.modifiedNodes;
            value[COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED] = currentPayload[COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED];
            initiateConfigRulesStateCall(api, value, additionalPayload);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            let prodHrchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            let selectedObjChar = api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] ? api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] : api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC];
            const selectedNodeId = prodHrchy.selectedItems[0][prodHrchy.selectedItems[0].length - 1];
            const targetNode = getTargetNodeRecursive(selectedNodeId, prodHrchy.hierarchy[0], [], true);
            const skipPricing = (selectedObjChar && selectedObjChar.path == targetNode.path) 
                || value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ARRAY_CHAR_INSTANCE_CHANGED;
            if(!skipPricing)
                debounceCurrentAppState({api: api, value: value, helpers: helpers, timeout: 0, appState: ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED});
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED;
            await receiveOpenStateResponse(api, value, currentPayload.output, skipPricing, helpers);
            if(selectedObjChar && selectedObjChar.path == targetNode.path) {
                value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                    selectedProductPath: selectedObjChar.path
                };
                setSelectedObjectCharNode(api, value);
            }
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#VALIDATION_SUCEEDED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.output;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            if(value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_CHAR_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHAR_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED;
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED;
            if(!api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                value[SKIP_PRICING] = false;
            else value[SKIP_PRICING] = true;
            receiveValidationResponse(api,value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CURRENCY_FORMAT_REQUESTED':
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.currentSelectionInstance;
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
            initiateCurrencyCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CURRENCY_FORMAT_REQUEST_SUCEEDED':
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.output;
            recieveCurrencyCallResponse(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PARENT_QUANTITY_UPDATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : parentQuantityUpdated,
                value : value,
                payload : currentPayload });
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_QUANTITY_UPDATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : await userActionProductQuantityChange,
                value : value,
                payload : {
                    quantity: currentPayload,
                    productPath: additionalPayload.productPath,
                    productInstanceQtyUpdate: additionalPayload.productInstanceQtyUpdate
                }});
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#HIDE_ERROR_CONTAINER':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            hideErrorContainer(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#SUMMARY_ACTION_DISPATCH':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.action = payload.payload.action;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.selectedProductPath = payload.payload.sourcePath;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.numberOfInstances = payload.payload.numberOfInstance;
            await summaryActionClicked(api, helpers, value);
            let content;
            if (payload.payload.action == 'cloneInitiated') {
                const numberOfClones = payload.payload.numberOfInstance;
                if (String(numberOfClones) === '1') {
                    content = await helpers.translate('{0} clone created', numberOfClones);
                } else {
                    content = await helpers.translate('{0} clones created', numberOfClones);
                }
            } else if (payload.payload.action == 'splitInitiated') {
                content = await helpers.translate('Configuration split');
            } else {
                content = await helpers.translate('Configuration deleted');
            }
            api.emit("NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS", {
                items: [{
                    id: "summaryInfo",
                    status: "positive",
                    icon: "info-circle-outline",
                    content: content,
                    action: {
                        type: "dismiss",
                    }
                }]
            });
            helpers.timing.setTimeout(()=> {
            api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#CLEAR_NOTIFICATIONS');
        }, 3000);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED;
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED;
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRICING_INSTANCE] = prepareConfigInstanceForOpenStatePricing(currentPayload, value);
            initiatePricingCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OBJECT_CHAR_VALUE_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                modifiedChar: payload.modifiedChar,
                selectedCharOption: payload.selectedCharOption
            };
            updateObjectCharValueInConfigInstance(api, value);
            break;
        case "OBJECT_CHARACTERISTIC_EDIT_BTN_CLICKED":
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                selectedObjectChar: payload.objectChar,
                parentChar: payload.parentChar
            };
            navigateToSelectedObjectChar(api, value);
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                selectedProductPath: payload.objectChar.path
            };
            setSelectedObjectCharNode(api, value);
            break;
        case "CONTENT_TREE_SELECTED_ITEMS_SET":
            let prodHierarchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            prodHierarchy.selectedItems = payload.nodes;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = prodHierarchy;
            setState(api, value);
            break;
        case "CONTENT_TREE_EXPANDED_ITEMS_SET":
            let prdHierarchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            prdHierarchy.expandedItems = payload.nodes;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = prdHierarchy;
            setState(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_ADD_MORE_INITIATED":
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: payload.parentChar
            };
            getNewInstanceComplexCharDb(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_ADD_MORE":
            let selectedChar;
            if(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedChar = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            else if(!api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedChar = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            let configInst = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            let hierarchy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY]));
            value[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] = selectedChar;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = configInst;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = hierarchy;
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: currentPayload.output.parentChar,
                newInstanceData: currentPayload.output.data
            };
            addOrRemoveInstances(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_DELETE_CLICKED":
            let selectedCharc;
            if(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedCharc = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            else if(!api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedCharc = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            let configInst2 = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            let hierarchy2 = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY]));
            value[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] = selectedCharc;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = configInst2;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = hierarchy2;
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: payload.parentChar,
                charToRemove: payload.charToRemove
            };
            addOrRemoveInstances(api, value);
    }

}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:34:04</sys_created_on><sys_id>5dc174d791170314b96b4a673452a036</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Config Reducer</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_5dc174d791170314b96b4a673452a036</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:34:04</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        if (api.state.configSettings['readonly']) return true;
        var isMandatory = +api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory.value;
        var hasValue = (api.item.value.characteristic_value ? api.item.value.characteristic_value.value : "") != "";
        if (isMandatory && !hasValue) return false;
        else return !api.item.value.attributes.is_editable;
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:34:01</sys_created_on><sys_id>6cc130d791170314b96b4a673452a0a7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>char_single_line_text/readonly</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_6cc130d791170314b96b4a673452a0a7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:34:01</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const currentAppState = api.state.currentAppState;
    const configInstance = api.state.configInstance;
    const path = currentAppState.selectedProductDetails ? currentAppState.selectedProductDetails.selectedProductPath : 'product';

    const getByDotPath = (path = "", object = {}) => {
        return path
            .split(".")
            .reduce((iteratee = {}, p) => iteratee[p], object);
    };

    let currentProductData = [];
    currentProductData.push(getByDotPath(path, configInstance));

    return currentProductData;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>a3b1f89791170314b96b4a673452a0f7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>product_data_repeater/repeatWith</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_a3b1f89791170314b96b4a673452a0f7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:56</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

    helpers
}) {
    const obj = api.item.value;
    const errorMessage = obj.attributes.error_message;
    if (errorMessage && errorMessage.content) {
        let data = [{
            "icon": "circle-info-outline",
            "content": obj.attributes.error_message.content
        }];
        return data;
    }
    const infoMessage = obj.attributes.message;
    if (infoMessage && infoMessage.content) {
        let data = [{
            "icon": "circle-info-outline",
            "content": obj.attributes.message.content
        }];
        return data;
    }
    return [];
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>b0b1b09791170314b96b4a673452a072</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>integer_char_input/messages</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_b0b1b09791170314b96b4a673452a072</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:45</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

  * @param {params} params
  * @param {api} params.api
  * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
  */
function evaluateProperty({api, helpers}) {
	  var prodChecked = Boolean(api.item.attributes.product.checked);
    if(!prodChecked) return true;
    var minQty = Number(api.item.value.attributes.min_quantity.value);
    var maxQty = Number(api.item.value.attributes.max_quantity.value);
    var qtyValue = Number(api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.value);
    var errorCondition = qtyValue < minQty || qtyValue > maxQty;
    let data = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.message;
    let dataContent = data && data.content;
   return !(errorCondition || dataContent);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:34:02</sys_created_on><sys_id>49c1f0d791170314b96b4a673452a0a7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>stylized_text_13/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_49c1f0d791170314b96b4a673452a0a7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:34:02</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

    if (api.context.props.showContextFilter) {

            parentSysId: api.context.props.entityDetails.headerId,
            view: "Catalog_filter",
            sysId: -1
        };
        api.setState('inputContextFilter', inputContextFilter);
        api.data.get_line_entity_metadata_detail.execute({
            headerEntityDetails: inputContextFilter
        });
    }
    api.setState('entityDetails', api.context.props.entityDetails);
    api.setState('itemQuantitySelected', {});

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-catalog default">39b1749791170314b96b4a673452a065</macroponent><name>Pagination invoked</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    if (event.payload.value == api.state.pageIndex)
        return;
    api.setState('pageIndex', event.payload.value);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    let cdbInput = {
        count: api.state.totalCount,
        selectedLocation: api.state.selectedLocation ? api.state.selectedLocation[0] : "",
        searchTerm: api.state.searchTerm,
        pageIndex: event.payload.value,
        transactionInput: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionInput,
        catalogType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType,
        suppressPricing: api.state.requestEntityDetails.suppressPricing,
        recommendation: api.state.recommendation,
        selectedCatalog: api.state.selectedCatalog,
        selectedCategory: api.state.selectedCategory,
        selectedCatalogHierarchy: api.state.selectedCatalogHierarchy,
        leafCategoryList: api.state.leafCategoryList,
        transactionType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionType,
        account: api.state.requestEntityDetails.account,
        inputEntityDetails: api.state.requestEntityDetails.inputEntityDetails,
        contextFilterChanges: api.state.contextFilterChanges,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy

    };
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>82b1b49791170314b96b4a673452a08b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Pagination invoked</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_82b1b49791170314b96b4a673452a08b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-catalog default">39b1749791170314b96b4a673452a065</macroponent><name>Set Catalog Data</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function script({
    api,
    event,
    helpers
}) {
    let data = event.payload.data.output;
    if (data) {
        if (data.selectedCatalog) {
            api.setState('selectedCatalog', data.selectedCatalog);
        }
        if (data.catalogList) {
            api.setState('catalogList', data.catalogList);
        }
        if (data.catalogList && data.catalogList.length > 0) {
            api.setState('selectedCatalogLabel', data.catalogList[0].children[0].label);
        }
        if (data.leafCategoryList) {
            api.setState('leafCategoryList', data.leafCategoryList);
        }
        if (data['spellCorrectedTerm'])
            api.setState('spellCorrectedTerm', data.spellCorrectedTerm);
        else
            api.setState('spellCorrectedTerm', '');
        let hierarchy = data.selectedAllCatalogHierarchy ? data.selectedAllCatalogHierarchy : data.selectedCatalogHierarchy;
        if (hierarchy && hierarchy.length > 0) {
            api.setState('selectedCatalogHierarchy', hierarchy);
        }

        let suggestionId = api.state.aiSearchSuggestionId;
        if (suggestionId !== "") {
            if (data.count == 1)
                api.setState('searchTerm', data.response[0].name.displayValue);
            if (data.count == 0)
                api.setState('searchTerm', data.suggestedRecordDisplayName);
        }
    }
    let obj = Object.assign({}, api.state.itemQuantitySelected || {});
    data.response.forEach(function(arrayItem) {
        var sysId = arrayItem.productOfferingSysId.value;
        arrayItem.invalid = {
            value: false
        };
        var existing = parseInt(obj[sysId]);
        obj[sysId] = (existing > 0) ? existing : 1;
    });
    api.setState('catalogData', data.response);
    if(data.filterCount == 0)
        api.setState('totalCount', data.count);
    api.setState('itemQuantitySelected', obj);
    if (data.count == 0) {
        api.setState("resultsFound", false);
        api.setState("loadingItems", false);
        if(!api.state.searchTerm)
            api.setState("showSearch", false);
    } else {
        api.setState("resultsFound", true);
        api.setState("loadingItems", false);
        api.setState("showSearch", true);
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>86b1b49791170314b96b4a673452a074</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set Catalog Data</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_86b1b49791170314b96b4a673452a074</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
