<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-catalog default">39b1749791170314b96b4a673452a065</macroponent><name>On context filter value change</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    const formFields = api.data.record.form.fields;
    let contextValues = {};
    for(const key in formFields) {
        if(formFields[key].value)
            contextValues[key] = {
                field: key,
                value: formFields[key].value
            };
    }
    let contextFilterChanges = {};
    contextFilterChanges["contextFields"] = contextValues;
    contextFilterChanges["entity"] = api.state.lineContext.table;
    api.setState("contextFilterChanges", contextFilterChanges);
    const data = api.state.requestEntityDetails;
    if (api.context.props.entityDetails.recommendation) {
        api.setState('showSearch', false);
        return;
    }
    api.setState('showSearch', true);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState('selectedCategory', 'showAll');
    api.setState('categorySelected', [
        ["showAll"]
    ]);
    api.setState('selectedCatalogHierarchy', null);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    let cdbInput = {
        count: 0,
        pageIndex: 0,
        searchTerm: api.state.searchTerm,
        selectedCategory: "showAll",
        selectedCatalog: null,
        transactionInput: data.transactionInput,
        transactionType: data.transactionType,
        account: data.account,
        catalogType: data.catalogType,
        suppressPricing: data.suppressPricing,
        inputEntityDetails: data.inputEntityDetails,
        selectedCatalogHierarchy: null,
        contextFilterChanges: contextFilterChanges,
        clearCatalogCache: true,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy
    };
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">84b1fc5791170314b96b4a673452a052</macroponent><name>related_product_checkbox/readonly</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        var selectedRelationshipGroup = api.item.parent.value;
        var currentRelatedProducts = selectedRelationshipGroup.related_product;
        let checkedCount = 0;
        if (api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory.value == "1" || !selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.is_editable) {
            return true;
        };
        for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
            if (currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked) checkedCount++;
            currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = false;
        }
        if (checkedCount >= +selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.max.value) {
            for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
                if (!currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked)
                    currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = true;
            }
        }else if (checkedCount <= +selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.min.value ) {
            for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
                if (currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked)
                    currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = true;
            }
        }
        if (api.item.value.attributes.is_disabled)
            return true;
        return !api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.is_editable;
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>7cb1709791170314b96b4a673452a0ba</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>related_product_checkbox/readonly</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_7cb1709791170314b96b4a673452a0ba</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:45</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">eab1389791170314b96b4a673452a076</macroponent><name>ConfigureProduct</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    let configInstance = api.state.configInstance;
    let tempConfigInstance = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(configInstance));
    let refreshId = parseInt(Math.ceil(Math.random() * Date.now()).toPrecision(16).toString().replace(".", ""));
    let escalationRefreshQueue = api.state.escalationRefreshQueue;
    escalationRefreshQueue.push(refreshId);
    api.setState('escalationRefreshQueue', escalationRefreshQueue);
    helpers.timing.setTimeout(() => {
        if (api.state.escalationRefreshQueue.length === 1) // Process only last request in queue
            api.emit('SN_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION#SEND_CONFIG_INSTANCE', {
                configInstance: tempConfigInstance
            });
        const index = escalationRefreshQueue.indexOf(refreshId);
        if (index > -1)
            escalationRefreshQueue.splice(index, 1); // Remove from queue
        api.setState('escalationRefreshQueue', escalationRefreshQueue);
    }, 1000);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:55</sys_created_on><sys_id>dbb1b89791170314b96b4a673452a068</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ConfigureProduct</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_dbb1b89791170314b96b4a673452a068</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:55</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        let msg;
        if (api.item.value.attributes.message) {
            const min = api.item.value.attributes.min.value;
            if (api.context.props.entityDetails['settings'] && api.context.props.entityDetails.settings['selectAllProductOptions'])
                msg = helpers.translateSync('Select a minimum of {0} options', [min]);

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Order record page">b5a1fc13f45747141f18b238e2e238d6</macroponent><name>Open secondary page</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "Order orchestration"
    },
    {
        "message": "Order timeline"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
async function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    var route;
    var fields;
    var title;
    if (event.elementId === 'order_orchestration'){
        route = 'order-orchestration';
        fields = {
            sysId: api.context.props.sysId,
            tableName: api.context.props.table
        };
        title = await helpers.translate("Order orchestration");

    } else if (event.elementId === 'order_timeline'){
        route = 'timeline';
        fields = {
            recordId: api.context.props.sysId
        };
        title = await helpers.translate("Order timeline");
    }
    const customPayload = {
        'route': route,
        'targetRoute': 'current',
        'fields': fields,
        'title': title
    };
    api.emit('NAV_ITEM_SELECTED', customPayload);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>c6a1b453f45747141f18b238e2e23857</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Open secondary page</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_c6a1b453f45747141f18b238e2e23857</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:34</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Review screen default">23a17c5791170314b96b4a673452a0b7</macroponent><name>Handle DSR inventory</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    var action = api.data.order_review.orderAction;
    var selectedAction = event.payload.item.id;
    if (action == selectedAction || action.indexOf(selectedAction) > -1 || action == 'change' || action.indexOf('change') > -1) {
        api.emit('MACROPONENT_VIEWPORT_LOAD_REQUESTED', {
            viewportElementId: "viewport_1",
            route: "suspend-resume-disconnect-interceptor",
            fields: {
                "prdInvtId": api.context.props.sysId,
                "orderId": api.context.props.orderId,
                "action": event.payload.item.id,
                "invtState": api.data.order_review.invtState,
                "invtNumber": api.data.order_review.invtNumber,
                "invtName": api.data.order_review.invtName
            },
        });

        helpers.modal.open('modal_viewport_interceptor', {
            size: 'md',
            bare: true
        });
    } else {
        var message = `Can't create new line items when the order action is set at Disconnect, Resume, or Suspend.`;
        api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
            items: [{
                id: 'info',
                status: 'info',
                icon: 'circle-info-outline',
                content: message,
                action: {
                    type: 'dismiss'
                }
            }]
        });
        helpers.timing.setTimeout(() => {
            api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#CLEAR_NOTIFICATIONS');
        }, 3000);
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>ffa1bc5791170314b96b4a673452a006</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Handle DSR inventory</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_ffa1bc5791170314b96b4a673452a006</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:40</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">50c1bc9791170314b96b4a673452a0e9</macroponent><name>container_57/isHidden</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        if (api.item.value.attributes.input_type.value == 'checkbox') {
            let options = api.item.value.characteristic_options;
            for (let i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
                if (options[i].label == 'True' && options[i].checked) return false;
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:34:01</sys_created_on><sys_id>b8c170d791170314b96b4a673452a070</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>container_57/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_b8c170d791170314b96b4a673452a070</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:34:01</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-catalog default">39b1749791170314b96b4a673452a065</macroponent><name>Update quantity</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    let obj = Object.assign({}, api.state.itemQuantitySelected);
    let catalogData = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state.catalogData));
    const itemIndex = event.context.item.index;
    const inputQty = event.payload.fieldValue;
    const offeringSysId = event.payload.name;
    let parsedQty = parseInt(inputQty);
    if (isNaN(parsedQty) || parsedQty < 1) {
        obj[offeringSysId] = inputQty;
        catalogData[itemIndex].invalid.value = true;
    } else if (!isInputValid(inputQty)) {
        obj[offeringSysId] = inputQty;
        catalogData[itemIndex].invalid.value = true;
    } else {
        obj[offeringSysId] = parsedQty;
        catalogData[itemIndex].invalid.value = false;
    }
    api.setState('itemQuantitySelected', obj);
    api.setState("catalogData", catalogData);

    function isInputValid(inputQty) {
        const pattern = /^\+{0,1}[0]{0,1}[1-9]{1}[0-9]{0,}$/g;
        return pattern.test(inputQty);
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>ceb1b49791170314b96b4a673452a0c2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update quantity</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_ceb1b49791170314b96b4a673452a0c2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">84b1fc5791170314b96b4a673452a052</macroponent><name>decimal_char_input/messages</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const obj = api.item.value;
    const errorMessage = obj.attributes.error_message;
    if (errorMessage && errorMessage.content) {
        let data = [{
            "icon": "circle-info-outline",
            "content": obj.attributes.error_message.content
        }];
        return data;
    }
    const infoMessage = obj.attributes.message;
    if (infoMessage && infoMessage.content) {
        let data = [{
            "icon": "circle-info-outline",
            "content": obj.attributes.message.content
        }];
        return data;

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const product = api.item.value.attributes.product;
    if (product.instances) {
        return product.checked ? product.totalQuantity : 0;
    }
    let qty = product.attributes.selectedQuantity;
    const isChecked = product.checked;
    if (!qty) {
        const productQty = product.attributes.quantity.value || 1;
        product.attributes.selectedQuantity = {
            value: isChecked ? productQty : 0
        };
        qty = product.attributes.selectedQuantity;
    }
    return isChecked ? qty.value : 0;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:34:03</sys_created_on><sys_id>59c134d791170314b96b4a673452a033</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>input_50/value</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_59c134d791170314b96b4a673452a033</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:34:03</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">84b1fc5791170314b96b4a673452a052</macroponent><name>ConfigureProduct</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    let configInstance = api.state.configInstance;
    let tempConfigInstance = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(configInstance));
    let refreshId = parseInt(Math.ceil(Math.random() * Date.now()).toPrecision(16).toString().replace(".", ""));
    let escalationRefreshQueue = api.state.escalationRefreshQueue;
    escalationRefreshQueue.push(refreshId);
    api.setState('escalationRefreshQueue', escalationRefreshQueue);
    helpers.timing.setTimeout(() => {
        if (api.state.escalationRefreshQueue.length === 1) // Process only last request in queue
            api.emit('SN_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION#SEND_CONFIG_INSTANCE', {
                configInstance: tempConfigInstance
            });
        const index = escalationRefreshQueue.indexOf(refreshId);
        if (index > -1)
            escalationRefreshQueue.splice(index, 1); // Remove from queue
        api.setState('escalationRefreshQueue', escalationRefreshQueue);
    }, 1000);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>78b1709791170314b96b4a673452a076</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ConfigureProduct</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_78b1709791170314b96b4a673452a076</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:44</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-catalog default">39b1749791170314b96b4a673452a065</macroponent><name>Set selected location</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    const locationId = event.payload.value[0];
    const selectedLoc = api.state.selectedLocation[0];
    if (selectedLoc == locationId)
        return;
    api.setState("selectedLocation", [locationId]);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState("resultsFound", true);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    let cdbInput = {
        count: 0,
        selectedLocation: locationId,
        searchTerm: api.state.searchTerm,
        pageIndex: 0,
        transactionInput: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionInput,
        transactionType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionType,
        account: api.state.requestEntityDetails.account,
        catalogType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy
    };
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>8eb1b49791170314b96b4a673452a0ea</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set selected location</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_8eb1b49791170314b96b4a673452a0ea</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (!api.state.hideQuantity) {
        return {
            "label": api.item.value.label + ' ' + 'x' + api.item.value.quantity,
            "variant": "primary",
            "size": "sm"
        };
    } else {
        return {
            "label": api.item.value.label,
            "variant": "primary",
            "size": "sm"
        };
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:54</sys_created_on><sys_id>4bb1789791170314b96b4a673452a01e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>accordion_item_2/header</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_4bb1789791170314b96b4a673452a01e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:54</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-catalog default">39b1749791170314b96b4a673452a065</macroponent><name>Search for data</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    var searchTerm = '';
    if (event.payload.actionPayload) {
        var aiSearchSuggestionId = event.payload.actionPayload.sysId;
        api.setState('aiSearchSuggestionId', aiSearchSuggestionId);
    } else {
        searchTerm = event.payload.fieldValue || event.payload.searchTerm || '';
        api.setState('aiSearchSuggestionId', '');
    }
    api.setState('pageIndex', 0);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState("resultsFound", true);
    api.setState('searchTerm', searchTerm);
    let cdbInput = {
        count: 0,
        pageIndex: 0,
        searchTerm: searchTerm,
        selectedLocation: api.state.selectedLocation ? api.state.selectedLocation[0] : "",
        transactionInput: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionInput,
        catalogType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType,
        transactionType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionType,
        suppressPricing: api.state.requestEntityDetails.suppressPricing,
        account: api.state.requestEntityDetails.account,
        recommendation: api.state.recommendation,
        selectedCatalog: api.state.selectedCatalog,
        selectedCategory: api.state.selectedCategory,
        leafCategoryList: api.state.leafCategoryList,
        selectedCatalogHierarchy: api.state.selectedCatalog == "allCatalog" ? null : api.state.selectedCatalogHierarchy,
        inputEntityDetails: api.state.requestEntityDetails.inputEntityDetails,
        contextFilterChanges: api.state.contextFilterChanges,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy
    };
    if(aiSearchSuggestionId) 
        cdbInput['aiSearchSuggestionId'] = aiSearchSuggestionId;
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:49</sys_created_on><sys_id>4eb1749791170314b96b4a673452a0e2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Search for data</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_4eb1749791170314b96b4a673452a0e2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:49</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">50c1bc9791170314b96b4a673452a0e9</macroponent><name>characteristic_dropdown/items</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    
    if (api.item.value) {
        const charOptions = api.item.value.characteristic_options;
        const checkedCount = charOptions.filter(item => item.checked).length;
        const isCharMandatory = api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory && api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory.value === '1';
        return charOptions
            .filter(option => option.is_visible)
            .map(option => ({
                id: option.sys_id.value,
                label: option.label,
                disabled: !option.is_editable ||
                    (isCharMandatory &&
                        checkedCount === 1 &&
                        option.checked)
            }));
    }

}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:34:04</sys_created_on><sys_id>55c174d791170314b96b4a673452a03a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>characteristic_dropdown/items</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_55c174d791170314b96b4a673452a03a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:34:04</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

}) {
    if (api.item.value && api.item.value.attributes.error_message) {
        var messageStatus = api.item.value.attributes.error_message.status;
        var isCritical = messageStatus && messageStatus === 'critical';
        var isVisible = api.item.value.attributes.is_visible;

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">50c1bc9791170314b96b4a673452a0e9</macroponent><name>fixed_characteristic_container/isHidden</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value.attributes) {
        var isCheckbox = (api.item.value.attributes.input_type.value == "checkbox");
        var isRadio = (api.item.value.attributes.input_type.value == "choice" || api.item.value.attributes.input_type.value == "yes_no" );
        var isTextBox =  (api.item.value.attributes.input_type.value == "single_line_text");
        if (api.item.value.characteristic_options) {
            return (isCheckbox || isRadio || isTextBox || api.item.value.characteristic_options.length > 1);
        }
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:34:02</sys_created_on><sys_id>74c1b0d791170314b96b4a673452a0b6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>fixed_characteristic_container/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_74c1b0d791170314b96b4a673452a0b6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:34:02</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes>c029403043d71210ea13912a1bb8f228,3d59c03043d71210ea13912a1bb8f2eb,6299f45143d35210ea13912a1bb8f221,4ef88cfc43971210ea13912a1bb8f26f,c0b44fea431bd210ea13912a1bb8f273,6e7407dd43231210ea13912a1bb8f2ab,69f913e143e71210ea13912a1bb8f2a5</includes><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">eab1389791170314b96b4a673452a076</macroponent><name>Config Reducer</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "{0} clone created"
    },
    {
        "message": "{0} clones created"
    },
    {
        "message": "Configuration split"
    },
    {
        "message": "Configuration deleted"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
async function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    const {
        emit: dispatch,
        setState,
        state,
        context,
        data
    } = api;
    const {
        'sn_prd_pm.updateStatesUtil': updateStatesInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigUtil': productConfigUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigTransformsUtil': productConfigTransformsUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigProcessResponseUtil': productConfigProcessResponseUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.constantsUtil': constantsUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.currentSelectionUtil': currentSelectionUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.attributeAdjustmentUtil': attributeAdjustmentUtilInclude
    } = imports;

    const {
        name,
        payload
    } = event;

    const {
        setStates
    } = updateStatesInclude();

    const {
        createCurrentSelection,
        updatePricesInCurrentSelection
    } = currentSelectionUtilInclude();

    const {
        configLoaded,
        userActionProductSelection,
        productHierarchyModified,
        userActionCharSelection,
        prepareConfigInstanceForPricing,
        parentQuantityUpdated,
        userActionProductQuantityChange,
        hideErrorContainer,
        updateMultiInstance,
        summaryActionClicked,
        resetConfigInstance,
        prepareConfigInstanceForOpenStatePricing,
        debounce,
        debounceCurrentAppState,
        updateObjectCharValueInConfigInstance,
        navigateToSelectedObjectChar,
        setSelectedObjectCharNode,
        addOrRemoveInstances,
        getTargetNodeRecursive
    } = productConfigUtilInclude();

    const {
        initiateConfigRulesStateCall,
        initiatePricingCall,
        initiateCurrencyCall,
        getNewInstanceComplexCharDb
    } = productConfigTransformsUtilInclude();

    const {
        receiveOpenStateResponse,
        receivePricingResponse,
        recieveCurrencyCallResponse,
        receiveValidationResponse
    } = productConfigProcessResponseUtilInclude();

    const {
        createAttributeAdjustments,
        updateAttributeAdjustments
    } = attributeAdjustmentUtilInclude();

    const {
        STATE_PROPS: {
            CONFIG_INSTANCE,
            CONFIG_SETTINGS,
            CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE,
            PRODUCT_HIERARCHY,
            CURRENT_APP_STATE,
            MODIFIED_NODES,
            PRICING_INSTANCE,
            PRICING_RESPONSE,
            SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC,
            SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC,
            COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED,
            ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD,
            SKIP_PRICING
            
        },
        APP_STATES: {
            ARRAY_CHAR_INSTANCE_CHANGED,
            INITIAL_CONFIG_DATA_LOADED,
            ON_LOAD_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_MODIFIED,
            HIERARCHY_PRICING_INITIATED,
            HIERARCHY_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHANGE_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_CHANGE_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            ON_LOAD_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_LOAD_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHAR_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHAR_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED,
            OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED
        }
    } = constantsUtilInclude();
    let outputValue = {};
    let value = {
        configInstance: null,
        currentSelectionInstance: null,
        currentAppState: null,
        productHierarchy: null
    };
   
    const currentPayload = payload.payload;
    const additionalPayload = payload.additionalPayload;
    if(!payload.eventName)
        payload.eventName = name;        
    switch (payload.eventName) {
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CONFIG_LOADED':
            var configInstance = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            if (Object.keys(configInstance).length > 0) resetConfigInstance(api);
            else {
                value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
                value[CONFIG_SETTINGS] = currentPayload.configSettings;
                value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = createCurrentSelection(api, value);
                value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE]['parentQuantity'] = currentPayload.configInstance.product.attributes.quantity.value;
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = {
                    selectedProductDetails: {
                        selectedProductId: currentPayload.configInstance.product.id,
                        selectedProductPath: currentPayload.configInstance.product.path
                    },
                    appState: INITIAL_CONFIG_DATA_LOADED,
                    errorState: {}
                };
                const defaultSelectedProduct = [];
                defaultSelectedProduct.push(currentPayload.configInstance.product.id);
                value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = {
                    hierarchy: currentPayload.productHierarchy,
                    selectedItems: [defaultSelectedProduct],
                    expandedItems: [defaultSelectedProduct]
                };
                configLoaded(api, value);
            }
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails = {
                selectedProductId: currentPayload.id,
                selectedProductPath: currentPayload.path,
                isCharacteristicNode: currentPayload.is_char,
                isCharacteristicGroup: currentPayload.is_char_group
            };
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_MODIFIED;
            await productHierarchyModified(api, helpers, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION#SUMMARY_ACTION_INITIATED':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = payload.eventName;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = payload.payload.currentSelectionInstance;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            await userActionProductSelection(api, value, {
                payload: currentPayload,
                modifiedValue: additionalPayload
            }, helpers);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CHAR_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : userActionCharSelection,
                value : value,
                payload : {
                    currentPayload: currentPayload,
                    additionalPayload: additionalPayload
                    }});
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRICING_INITIATED':
            value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentPayload));
            value[PRICING_INSTANCE] = [prepareConfigInstanceForPricing(api, value)];
            initiatePricingCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRICING_SUCEEDED':
            value[PRICING_RESPONSE] = currentPayload.output;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_LOAD_PRICING_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == HIERARCHY_PRICING_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = HIERARCHY_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED) {
                await createAttributeAdjustments(api, value, helpers);
            } else {
                if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState != ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED)
                    value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHANGE_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
                await updateAttributeAdjustments(api, value, helpers);
            }
            updatePricesInCurrentSelection(api, value);
            receivePricingResponse(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_INITIATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = currentPayload.currentAppState;
            value[MODIFIED_NODES] = currentPayload.modifiedNodes;
            value[COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED] = currentPayload[COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED];
            initiateConfigRulesStateCall(api, value, additionalPayload);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            let prodHrchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            let selectedObjChar = api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] ? api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] : api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC];
            const selectedNodeId = prodHrchy.selectedItems[0][prodHrchy.selectedItems[0].length - 1];
            const targetNode = getTargetNodeRecursive(selectedNodeId, prodHrchy.hierarchy[0], [], true);
            const skipPricing = (selectedObjChar && selectedObjChar.path == targetNode.path) 
                || value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ARRAY_CHAR_INSTANCE_CHANGED;
            if(!skipPricing)
                debounceCurrentAppState({api: api, value: value, helpers: helpers, timeout: 0, appState: ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED});
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED;
            await receiveOpenStateResponse(api, value, currentPayload.output, skipPricing, helpers);
            if(selectedObjChar && selectedObjChar.path == targetNode.path) {
                value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                    selectedProductPath: selectedObjChar.path
                };
                setSelectedObjectCharNode(api, value);
            }
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#VALIDATION_SUCEEDED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.output;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            if(value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_CHAR_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHAR_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED;
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED;
            if(!api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                value[SKIP_PRICING] = false;
            else value[SKIP_PRICING] = true;
            receiveValidationResponse(api,value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CURRENCY_FORMAT_REQUESTED':
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.currentSelectionInstance;
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
            initiateCurrencyCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CURRENCY_FORMAT_REQUEST_SUCEEDED':
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.output;
            recieveCurrencyCallResponse(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PARENT_QUANTITY_UPDATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : parentQuantityUpdated,
                value : value,
                payload : currentPayload });
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_QUANTITY_UPDATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : await userActionProductQuantityChange,
                value : value,
                payload : {
                    quantity: currentPayload,
                    productPath: additionalPayload.productPath,
                    productInstanceQtyUpdate: additionalPayload.productInstanceQtyUpdate
                }});
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#HIDE_ERROR_CONTAINER':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            hideErrorContainer(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#SUMMARY_ACTION_DISPATCH':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.action = payload.payload.action;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.selectedProductPath = payload.payload.sourcePath;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.numberOfInstances = payload.payload.numberOfInstance;
            await summaryActionClicked(api, helpers, value);
            let content;
            if (payload.payload.action == 'cloneInitiated') {
                const numberOfClones = payload.payload.numberOfInstance;
                if (String(numberOfClones) === '1') {
                    content = await helpers.translate('{0} clone created', numberOfClones);
                } else {
                    content = await helpers.translate('{0} clones created', numberOfClones);
                }
            } else if (payload.payload.action == 'splitInitiated') {
                content = await helpers.translate('Configuration split');
            } else {
                content = await helpers.translate('Configuration deleted');
            }
            api.emit("NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS", {
                items: [{
                    id: "summaryInfo",
                    status: "positive",
                    icon: "info-circle-outline",
                    content: content,
                    action: {
                        type: "dismiss",
                    }
                }]
            });
            helpers.timing.setTimeout(()=> {
            api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#CLEAR_NOTIFICATIONS');
        }, 3000);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED;
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED;
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRICING_INSTANCE] = prepareConfigInstanceForOpenStatePricing(currentPayload, value);
            initiatePricingCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OBJECT_CHAR_VALUE_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                modifiedChar: payload.modifiedChar,
                selectedCharOption: payload.selectedCharOption
            };
            updateObjectCharValueInConfigInstance(api, value);
            break;
        case "OBJECT_CHARACTERISTIC_EDIT_BTN_CLICKED":
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                selectedObjectChar: payload.objectChar,
                parentChar: payload.parentChar
            };
            navigateToSelectedObjectChar(api, value);
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                selectedProductPath: payload.objectChar.path
            };
            setSelectedObjectCharNode(api, value);
            break;
        case "CONTENT_TREE_SELECTED_ITEMS_SET":
            let prodHierarchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            prodHierarchy.selectedItems = payload.nodes;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = prodHierarchy;
            setState(api, value);
            break;
        case "CONTENT_TREE_EXPANDED_ITEMS_SET":
            let prdHierarchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            prdHierarchy.expandedItems = payload.nodes;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = prdHierarchy;
            setState(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_ADD_MORE_INITIATED":
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: payload.parentChar
            };
            getNewInstanceComplexCharDb(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_ADD_MORE":
            let selectedChar;
            if(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedChar = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            else if(!api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedChar = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            let configInst = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            let hierarchy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY]));
            value[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] = selectedChar;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = configInst;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = hierarchy;
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: currentPayload.output.parentChar,
                newInstanceData: currentPayload.output.data
            };
            addOrRemoveInstances(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_DELETE_CLICKED":
            let selectedCharc;
            if(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedCharc = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            else if(!api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedCharc = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            let configInst2 = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            let hierarchy2 = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY]));
            value[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] = selectedCharc;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = configInst2;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = hierarchy2;
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: payload.parentChar,
                charToRemove: payload.charToRemove
            };
            addOrRemoveInstances(api, value);
    }

}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:57</sys_created_on><sys_id>7bb13c9791170314b96b4a673452a0f9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Config Reducer</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_7bb13c9791170314b96b4a673452a0f9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:57</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">84b1fc5791170314b96b4a673452a052</macroponent><name>label_value_32/label</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        if (api.item.value.input_type == 'choice' || api.item.value.input_type == 'yes_no') return api.item.value.price;

function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const isProductSelected = api.item.value.attributes.product.checked;
    if (!isProductSelected)
        return true;
    if (api.item.value.attributes.product.instances)
        return true;
    const minQty = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.min_quantity.value);
    const maxQty = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.max_quantity.value);
    const qtyValue = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.value);
    const errorCondition = qtyValue < minQty || qtyValue > maxQty;
    const invalidCondition = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.invalid && api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.invalid.value;
    let data = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.message;
    let dataContent = data && data.content;
    return !dataContent || (invalidCondition || errorCondition);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>85b1b09791170314b96b4a673452a0ad</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>label_value_46/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_85b1b09791170314b96b4a673452a0ad</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:45</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const product = api.item.value.attributes.product;
    if (product.instances) {
        return product.checked ? product.totalQuantity : 0;
    }
    let qty = product.attributes.selectedQuantity;
    const isChecked = product.checked;
    if (!qty) {
        const productQty = product.attributes.quantity.value || 1;
        product.attributes.selectedQuantity = {
            value: isChecked ? productQty : 0
        };
        qty = product.attributes.selectedQuantity;
    }
    return isChecked ? qty.value : 0;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>89b1f09791170314b96b4a673452a010</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>input_50/value</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_89b1f09791170314b96b4a673452a010</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:46</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const product = api.item.value.attributes.product;
    if (product.instances) {
        return product.checked ? product.totalQuantity : 0;
    }
    let qty = product.attributes.selectedQuantity;
    const isChecked = product.checked;
    if (!qty) {
        const productQty = product.attributes.quantity.value || 1;
        product.attributes.selectedQuantity = {
            value: isChecked ? productQty : 0
        };
        qty = product.attributes.selectedQuantity;
    }
    return isChecked ? qty.value : 0;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>63b13c9791170314b96b4a673452a028</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>input_50/value</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_63b13c9791170314b96b4a673452a028</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:56</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-catalog default">39b1749791170314b96b4a673452a065</macroponent><name>On context form initialized</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    const formFields = api.data.record.form.fields;
    let contextValues = {};
    for(const key in formFields) {
        if(formFields[key].value)
            contextValues[key] = {
                field: key,
                value: formFields[key].value
            };
    }
    let contextFilterChanges = {};
    contextFilterChanges["contextFields"] = contextValues;
    contextFilterChanges["entity"] = api.state.lineContext.table;
    api.setState("contextFilterChanges", contextFilterChanges);
    const data = api.state.requestEntityDetails;
    if (api.context.props.entityDetails.recommendation) {
        api.setState('showSearch', false);
        return;
    }
    api.setState('showSearch', true);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState('selectedCategory', 'showAll');
    api.setState('categorySelected', [
        ["showAll"]
    ]);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    let cdbInput = {
        count: 0,
        pageIndex: 0,
        selectedCategory: "showAll",
        transactionInput: data.transactionInput,
        transactionType: data.transactionType,
        account: data.account,
        catalogType: data.catalogType,
        suppressPricing: data.suppressPricing,
        inputEntityDetails: data.inputEntityDetails,
        contextFilterChanges: contextFilterChanges,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy
    };
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>cab1b49791170314b96b4a673452a0d9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>On context form initialized</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_cab1b49791170314b96b4a673452a0d9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

    {
        "message": "Select a maximum of {0} options"

    {

]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        let msg;
        if (api.item.value.attributes.name.value == "Bundled Products" || api.item.value.attributes.name.value == "Optional Products") {
            msg = "";
        } else {
            const min = api.item.value.attributes.min.value;
            const max = api.item.value.attributes.max.value;
            if (min == 0)
                msg = helpers.translateSync('Select a maximum of {0} options', [max]);
            else if (api.context.props.entityDetails['settings'] && api.context.props.entityDetails.settings['selectAllProductOptions'])
                msg = helpers.translateSync('Select a minimum of {0} options', [min]);
            else
                msg = helpers.translateSync('Select a minimum of {0} options and a maximum of {1} options', [min, max]);
        }
        return msg;
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>f8b1709791170314b96b4a673452a06f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>rel_grp_info_msg/text</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_f8b1709791170314b96b4a673452a06f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:44</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

}) {

        char_options = char_options.filter((option) => option.is_visible != false);

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const currentAppState = api.state.currentAppState;
    const configInstance = api.state.configInstance;
    const path = currentAppState.selectedProductDetails ? currentAppState.selectedProductDetails.selectedProductPath : 'product';

    const getByDotPath = (path = "", object = {}) => {
        return path
            .split(".")
            .reduce((iteratee = {}, p) => iteratee[p], object);
    };

    let currentProductData = [];
    currentProductData.push(getByDotPath(path, configInstance));

    return currentProductData;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>c9b1b09791170314b96b4a673452a0df</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>product_data_repeater/repeatWith</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_c9b1b09791170314b96b4a673452a0df</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:46</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">50c1bc9791170314b96b4a673452a0e9</macroponent><name>related_product_checkbox/readonly</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        var selectedRelationshipGroup = api.item.parent.value;
        var currentRelatedProducts = selectedRelationshipGroup.related_product;
        let checkedCount = 0;
        if (api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory.value == "1" || !selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.is_editable) {
            return true;
        };
        for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
            if (currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked) checkedCount++;
            currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = false;
        }
        if (checkedCount >= +selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.max.value) {
            for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
                if (!currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked)
                    currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = true;
            }
        }else if (checkedCount <= +selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.min.value ) {
            for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
                if (currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked)
                    currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = true;
            }
        }
        if (api.item.value.attributes.is_disabled)
            return true;
        return !api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.is_editable;
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:34:01</sys_created_on><sys_id>b4c1b0d791170314b96b4a673452a061</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>related_product_checkbox/readonly</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_b4c1b0d791170314b96b4a673452a061</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:34:01</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-catalog default">39b1749791170314b96b4a673452a065</macroponent><name>Update Heading For Eligibility</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "All products"
    },
    {
        "message": "Products for \"Show all\""
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    const data = event.payload.data.output;
    if (data.selectedCatalog === "allCatalog") {
        helpers.translate('All products')
            .then((translatedText) => {
                api.setState("productHeading", translatedText);
            });
    } else {
        if(api.state.selectedCategory === "showAll") {
                    helpers.translate('Products for "Show all"')
            .then((translatedText) => {
                api.setState("productHeading", translatedText);
            });

        var filteredArray = arr.filter(item => item.table != 'sn_ind_tmt_orm_order_task');
        return filteredArray;
    }
    return arr;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>4aa1b453f45747141f18b238e2e23841</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>clnbigwuiiaabbkaddbhhsntddzasjo/repeatWith</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_4aa1b453f45747141f18b238e2e23841</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:34</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
