sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes>c029403043d71210ea13912a1bb8f228,3d59c03043d71210ea13912a1bb8f2eb,6299f45143d35210ea13912a1bb8f221,4ef88cfc43971210ea13912a1bb8f26f,c0b44fea431bd210ea13912a1bb8f273,6e7407dd43231210ea13912a1bb8f2ab,69f913e143e71210ea13912a1bb8f2a5</includes><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">84b1fc5791170314b96b4a673452a052</macroponent><name>Config Reducer</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "{0} clone created"
    },
    {
        "message": "{0} clones created"
    },
    {
        "message": "Configuration split"
    },
    {
        "message": "Configuration deleted"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
async function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    const {
        emit: dispatch,
        setState,
        state,
        context,
        data
    } = api;
    const {
        'sn_prd_pm.updateStatesUtil': updateStatesInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigUtil': productConfigUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigTransformsUtil': productConfigTransformsUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigProcessResponseUtil': productConfigProcessResponseUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.constantsUtil': constantsUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.currentSelectionUtil': currentSelectionUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.attributeAdjustmentUtil': attributeAdjustmentUtilInclude
    } = imports;

    const {
        name,
        payload
    } = event;

    const {
        setStates
    } = updateStatesInclude();

    const {
        createCurrentSelection,
        updatePricesInCurrentSelection
    } = currentSelectionUtilInclude();

    const {
        configLoaded,
        userActionProductSelection,
        productHierarchyModified,
        userActionCharSelection,
        prepareConfigInstanceForPricing,
        parentQuantityUpdated,
        userActionProductQuantityChange,
        hideErrorContainer,
        updateMultiInstance,
        summaryActionClicked,
        resetConfigInstance,
        prepareConfigInstanceForOpenStatePricing,
        debounce,
        debounceCurrentAppState,
        updateObjectCharValueInConfigInstance,
        navigateToSelectedObjectChar,
        setSelectedObjectCharNode,
        addOrRemoveInstances,
        getTargetNodeRecursive
    } = productConfigUtilInclude();

    const {
        initiateConfigRulesStateCall,
        initiatePricingCall,
        initiateCurrencyCall,
        getNewInstanceComplexCharDb
    } = productConfigTransformsUtilInclude();

    const {
        receiveOpenStateResponse,
        receivePricingResponse,
        recieveCurrencyCallResponse,
        receiveValidationResponse
    } = productConfigProcessResponseUtilInclude();

    const {
        createAttributeAdjustments,
        updateAttributeAdjustments
    } = attributeAdjustmentUtilInclude();

    const {
        STATE_PROPS: {
            CONFIG_INSTANCE,
            CONFIG_SETTINGS,
            CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE,
            PRODUCT_HIERARCHY,
            CURRENT_APP_STATE,
            MODIFIED_NODES,
            PRICING_INSTANCE,
            PRICING_RESPONSE,
            SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC,
            SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC,
            COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED,
            ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD,
            SKIP_PRICING
            
        },
        APP_STATES: {
            ARRAY_CHAR_INSTANCE_CHANGED,
            INITIAL_CONFIG_DATA_LOADED,
            ON_LOAD_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_MODIFIED,
            HIERARCHY_PRICING_INITIATED,
            HIERARCHY_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHANGE_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_CHANGE_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            ON_LOAD_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_LOAD_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHAR_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHAR_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED,
            OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED
        }
    } = constantsUtilInclude();
    let outputValue = {};
    let value = {
        configInstance: null,
        currentSelectionInstance: null,
        currentAppState: null,
        productHierarchy: null
    };
   
    const currentPayload = payload.payload;
    const additionalPayload = payload.additionalPayload;
    if(!payload.eventName)
        payload.eventName = name;        
    switch (payload.eventName) {
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CONFIG_LOADED':
            var configInstance = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            if (Object.keys(configInstance).length > 0) resetConfigInstance(api);
            else {
                value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
                value[CONFIG_SETTINGS] = currentPayload.configSettings;
                value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = createCurrentSelection(api, value);
                value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE]['parentQuantity'] = currentPayload.configInstance.product.attributes.quantity.value;
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = {
                    selectedProductDetails: {
                        selectedProductId: currentPayload.configInstance.product.id,
                        selectedProductPath: currentPayload.configInstance.product.path
                    },
                    appState: INITIAL_CONFIG_DATA_LOADED,
                    errorState: {}
                };
                const defaultSelectedProduct = [];
                defaultSelectedProduct.push(currentPayload.configInstance.product.id);
                value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = {
                    hierarchy: currentPayload.productHierarchy,
                    selectedItems: [defaultSelectedProduct],
                    expandedItems: [defaultSelectedProduct]
                };
                configLoaded(api, value);
            }
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails = {
                selectedProductId: currentPayload.id,
                selectedProductPath: currentPayload.path,
                isCharacteristicNode: currentPayload.is_char,
                isCharacteristicGroup: currentPayload.is_char_group
            };
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_MODIFIED;
            await productHierarchyModified(api, helpers, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION#SUMMARY_ACTION_INITIATED':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = payload.eventName;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = payload.payload.currentSelectionInstance;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            await userActionProductSelection(api, value, {
                payload: currentPayload,
                modifiedValue: additionalPayload
            }, helpers);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CHAR_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : userActionCharSelection,
                value : value,
                payload : {
                    currentPayload: currentPayload,
                    additionalPayload: additionalPayload
                    }});
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRICING_INITIATED':
            value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentPayload));
            value[PRICING_INSTANCE] = [prepareConfigInstanceForPricing(api, value)];
            initiatePricingCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRICING_SUCEEDED':
            value[PRICING_RESPONSE] = currentPayload.output;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_LOAD_PRICING_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == HIERARCHY_PRICING_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = HIERARCHY_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED) {
                await createAttributeAdjustments(api, value, helpers);
            } else {
                if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState != ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED)
                    value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHANGE_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
                await updateAttributeAdjustments(api, value, helpers);
            }
            updatePricesInCurrentSelection(api, value);
            receivePricingResponse(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_INITIATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = currentPayload.currentAppState;
            value[MODIFIED_NODES] = currentPayload.modifiedNodes;
            value[COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED] = currentPayload[COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED];
            initiateConfigRulesStateCall(api, value, additionalPayload);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            let prodHrchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            let selectedObjChar = api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] ? api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] : api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC];
            const selectedNodeId = prodHrchy.selectedItems[0][prodHrchy.selectedItems[0].length - 1];
            const targetNode = getTargetNodeRecursive(selectedNodeId, prodHrchy.hierarchy[0], [], true);
            const skipPricing = (selectedObjChar && selectedObjChar.path == targetNode.path) 
                || value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ARRAY_CHAR_INSTANCE_CHANGED;
            if(!skipPricing)
                debounceCurrentAppState({api: api, value: value, helpers: helpers, timeout: 0, appState: ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED});
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED;
            await receiveOpenStateResponse(api, value, currentPayload.output, skipPricing, helpers);
            if(selectedObjChar && selectedObjChar.path == targetNode.path) {
                value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                    selectedProductPath: selectedObjChar.path
                };
                setSelectedObjectCharNode(api, value);
            }
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#VALIDATION_SUCEEDED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.output;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            if(value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_CHAR_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHAR_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED;
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED;
            if(!api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                value[SKIP_PRICING] = false;
            else value[SKIP_PRICING] = true;
            receiveValidationResponse(api,value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CURRENCY_FORMAT_REQUESTED':
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.currentSelectionInstance;
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
            initiateCurrencyCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CURRENCY_FORMAT_REQUEST_SUCEEDED':
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.output;
            recieveCurrencyCallResponse(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PARENT_QUANTITY_UPDATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : parentQuantityUpdated,
                value : value,
                payload : currentPayload });
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_QUANTITY_UPDATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : await userActionProductQuantityChange,
                value : value,
                payload : {
                    quantity: currentPayload,
                    productPath: additionalPayload.productPath,
                    productInstanceQtyUpdate: additionalPayload.productInstanceQtyUpdate
                }});
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#HIDE_ERROR_CONTAINER':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            hideErrorContainer(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#SUMMARY_ACTION_DISPATCH':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.action = payload.payload.action;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.selectedProductPath = payload.payload.sourcePath;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.numberOfInstances = payload.payload.numberOfInstance;
            await summaryActionClicked(api, helpers, value);
            let content;
            if (payload.payload.action == 'cloneInitiated') {
                const numberOfClones = payload.payload.numberOfInstance;
                if (String(numberOfClones) === '1') {
                    content = await helpers.translate('{0} clone created', numberOfClones);
                } else {
                    content = await helpers.translate('{0} clones created', numberOfClones);
                }
            } else if (payload.payload.action == 'splitInitiated') {
                content = await helpers.translate('Configuration split');
            } else {
                content = await helpers.translate('Configuration deleted');
            }
            api.emit("NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS", {
                items: [{
                    id: "summaryInfo",
                    status: "positive",
                    icon: "info-circle-outline",
                    content: content,
                    action: {
                        type: "dismiss",
                    }
                }]
            });
            helpers.timing.setTimeout(()=> {
            api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#CLEAR_NOTIFICATIONS');
        }, 3000);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED;
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED;
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRICING_INSTANCE] = prepareConfigInstanceForOpenStatePricing(currentPayload, value);
            initiatePricingCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OBJECT_CHAR_VALUE_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                modifiedChar: payload.modifiedChar,
                selectedCharOption: payload.selectedCharOption
            };
            updateObjectCharValueInConfigInstance(api, value);
            break;
        case "OBJECT_CHARACTERISTIC_EDIT_BTN_CLICKED":
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                selectedObjectChar: payload.objectChar,
                parentChar: payload.parentChar
            };
            navigateToSelectedObjectChar(api, value);
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                selectedProductPath: payload.objectChar.path
            };
            setSelectedObjectCharNode(api, value);
            break;
        case "CONTENT_TREE_SELECTED_ITEMS_SET":
            let prodHierarchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            prodHierarchy.selectedItems = payload.nodes;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = prodHierarchy;
            setState(api, value);
            break;
        case "CONTENT_TREE_EXPANDED_ITEMS_SET":
            let prdHierarchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            prdHierarchy.expandedItems = payload.nodes;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = prdHierarchy;
            setState(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_ADD_MORE_INITIATED":
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: payload.parentChar
            };
            getNewInstanceComplexCharDb(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_ADD_MORE":
            let selectedChar;
            if(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedChar = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            else if(!api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedChar = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            let configInst = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            let hierarchy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY]));
            value[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] = selectedChar;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = configInst;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = hierarchy;
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: currentPayload.output.parentChar,
                newInstanceData: currentPayload.output.data
            };
            addOrRemoveInstances(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_DELETE_CLICKED":
            let selectedCharc;
            if(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedCharc = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            else if(!api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedCharc = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            let configInst2 = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            let hierarchy2 = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY]));
            value[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] = selectedCharc;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = configInst2;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = hierarchy2;
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: payload.parentChar,
                charToRemove: payload.charToRemove
            };
            addOrRemoveInstances(api, value);
    }

}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:47</sys_created_on><sys_id>5db1f09791170314b96b4a673452a0bc</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Config Reducer</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_5db1f09791170314b96b4a673452a0bc</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:47</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

function evaluateProperty({

}) {
    var catalogType = api.state.catalogType;
    var isProdOfferingOrServiceSpecCatalog = (catalogType == 'PRODUCT_OFFERING' || catalogType == 'SERVICE_SPECIFICATION');
    if (api.state.requestEntityDetails && api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType === "NEEDS")
        return true;
    else if (api.state.enableAISearchInCatalog && isProdOfferingOrServiceSpecCatalog)

    else return api.state.showSearch;

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-catalog default">39b1749791170314b96b4a673452a065</macroponent><name>Update heading</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "All products"
    },
    {
        "message": "Products for \"Show all\""
    },
    {
        "message": "Product selection guide"
    },
    {
        "message": "Products for \"{0}\""
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    // if (event.payload.item && event.payload.item.id != '') {
    //     if (event.payload.item.id == api.state.selectedCatalog || event.payload.item.id == api.state.selectedCategory)
    //         return;
    // }
    const elementId = event.elementId;
    const itemId = event.payload.item && event.payload.item.id != '' ? event.payload.item.id : '';
    const selectedCatalog = api.state.selectedCatalog;
    const isRecommendationCategory = event.payload.value ? event.payload.value.recommendation : false;
    if (elementId == "catalog_dropdown" && itemId == "allCatalog") {
        helpers.translate("All products")
            .then((translatedText) => {
                api.setState("productHeading", translatedText);
            });
    } else if (elementId == "category_hierarchy" && selectedCatalog == "allCatalog") {
        helpers.translate('Products for "Show all"')
            .then((translatedText) => {
                api.setState("productHeading", translatedText);
            });
    } else if (elementId == "catalog_dropdown" && itemId != "allCatalog") {
        helpers.translate('Products for "Show all"')
            .then((translatedText) => {
                api.setState("productHeading", translatedText);
            });
    } else if (elementId == "product_selection_guide_tree" || isRecommendationCategory) {
        helpers.translate('Product selection guide')
            .then((translatedText) => {
                api.setState("productHeading", translatedText);
            });
    } else {
        const selectedCategory = event.payload.item.label;
        helpers.translate('Products for "{0}"', selectedCategory)
            .then((translatedText) => {
                api.setState("productHeading", translatedText);
            });
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>8eb1b49791170314b96b4a673452a04f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update heading</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_8eb1b49791170314b96b4a673452a04f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">50c1bc9791170314b96b4a673452a0e9</macroponent><name>container_46/isHidden</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    var attributeAdjustments = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state.attributeAdjustments));
    if (attributeAdjustments) {
        for (let i = 0; i < attributeAdjustments.length; i++) {
            attributeAdjustments[i].selected_products = attributeAdjustments[i].selected_products.filter((product) => product.adjustment_applied != null);
            attributeAdjustments[i].selected_chars = attributeAdjustments[i].selected_chars.filter((char) => char.adjustment_applied != null);
        }
    }

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">50c1bc9791170314b96b4a673452a0e9</macroponent><name>ConfigureProduct</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    let configInstance = api.state.configInstance;
    let tempConfigInstance = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(configInstance));
    let refreshId = parseInt(Math.ceil(Math.random() * Date.now()).toPrecision(16).toString().replace(".", ""));
    let escalationRefreshQueue = api.state.escalationRefreshQueue;
    escalationRefreshQueue.push(refreshId);
    api.setState('escalationRefreshQueue', escalationRefreshQueue);
    helpers.timing.setTimeout(() => {
        if (api.state.escalationRefreshQueue.length === 1) // Process only last request in queue
            api.emit('SN_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION#SEND_CONFIG_INSTANCE', {
                configInstance: tempConfigInstance
            });
        const index = escalationRefreshQueue.indexOf(refreshId);
        if (index > -1)
            escalationRefreshQueue.splice(index, 1); // Remove from queue
        api.setState('escalationRefreshQueue', escalationRefreshQueue);
    }, 1000);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:34:01</sys_created_on><sys_id>b4c170d791170314b96b4a673452a0eb</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ConfigureProduct</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_b4c170d791170314b96b4a673452a0eb</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:34:01</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-catalog default">39b1749791170314b96b4a673452a065</macroponent><name>Sort Order/Sort By Clicked</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    let cdbInput = {};
    api.setState('pageIndex', 0);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState("resultsFound", true);
    cdbInput = {
        count: 0,
        pageIndex: 0,
        searchTerm: api.state.searchTerm,
        selectedLocation: api.state.selectedLocation ? api.state.selectedLocation[0] : "",
        transactionInput: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionInput,
        catalogType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType,
        transactionType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionType,
        suppressPricing: api.state.requestEntityDetails.suppressPricing,
        account: api.state.requestEntityDetails.account,
        recommendation: api.state.recommendation,
        selectedCatalog: api.state.selectedCatalog,
        selectedCategory: api.state.selectedCategory,
        leafCategoryList: api.state.leafCategoryList,
        selectedCatalogHierarchy: api.state.selectedCatalog == "allCatalog" ? null : api.state.selectedCatalogHierarchy,
        inputEntityDetails: api.state.requestEntityDetails.inputEntityDetails,
        contextFilterChanges: api.state.contextFilterChanges

    };
    if (event.elementId == 'sort_order') {
        var sortOrderIcon = api.state.sortOrderIcon.includes('ascending') ? 'sort-descending-fill' : 'sort-ascending-fill';
        api.setState('sortOrderIcon', sortOrderIcon);

        var sortOrder = api.state.sortOrderIcon.includes('ascending') ? 'descending' : 'ascending';
        var pageFilters = api.state.pageFilters;
        pageFilters.sort.sortOrder = sortOrder;
        api.setState('pageFilters', pageFilters);

        cdbInput['sortOrder'] = api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder;
        cdbInput['sortBy'] = api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy;
    } else {
        cdbInput['sortBy'] = event.payload.item.id;
        cdbInput['sortOrder'] = api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder;
        
        var pageFilters = api.state.pageFilters;
        pageFilters.sort.sortBy = event.payload.item.id;
        api.setState('pageFilters', pageFilters);
    }
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:49</sys_created_on><sys_id>b9b1749791170314b96b4a673452a0c8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Sort Order/Sort By Clicked</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_b9b1749791170314b96b4a673452a0c8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:49</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    var attributeAdjustments = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state.attributeAdjustments));
    if (attributeAdjustments) {
        for (let i = 0; i < attributeAdjustments.length; i++) {
            attributeAdjustments[i].selected_products = attributeAdjustments[i].selected_products.filter((product) => product.adjustment_applied != null);
            attributeAdjustments[i].selected_chars = attributeAdjustments[i].selected_chars.filter((char) => char.adjustment_applied != null);
        }
    }
    attributeAdjustments = attributeAdjustments.filter((adjustmentsObj) => (adjustmentsObj.selected_products.length > 0 || adjustmentsObj.selected_chars.length > 0));
    return attributeAdjustments.length == 0;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>c5b1f09791170314b96b4a673452a03f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>container_46/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_c5b1f09791170314b96b4a673452a03f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:46</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {api} params.api

 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        if (!api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.is_editable)
            return true;
        if (api.context.props.entityDetails['settings'] && api.context.props.entityDetails.settings['selectAllProductOptions'] || api.item.value.attributes.product.instances)

        var data = api.item.value.attributes;

    }
    return false;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:57</sys_created_on><sys_id>f3b13c9791170314b96b4a673452a0bc</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>input_50/readonly</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_f3b13c9791170314b96b4a673452a0bc</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:57</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    let requestEntityDetails = api.state.requestEntityDetails;
    if (!requestEntityDetails) {
        return true;
    }
    if ((requestEntityDetails.table == "sn_opty_mgmt_core_opportunity" || requestEntityDetails.table == "sn_lead_mgmt_core_lead") && requestEntityDetails.isNeededInstalled) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:49</sys_created_on><sys_id>bdb1749791170314b96b4a673452a0a1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>product_selection_guide_tree/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_bdb1749791170314b96b4a673452a0a1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:49</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">50c1bc9791170314b96b4a673452a0e9</macroponent><name>charcteristic_option_checkbox/readonly</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        if (!api.item.value.is_editable) return true;
        var currentCharacteristic = api.item.parent.value;
        if (currentCharacteristic.attributes.is_mandatory && currentCharacteristic.attributes.is_mandatory.value == '1') {
            var currentCharacteristicOptions = currentCharacteristic.characteristic_options;
            const checkedCount = currentCharacteristicOptions.filter(item => item.checked).length;
            if (checkedCount == 1 && api.item.value.checked)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:34:02</sys_created_on><sys_id>c9c1f0d791170314b96b4a673452a03c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>charcteristic_option_checkbox/readonly</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_c9c1f0d791170314b96b4a673452a03c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:34:02</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-catalog default">39b1749791170314b96b4a673452a065</macroponent><name>Set search placeholder</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "Search product display name, code or description"
    },
    {
        "message": "Search inventory name"
    },
    {
        "message": "Search service display name, code or description"
    },
    {
        "message": "Search needs name or description"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    let data = api.data.transactioncatalogdatabroker.output;
    if (data) {
        if (data.catalogType == "PRODUCT_OFFERING"){
            helpers.translate("Search product display name, code or description")
                .then((translatedText) => {
                    api.setState("searchPlaceholder", translatedText);
            });
        } else if (data.catalogType == "PRODUCT_INVENTORY"){
            helpers.translate("Search inventory name")
                .then((translatedText) => {
                    api.setState("searchPlaceholder", translatedText);
            });
        } else if (data.catalogType == "SERVICE_SPECIFICATION") {
            helpers.translate("Search service display name, code or description")
                .then((translatedText) => {
                    api.setState("searchPlaceholder", translatedText);
            });
        } else if (data.catalogType == "NEEDS") {
            helpers.translate("Search needs name or description")
                .then((translatedText) => {
                    api.setState("searchPlaceholder", translatedText);
            });
        }
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>ceb1b49791170314b96b4a673452a00c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set search placeholder</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_ceb1b49791170314b96b4a673452a00c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

                                                            "controllerElementId": null,
                                                            "inlineScript": "/**\n * @param {params} params\n * @param {api} params.api\n * @param {any} params.event\n */\nfunction evaluateEvent({\n api,\n event\n}) {\n return {\n propName: \"sideTabIndex\",\n value: getRequestTrackerIndex()\n };\n\n function getRequestTrackerIndex() {\n if (showRequestTracker()) {\n var tabs = event.payload.tabs;\n for (var index = 0; index < tabs.length; index++) {\n if (tabs[index].id == \"request-tracker\") return index;\n }\n }\n return api.state.sideTabIndex;\n }\n\n function showRequestTracker() {\n var extraParams = api.context.props.extraParams;\n if (extraParams != null) {\n var params = extraParams.split(',');\n return 'showMessage'.localeCompare(params[0]) == 0 ||\n 'showRequestTracker'.localeCompare(params[0]) == 0;\n }\n return false;\n }\n}",

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-catalog default">39b1749791170314b96b4a673452a065</macroponent><name>Update Product Offerings</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    if (event.payload.item.id == api.state.selectedCategory)
        return;
    api.setState("showSearch", true);
    api.setState('productSelectionSelected', [
        []
    ]);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState("resultsFound", true);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    api.setState("leafCategoryList", null);
    api.setState('pageIndex', 0);
    const selectedCategory = event.payload.item.id;
    const selectedCatalog = api.state.selectedCatalog;
    let cdbInput = {
        count: 0,
        searchTerm: api.state.searchTerm,
        pageIndex: 0,
        transactionInput: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionInput,
        inputEntityDetails: api.state.requestEntityDetails.inputEntityDetails,
        catalogType: "PRODUCT_OFFERING",
        contextFilterChanges: api.state.contextFilterChanges,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy,
        aiSearchSuggestionId: api.state.aiSearchSuggestionId
    };
    if (selectedCatalog == 'allCatalog') {
        api.setState('selectedCatalog', selectedCategory);
        api.setState('selectedCategory', "showAll");
        api.setState('selectedCatalogHierarchy', null);
        api.setState('categorySelected', [
            ["showAll"]
        ]);
        cdbInput.selectedCatalog = selectedCategory;
        cdbInput.selectedCategory = "showAll";
    } else {
        api.setState('selectedCategory', selectedCategory);
        cdbInput.selectedCatalog = selectedCatalog;
        cdbInput.selectedCategory = selectedCategory;
        cdbInput.selectedCatalogHierarchy = api.state.selectedCatalogHierarchy;
    }
    let requestEntityDetails = api.state.requestEntityDetails;
    requestEntityDetails.catalogType = "PRODUCT_OFFERING";
    api.setState("requestEntityDetails", requestEntityDetails);
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>06b1b49791170314b96b4a673452a07b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update Product Offerings</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_06b1b49791170314b96b4a673452a07b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:50</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        var selectedRelationshipGroup = api.item.parent.value;
        var currentRelatedProducts = selectedRelationshipGroup.related_product;
        let checkedCount = 0;
        if (api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory.value == "1" || !selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.is_editable) {
            return true;
        };
        for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
            if (currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked) checkedCount++;
            currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = false;
        }
        if (checkedCount >= +selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.max.value) {
            for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
                if (!currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked)
                    currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = true;
            }
        }else if (checkedCount <= +selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.min.value ) {
            for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
                if (currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked)
                    currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = true;
            }
        }
        if (api.item.value.attributes.is_disabled)
            return true;
        return !api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.is_editable;
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:55</sys_created_on><sys_id>1bb1b89791170314b96b4a673452a0a0</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>related_product_checkbox/readonly</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_1bb1b89791170314b96b4a673452a0a0</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:55</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

    const currentAppState = api.state.currentAppState;

    const path = currentAppState.selectedProductDetails ? currentAppState.selectedProductDetails.selectedProductPath : 'product';

    const getByDotPath = (path = "", object = {}) => {

    let currentProductData = [];
    currentProductData.push(getByDotPath(path, configInstance));

    return currentProductData;

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Review screen default">23a17c5791170314b96b4a673452a0b7</macroponent><name>Handle modify inventory</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    var action = api.data.order_review.orderAction;
    if(api.state.waitTime) {
        return;
    }
    api.setState("waitTime", true);
    if (action == 'change' || action.indexOf('change') > -1) {
        if (api.data.order_review.configuratorActivated) {
            var payload = {};
            payload.isInvt = true;
            payload.productId = api.data.order_review.topInvtId;
            payload.orderCategory = api.data.order_review.orderCategory;

            api.emit('ORDER_MANAGEMENT#OPEN_CONFIGURATOR', {
                payload: payload
            });
            api.setState("waitTime", false);
        } else {
            api.data.generate_order_lines_to_manage_inventory_1.execute({
                "orderId": api.context.props.orderId,
                "productId": api.context.props.sysId,
                "action": 'change'
            });
            api.setState("waitTime", false);

        }
    } else {
        var message = `Can't change line items when the order action is set at Disconnect, Resume, or Suspend.`;
        api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
            items: [{
                id: 'info',
                status: 'info',
                icon: 'circle-info-outline',
                content: message,
                action: {
                    type: 'dismiss'
                }
            }]
        });
        helpers.timing.setTimeout(() => {
            api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#CLEAR_NOTIFICATIONS');
        }, 3000);

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    var attributeAdjustments = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state.attributeAdjustments));
    if (attributeAdjustments) {
        for (let i = 0; i < attributeAdjustments.length; i++) {
            attributeAdjustments[i].selected_products = attributeAdjustments[i].selected_products.filter((product) => product.adjustment_applied != null);
            attributeAdjustments[i].selected_chars = attributeAdjustments[i].selected_chars.filter((char) => char.adjustment_applied != null);
        }
    }
    attributeAdjustments = attributeAdjustments.filter((adjustmentsObj) => (adjustmentsObj.selected_products.length > 0 || adjustmentsObj.selected_chars.length > 0));
    return attributeAdjustments.length == 0;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:57</sys_created_on><sys_id>bfb13c9791170314b96b4a673452a056</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>container_46/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_bfb13c9791170314b96b4a673452a056</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:57</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">84b1fc5791170314b96b4a673452a052</macroponent><name>characteristic_dropdown/items</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    
    if (api.item.value) {
        const charOptions = api.item.value.characteristic_options;
        const checkedCount = charOptions.filter(item => item.checked).length;
        const isCharMandatory = api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory && api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory.value === '1';
        return charOptions
            .filter(option => option.is_visible)
            .map(option => ({
                id: option.sys_id.value,
                label: option.label,
                disabled: !option.is_editable ||
                    (isCharMandatory &&
                        checkedCount === 1 &&
                        option.checked)
            }));
    }

}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:47</sys_created_on><sys_id>d5b1f09791170314b96b4a673452a0c0</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>characteristic_dropdown/items</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_d5b1f09791170314b96b4a673452a0c0</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:47</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        if (!api.item.value.is_editable) return true;
        var currentCharacteristic = api.item.parent.value;
        if (currentCharacteristic.attributes.is_mandatory && currentCharacteristic.attributes.is_mandatory.value == '1') {
            var currentCharacteristicOptions = currentCharacteristic.characteristic_options;
            const checkedCount = currentCharacteristicOptions.filter(item => item.checked).length;
            if (checkedCount == 1 && api.item.value.checked)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>e3b1f89791170314b96b4a673452a031</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>charcteristic_option_checkbox/readonly</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_e3b1f89791170314b96b4a673452a031</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:56</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    let ruleEngineError = api.state.configInstance.rule_engine_error;
    let currentAppState = api.state.currentAppState;
    let hasRuleEngineError = ruleEngineError && ruleEngineError != "";
    var onLoadAppState = ["onLoadPricingInitiated", "hierarchyPricingInitiated", "onChangePricingInitiated", "onLoadOpenStateInitiated", "onCharChangeOpenStateInitiated", "onProductChangeOpenStateInitiated", "openStatePricingInitiated"];
    let appInProcessingState = onLoadAppState.indexOf(currentAppState.appState) > -1;
    let productQtyInvalid = currentAppState['errorState'] && currentAppState['errorState']['productQtyInvalidMap'] ? Object.keys(currentAppState['errorState']['productQtyInvalidMap']).length > 0 : false;
    return hasRuleEngineError || appInProcessingState || productQtyInvalid;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>f8b1b09791170314b96b4a673452a01c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>add_update_button/disabled</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_f8b1b09791170314b96b4a673452a01c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:45</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    let commitInstance, entityDetails;
    let input = {
        action: '',
        lineId: '',
        lineTableName: '',
        ruleSessionId: '',
        configId: ''
    };
    let configInstance = api.state.configData.configInstance;
    commitInstance = api.data.productconfigurationdatabroker.output;
    entityDetails = api.context.props.entityDetails;
        if(typeof entityDetails == 'string')
        entityDetails = JSON.parse(entityDetails);
    input.ruleSessionId = configInstance.ruleSessionId;
    if (event.name == 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION#RECEIVE_CANCEL') {
        input.action = 'ABORT';
        input.lineId = entityDetails ? entityDetails.lineId : '';
    } else if (event.elementId == 'productconfigurationdatabroker' &&
        event.name == 'DATA_FETCH_SUCCEEDED' &&
        commitInstance && Object.keys(commitInstance).length > 0) {
        input.action = 'COMMIT';
        input.lineId = commitInstance.rootLineIDs[0];
        input.configId = entityDetails && entityDetails.metadata ? entityDetails.metadata.sourceToTargetEntityId : '';
    }
    api.data.ruleActionDataBroker.execute(input);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:48</sys_created_on><sys_id>e1b1349791170314b96b4a673452a0f2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ConfigRuleAction</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_e1b1349791170314b96b4a673452a0f2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:48</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:43</sys_created_on><sys_id>e8b1309791170314b96b4a673452a04c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>date_time_picker_input/format</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_e8b1309791170314b96b4a673452a04c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:43</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Configuration">eab1389791170314b96b4a673452a076</macroponent><name>label_value_46/isHidden</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const isProductSelected = api.item.value.attributes.product.checked;
    if (!isProductSelected)
        return true;
    if (api.item.value.attributes.product.instances)
        return true;
    const minQty = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.min_quantity.value);
    const maxQty = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.max_quantity.value);
    const qtyValue = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.value);
    const errorCondition = qtyValue < minQty || qtyValue > maxQty;
    const invalidCondition = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.invalid && api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.invalid.value;
    let data = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.message;
    let dataContent = data && data.content;
    return !dataContent || (invalidCondition || errorCondition);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>efb1f89791170314b96b4a673452a0ab</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>label_value_46/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_efb1f89791170314b96b4a673452a0ab</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:56</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        if (!api.item.value.is_editable) return true;
        var currentCharacteristic = api.item.parent.value;
        if (currentCharacteristic.attributes.is_mandatory && currentCharacteristic.attributes.is_mandatory.value == '1') {
            var currentCharacteristicOptions = currentCharacteristic.characteristic_options;
            const checkedCount = currentCharacteristicOptions.filter(item => item.checked).length;
            if (checkedCount == 1 && api.item.value.checked)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:33:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>fcb1b09791170314b96b4a673452a057</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>charcteristic_option_checkbox/readonly</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_fcb1b09791170314b96b4a673452a057</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:33:45</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        let charOptions = api.item.value.characteristic_options;

        }
        return options;
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 08:34:01</sys_created_on><sys_id>b4c170d791170314b96b4a673452a01a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>characteristic_dropdown/selectedItems</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_b4c170d791170314b96b4a673452a01a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 08:34:01</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-catalog default">39b1749791170314b96b4a673452a065</macroponent><name>Handle card events</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    if (api.state.requestEntityDetails.inputEntityDetails['readonly'])
    return;
    const eventName = event.name;
    updateLastUsedNumber();
    switch (eventName) {
        case "SN_PRODUCT_CATALOG#ADD_BUTTON_CLICKED":
            addToCart(event);
            break;
        case "SN_PRODUCT_CATALOG#CUSTOMIZE_BUTTON_CLICKED":
            customize(event);
            break;
        case "SN_PRODUCT_CATALOG#MANAGE_BUTTON_CLICKED":
            manageInventory();
            break;
        case "SN_PRODUCT_CATALOG#CAPTURE_NEEDS_BUTTON_CLICKED":
            captureNeeds();
            break;
        case "SN_PRODUCT_CATALOG#CARD_CLICKED":
            if (api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionInput.table == "sn_lead_mgmt_core_lead")
                return;
            if(!api.state.requestEntityDetails.showCustomize)
                return;
            if (api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType == "PRODUCT_INVENTORY")
                manageInventory();
            else if (api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType == "NEEDS")
                captureNeeds();
            else
                customize();
            break;
        default:
            break;
    }

    function manageInventory() {
        let productData = {
            "inventoryId": event.context.item.value.productOfferingSysId.value
        };
        api.emit('SN_PRODUCT_CATALOG#MANAGE', {
            productData: productData,
            catalogType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType
        });
    }

    function captureNeeds() {
        var decisionTree = event.context.item.value.decisionTree.value;
        api.setState('decisionTree', decisionTree);
        var needsDetail = {
            needsTemplateId: event.context.item.value.productOfferingSysId.value,
            sourcePage: "PRODUCT_CATALOG",
            headerId: api.context.props.entityDetails.headerId
        };
        api.context.props.entityDetails.recommendation = '';
        api.setState('needsDetails', needsDetail);
        api.data.decision_tree_execution.refresh();
    }

    function addToCart() {
        let qtyValue = getQuantity();
        if (qtyValue < 0)
            return;
        let productData = {
            "productId": event.context.item.value.productOfferingSysId.value,
            "quantity": qtyValue,
            "contextFilterChanges": api.state.contextFilterChanges
        };
        if (!api.state.isTransactionManagerActive) {
            api.data.productCatalogAddDataBroker.execute({
                productData: productData,
                entityDetails: api.state.requestEntityDetails
            });
        }
        const itemQuantitySelected = api.state.itemQuantitySelected;
        itemQuantitySelected[event.context.item.value.productOfferingSysId.value] = 1;
        api.setState("itemQuantitySelected",itemQuantitySelected);
        let output = api.state.isTransactionManagerActive ? productData : event.context.item.value;
        api.emit('PRODUCT_CATALOG#ADD_TO_CART', {
            cartData: output
        });
    }

    function customize() {
        let quantityValue = getQuantity();
        let productData = {
            "productId": event.context.item.value.productOfferingSysId.value,
            "quantity": quantityValue > 0 ? quantityValue : 1,
            "contextFilterChanges": api.state.contextFilterChanges
        };
        api.emit('SN_PRODUCT_CATALOG#CUSTOMIZE', {
            productData: productData,
            catalogType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType
        });
    }

    function getQuantity(){
        return parseInt(api.state.itemQuantitySelected[event.context.item.value.productOfferingSysId.value]);
    }

    function updateLastUsedNumber() {
        let contextFilterChanges = api.state.contextFilterChanges;
        if (contextFilterChanges && contextFilterChanges.contextFields) {
            if (api.state.lastUsedNumber && (contextFilterChanges.contextFields.number && contextFilterChanges.contextFields.number.value == api.state.lastUsedNumber)) {
                delete contextFilterChanges.contextFields["number"];
                api.setState("contextFilterChanges", contextFilterChanges);
            } else {
                const lastUsedNumber = contextFilterChanges.contextFields["number"] ? contextFilterChanges.contextFields["number"].value : api.state.lastUsedNumber;
                api.setState("lastUsedNumber", lastUsedNumber);
            }
        }
    }

                                                            "controllerElementId": null,
                                                            "inlineScript": "/**\n * @param {params} params\n * @param {api} params.api\n * @param {any} params.event\n */\nfunction evaluateEvent({\n api,\n event\n}) {\n return {\n propName: \"sideTabIndex\",\n value: getRequestTrackerIndex()\n };\n\n function getRequestTrackerIndex() {\n if (showRequestTracker()) {\n var tabs = event.payload.tabs;\n for (var index = 0; index < tabs.length; index++) {\n if (tabs[index].id == \"request-tracker\") return index;\n }\n }\n return api.state.sideTabIndex;\n }\n\n function showRequestTracker() {\n var extraParams = api.context.props.extraParams;\n if (extraParams != null) {\n var params = extraParams.split(',');\n return 'showMessage'.localeCompare(params[0]) == 0 ||\n 'showRequestTracker'.localeCompare(params[0]) == 0;\n }\n return false;\n }\n}",

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_9a3902b310fecf504699cdb60f0cc9e9
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>false</active><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt_core.ChoiceSyncUtil</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ChoiceSyncUtil</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[
var ChoiceSyncUtil = Class.create();
ChoiceSyncUtil.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    // Target Choice field being fed by the options table
    TARGET_TABLE: 'sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item',
    TARGET_ELEMENT: 'u_lbbw_enviroment',

    /**
     * Insert or update the matching sys_choice record
     * based on a row from the LBBW enviroment options table.
     */
    syncChoice: function(sourceRecord) {
        var label = sourceRecord.getValue('u_label');

        var choiceGR = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        choiceGR.addQuery('name', this.TARGET_TABLE);
        choiceGR.addQuery('element', this.TARGET_ELEMENT);
        choiceGR.addQuery('value', label); // no separate value column, so label = value
        choiceGR.query();

        if (choiceGR.next()) {
            choiceGR.setValue('label', label);
            choiceGR.setValue('sequence', sourceRecord.getValue('u_sequence'));
            choiceGR.update();
        } else {
            choiceGR.initialize();
            choiceGR.setValue('name', this.TARGET_TABLE);
            choiceGR.setValue('element', this.TARGET_ELEMENT);
            choiceGR.setValue('value', label);
            choiceGR.setValue('label', label);
            choiceGR.setValue('sequence', sourceRecord.getValue('u_sequence'));
            choiceGR.setValue('language', 'en');
            choiceGR.insert();
        }
    },

    /**
     * Remove the matching sys_choice record when the source row is deleted.
     */
    removeChoice: function(sourceRecord) {
        var label = sourceRecord.getValue('u_label');

        var choiceGR = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        choiceGR.addQuery('name', this.TARGET_TABLE);
        choiceGR.addQuery('element', this.TARGET_ELEMENT);
        choiceGR.addQuery('value', label);
        choiceGR.query();
        while (choiceGR.next()) {
            choiceGR.deleteRecord();
        }
    },

    type: 'ChoiceSyncUtil'
};
