<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt.QuoteDecisionAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description>Accept / Reject Quote in CSM Portal</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>QuoteDecisionAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var QuoteDecisionAjax = Class.create();
QuoteDecisionAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    isPublic: function() {
        return true;
    },

    processDecision: function() {
        var decision = this.getParameter('sysparm_decision');
        var sys_id = this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id');
        var table = this.getParameter('sysparm_table');

        gs.info('=== QuoteDecisionAjax START ===');
        gs.info('Decision: ' + decision + ', Sys ID: ' + sys_id + ', Table: ' + table);

        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(table);

        if (!gr.get(sys_id) || !gr.isValid()) {
            return 'Angebot nicht gefunden';
        }

        if (decision === 'accept') {
            gr.state = 'completed';
            gr.update();
            return 'Angebot erfolgreich akzeptiert';
        } else if (decision === 'reject') {
            return 'Bitte verwenden Sie das Formular "Ablehnen mit Grund"';
        } else {
            return 'Ungültige Entscheidung';
        }
    },

    rejectWithReason: function() {
        var sys_id = this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id');
        var table = this.getParameter('sysparm_table');
        var reason = this.getParameter('sysparm_reason');

        gs.info('=== QuoteDecisionAjax rejectWithReason START ===');
        gs.info('Sys ID: ' + sys_id + ', Table: ' + table + ', Reason: ' + reason);

        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(table);

        if (!gr.get(sys_id) || !gr.isValid()) {
            return 'Angebot nicht gefunden';
        }

        // Prüfen ob Grund-Attribut existiert
        if (gr.isValidField('u_reason_for_rejection')) {
            gr.u_reason_for_rejection = reason;
        } else {
            gs.error('Das Feld u_reason_for_rejection existiert nicht!');
            return 'Ablehnungsfeld (u_reason_for_rejection) nicht gefunden';
        }

        gr.state = 'rejected';
        gr.update();

        gs.info('Angebot erfolgreich mit Grund abgelehnt');

        return 'Angebot erfolgreich abgelehnt.\nGrund: ' + reason;
    },

    returnForRevision: function() {
        var sys_id = this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id');
        var table = this.getParameter('sysparm_table');
        var reason = this.getParameter('sysparm_reason');

        gs.info('=== QuoteDecisionAjax returnForRevision START ===');
        gs.info('Sys ID: ' + sys_id + ', Table: ' + table + ', Reason: ' + reason);

        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(table);

        if (!gr.get(sys_id) || !gr.isValid()) {
            return 'Angebot nicht gefunden';
        }

        // Prüfen ob Grund-Attribut existiert (für die Überarbeitung)
        if (gr.isValidField('u_reason_for_rejection')) {
            gr.u_reason_for_rejection = reason;
        } else {
            gs.error('Das Feld u_reason_for_rejection existiert nicht!');
            return 'Überarbeitungsfeld (u_reason_for_rejection) nicht gefunden';
        }

        gr.state = 'in_review';
        gr.update();

        gs.info('Angebot erfolgreich zur Überarbeitung zurückgegeben');

        return 'Angebot erfolgreich zur Überarbeitung zurückgegeben.\nGrund: ' + reason;
    },

    type: 'QuoteDecisionAjax'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-09 15:21:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>0c364e76d05d8b501f18ceb26814d700</sys_id><sys_mod_count>29</sys_mod_count><sys_name>QuoteDecisionAjax</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_0c364e76d05d8b501f18ceb26814d700</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-11 11:31:07</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sn_doc_template_script"><sn_doc_template_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>SOM_Termine_Realization_Sentence</name><script><![CDATA[(function runTemplateScript(target /*GlideRecord for target task*/ , docTemplate /*GlideRecord for doc template*/ ) {
    var periodFrom = target.getValue('u_document_quote_fulfillment_period_from');
    var periodTo = target.getValue('u_document_quote_fulfillment_period_to');
    if (gs.nil(periodFrom) || gs.nil(periodTo)) {
        return '';
    }
    var periodFromDisplay = target.getDisplayValue('u_document_quote_fulfillment_period_from');
    var periodToDisplay = target.getDisplayValue('u_document_quote_fulfillment_period_to');
    return ' Die Realisierung erfolgt voraussichtlich im Zeitraum von ' + periodFromDisplay + ' bis ' + periodToDisplay + '.';
})(target, docTemplate);]]></script><sys_class_name>sn_doc_template_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE48</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-21 11:12:30</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_id>3452345cc9a30314b96b412c13023d22</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>SOM_Termine_Realization_Sentence</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sn_doc_template_script_3452345cc9a30314b96b412c13023d22</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE48</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-21 11:12:30</sys_updated_on></sn_doc_template_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    let configInstance = api.state.configInstance;
    let tempConfigInstance = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(configInstance));
    let refreshId = parseInt(Math.ceil(Math.random() * Date.now()).toPrecision(16).toString().replace(".", ""));
    let escalationRefreshQueue = api.state.escalationRefreshQueue;
    escalationRefreshQueue.push(refreshId);
    api.setState('escalationRefreshQueue', escalationRefreshQueue);
    helpers.timing.setTimeout(() => {
        if (api.state.escalationRefreshQueue.length === 1) // Process only last request in queue
            api.emit('SN_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION#SEND_CONFIG_INSTANCE', {
                configInstance: tempConfigInstance
            });
        const index = escalationRefreshQueue.indexOf(refreshId);
        if (index > -1)
            escalationRefreshQueue.splice(index, 1); // Remove from queue
        api.setState('escalationRefreshQueue', escalationRefreshQueue);
    }, 1000);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:51:04</sys_created_on><sys_id>3a8c1f7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8dcf</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ConfigureProduct</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_3a8c1f7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8dcf</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:51:04</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    var action = api.data.order_review.orderAction;
    if(api.state.waitTime) {
        return;
    }
    api.setState("waitTime", true);
    if (action == 'change' || action.indexOf('change') > -1) {
        if (api.data.order_review.configuratorActivated) {

            payload.isInvt = true;
            payload.productId = api.data.order_review.topInvtId;

            api.emit('ORDER_MANAGEMENT#OPEN_CONFIGURATOR', {
                payload: payload
            });

 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    var attributeAdjustments = api.state.attributeAdjustments;
    var updatedAttributeAdjustments = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(attributeAdjustments));
    if (updatedAttributeAdjustments) {
        for (let i = 0; i < updatedAttributeAdjustments.length; i++) {
            updatedAttributeAdjustments[i].selected_products = updatedAttributeAdjustments[i].selected_products.filter((product) => product.adjustment_applied != "");
            updatedAttributeAdjustments[i].selected_chars = {};
        }
    }
    return updatedAttributeAdjustments;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>9a7c1f74e9270b944699741a8f7d746f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>repeater_7/repeatWith</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_9a7c1f74e9270b944699741a8f7d746f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:46</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product catalog view default">497c1774e9270b944699741a8f7d74ef</macroponent><name>On context filter value change</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    const formFields = api.data.record.form.fields;
    let contextValues = {};
    for(const key in formFields) {
        if(formFields[key].value)
            contextValues[key] = {
                field: key,
                value: formFields[key].value
            };
    }
    let contextFilterChanges = {};
    contextFilterChanges["contextFields"] = contextValues;
    contextFilterChanges["entity"] = api.state.lineContext.table;
    api.setState("contextFilterChanges", contextFilterChanges);
    const data = api.state.requestEntityDetails;
    if (api.context.props.entityDetails.recommendation) {
        api.setState('showSearch', false);
        return;
    }
    api.setState('showSearch', true);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState('selectedCategory', 'showAll');
    api.setState('categorySelected', [
        ["showAll"]
    ]);
    api.setState('selectedCatalogHierarchy', null);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    let cdbInput = {
        count: 0,
        pageIndex: 0,
        searchTerm: api.state.searchTerm,
        selectedCategory: "showAll",
        selectedCatalog: null,
        transactionInput: data.transactionInput,
        transactionType: data.transactionType,
        account: data.account,
        catalogType: data.catalogType,
        suppressPricing: data.suppressPricing,
        inputEntityDetails: data.inputEntityDetails,
        selectedCatalogHierarchy: null,
        contextFilterChanges: contextFilterChanges,
        clearCatalogCache: true,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy
    };
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>d17c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d743c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>On context filter value change</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_d17c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d743c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Config Default">3d8c5b7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8dd5</macroponent><name>characteristic_dropdown/items</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    
    if (api.item.value) {
        const charOptions = api.item.value.characteristic_options;
        const checkedCount = charOptions.filter(item => item.checked).length;
        const isCharMandatory = api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory && api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory.value === '1';
        return charOptions
            .filter(option => option.is_visible)
            .map(option => ({
                id: option.sys_id.value,
                label: option.label,
                disabled: !option.is_editable ||
                    (isCharMandatory &&
                        checkedCount === 1 &&
                        option.checked)
            }));
    }

}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:51:03</sys_created_on><sys_id>ee8cdb7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8dbb</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>characteristic_dropdown/items</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_ee8cdb7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8dbb</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:51:03</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-configuration default">c88c5b701163cf94b0e48eebb0942138</macroponent><name>input_50/value</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const product = api.item.value.attributes.product;
    if (product.instances) {
        return product.checked ? product.totalQuantity : 0;
    }
    let qty = product.attributes.selectedQuantity;
    const isChecked = product.checked;
    if (!qty) {
        const productQty = product.attributes.quantity.value || 1;
        product.attributes.selectedQuantity = {
            value: isChecked ? productQty : 0
        };
        qty = product.attributes.selectedQuantity;
    }
    return isChecked ? qty.value : 0;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>b08c9b701163cf94b0e48eebb09421b8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>input_50/value</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_b08c9b701163cf94b0e48eebb09421b8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:56</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-configuration default">c88c5b701163cf94b0e48eebb0942138</macroponent><name>label_value_38/isHidden</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const isProductSelected = api.item.value.attributes.product.checked;
    if (!isProductSelected)
        return false;
    if (api.item.value.attributes.product.instances)
        return false;
    const minQty = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.min_quantity.value);
    const maxQty = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.max_quantity.value);
    const qtyValue = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.value);
    const errorCondition = qtyValue < minQty || qtyValue > maxQty;
    const invalidCondition = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.invalid && api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.invalid.value;
    let data = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.message;
    let dataContent = data && data.content;
    return dataContent || (invalidCondition || errorCondition);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>058cdb701163cf94b0e48eebb0942120</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>label_value_38/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_058cdb701163cf94b0e48eebb0942120</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:56</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product catalog view default">497c1774e9270b944699741a8f7d74ef</macroponent><name>Search for data</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    var searchTerm = '';
    if (event.payload.actionPayload) {
        var aiSearchSuggestionId = event.payload.actionPayload.sysId;
        api.setState('aiSearchSuggestionId', aiSearchSuggestionId);
    } else {
        searchTerm = event.payload.fieldValue || event.payload.searchTerm || '';
        api.setState('aiSearchSuggestionId', '');
    }
    api.setState('pageIndex', 0);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState("resultsFound", true);
    api.setState('searchTerm', searchTerm);
    let cdbInput = {
        count: 0,
        pageIndex: 0,
        searchTerm: searchTerm,
        selectedLocation: api.state.selectedLocation ? api.state.selectedLocation[0] : "",
        transactionInput: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionInput,
        catalogType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType,
        transactionType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionType,
        suppressPricing: api.state.requestEntityDetails.suppressPricing,
        account: api.state.requestEntityDetails.account,
        recommendation: api.state.recommendation,
        selectedCatalog: api.state.selectedCatalog,
        selectedCategory: api.state.selectedCategory,
        leafCategoryList: api.state.leafCategoryList,
        selectedCatalogHierarchy: api.state.selectedCatalog == "allCatalog" ? null : api.state.selectedCatalogHierarchy,
        inputEntityDetails: api.state.requestEntityDetails.inputEntityDetails,
        contextFilterChanges: api.state.contextFilterChanges,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy
    };
    if(aiSearchSuggestionId) 
        cdbInput['aiSearchSuggestionId'] = aiSearchSuggestionId;
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>117c5774e9270b944699741a8f7d74a3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Search for data</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_117c5774e9270b944699741a8f7d74a3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:41</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product catalog view default">497c1774e9270b944699741a8f7d74ef</macroponent><name>Set Catalog Data</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function script({
    api,
    event,
    helpers
}) {
    let data = event.payload.data.output;
    if (data) {
        if (data.selectedCatalog) {
            api.setState('selectedCatalog', data.selectedCatalog);
        }
        if (data.catalogList) {
            api.setState('catalogList', data.catalogList);
        }
        if (data.catalogList && data.catalogList.length > 0) {
            api.setState('selectedCatalogLabel', data.catalogList[0].children[0].label);
        }
        if (data.leafCategoryList) {
            api.setState('leafCategoryList', data.leafCategoryList);
        }
        if (data['spellCorrectedTerm'])
            api.setState('spellCorrectedTerm', data.spellCorrectedTerm);
        else
            api.setState('spellCorrectedTerm', '');
        let hierarchy = data.selectedAllCatalogHierarchy ? data.selectedAllCatalogHierarchy : data.selectedCatalogHierarchy;
        if (hierarchy && hierarchy.length > 0) {
            api.setState('selectedCatalogHierarchy', hierarchy);
        }

        let suggestionId = api.state.aiSearchSuggestionId;
        if (suggestionId !== "") {
            if (data.count == 1)
                api.setState('searchTerm', data.response[0].name.displayValue);
            if (data.count == 0)
                api.setState('searchTerm', data.suggestedRecordDisplayName);
        }
    }
    let obj = Object.assign({}, api.state.itemQuantitySelected || {});
    data.response.forEach(function(arrayItem) {
        var sysId = arrayItem.productOfferingSysId.value;
        arrayItem.invalid = {
            value: false
        };
        var existing = parseInt(obj[sysId]);
        obj[sysId] = (existing > 0) ? existing : 1;
    });
    api.setState('catalogData', data.response);
    if(data.filterCount == 0)

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        var selectedRelationshipGroup = api.item.parent.value;
        var currentRelatedProducts = selectedRelationshipGroup.related_product;
        let checkedCount = 0;
        if (api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory.value == "1" || !selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.is_editable) {
            return true;
        };
        for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
            if (currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked) checkedCount++;
            currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = false;
        }
        if (checkedCount >= +selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.max.value) {
            for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
                if (!currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked)
                    currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = true;
            }
        }else if (checkedCount <= +selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.min.value ) {
            for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
                if (currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked)
                    currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = true;
            }
        }
        if (api.item.value.attributes.is_disabled)
            return true;
        return !api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.is_editable;
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:57</sys_created_on><sys_id>0d8cdb701163cf94b0e48eebb094219a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>related_product_checkbox/readonly</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_0d8cdb701163cf94b0e48eebb094219a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:57</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const isProductSelected = api.item.value.attributes.product.checked;
    if (!isProductSelected || api.item.value.attributes.product.instances)
        return true;
    const minQty = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.min_quantity.value);
    const maxQty = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.max_quantity.value);
    const qtyValue = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.value);
    const errorCondition = qtyValue < minQty || qtyValue > maxQty;

function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const currentAppState = api.state.currentAppState;
    const configInstance = api.state.configInstance;
    const path = currentAppState.selectedProductDetails ? currentAppState.selectedProductDetails.selectedProductPath : 'product';

    const getByDotPath = (path = "", object = {}) => {
        return path
            .split(".")
            .reduce((iteratee = {}, p) => iteratee[p], object);
    };

    let currentProductData = [];
    currentProductData.push(getByDotPath(path, configInstance));

    return currentProductData;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:47</sys_created_on><sys_id>3a7c5f74e9270b944699741a8f7d7482</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>product_data_repeater/repeatWith</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_3a7c5f74e9270b944699741a8f7d7482</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:47</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const currentAppState = api.state.currentAppState;
    const configInstance = api.state.configInstance;
    const path = currentAppState.selectedProductDetails ? currentAppState.selectedProductDetails.selectedProductPath : 'product';

    const getByDotPath = (path = "", object = {}) => {
        return path
            .split(".")
            .reduce((iteratee = {}, p) => iteratee[p], object);
    };

    let currentProductData = [];
    currentProductData.push(getByDotPath(path, configInstance));

    return currentProductData;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:51:04</sys_created_on><sys_id>728c1f7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8d4c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>product_data_repeater/repeatWith</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_728c1f7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8d4c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:51:04</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

    var title;
    if (event.elementId === 'order_orchestration'){
        route = 'order-orchestration';
        fields = {
            sysId: api.context.props.sysId,
            tableName: api.context.props.table
        };
        title = await helpers.translate("Order orchestration");

    } else if (event.elementId === 'order_timeline'){
        route = 'timeline';
        fields = {
            recordId: api.context.props.sysId
        };
        title = await helpers.translate("Order timeline");
    }
    const customPayload = {
        'route': route,
        'targetRoute': 'current',
        'fields': fields,
        'title': title
    };
    api.emit('NAV_ITEM_SELECTED', customPayload);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:33</sys_created_on><sys_id>9f6c5b7010ef4b144699cdb60f0cc975</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Open secondary page</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_9f6c5b7010ef4b144699cdb60f0cc975</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:33</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    let ruleEngineError = api.state.configInstance.rule_engine_error;
    let currentAppState = api.state.currentAppState;
    let hasRuleEngineError = ruleEngineError && ruleEngineError != "";
    var onLoadAppState = ["onLoadPricingInitiated", "hierarchyPricingInitiated", "onChangePricingInitiated", "onLoadOpenStateInitiated", "onCharChangeOpenStateInitiated", "onProductChangeOpenStateInitiated", "openStatePricingInitiated"];
    let appInProcessingState = onLoadAppState.indexOf(currentAppState.appState) > -1;
    let productQtyInvalid = currentAppState['errorState'] && currentAppState['errorState']['productQtyInvalidMap'] ? Object.keys(currentAppState['errorState']['productQtyInvalidMap']).length > 0 : false;
    return hasRuleEngineError || appInProcessingState || productQtyInvalid;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:51:05</sys_created_on><sys_id>368c1f7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8ddd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>add_update_button/disabled</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_368c1f7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8ddd</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:51:05</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product catalog view default">497c1774e9270b944699741a8f7d74ef</macroponent><name>Set selected location</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    const locationId = event.payload.value[0];
    const selectedLoc = api.state.selectedLocation[0];
    if (selectedLoc == locationId)
        return;
    api.setState("selectedLocation", [locationId]);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState("resultsFound", true);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    let cdbInput = {
        count: 0,
        selectedLocation: locationId,
        searchTerm: api.state.searchTerm,
        pageIndex: 0,
        transactionInput: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionInput,
        transactionType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionType,
        account: api.state.requestEntityDetails.account,
        catalogType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy
    };
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>557c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d742c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set selected location</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_557c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d742c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-configuration default">c88c5b701163cf94b0e48eebb0942138</macroponent><name>product_data_repeater/repeatWith</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const currentAppState = api.state.currentAppState;
    const configInstance = api.state.configInstance;
    const path = currentAppState.selectedProductDetails ? currentAppState.selectedProductDetails.selectedProductPath : 'product';

    const getByDotPath = (path = "", object = {}) => {
        return path
            .split(".")
            .reduce((iteratee = {}, p) => iteratee[p], object);
    };

    let currentProductData = [];
    currentProductData.push(getByDotPath(path, configInstance));

    return currentProductData;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>708c9b701163cf94b0e48eebb0942197</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>product_data_repeater/repeatWith</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_708c9b701163cf94b0e48eebb0942197</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:56</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    var minQty = api.item.value.attributes.min_quantity.value;
    var maxQty = api.item.value.attributes.max_quantity.value;
    var qtyValue = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.value;
    var errorCondition = qtyValue < minQty || qtyValue > maxQty;
    let data = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.message;
    let errorMessage = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.error_message ?
        api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.error_message.content : '';
    return errorCondition ? errorMessage : data.content;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>9e7cdb74e9270b944699741a8f7d7434</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>stylized_text_13/text</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_9e7cdb74e9270b944699741a8f7d7434</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:45</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product catalog view default">497c1774e9270b944699741a8f7d74ef</macroponent><name>Sort Order/Sort By Clicked</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    let cdbInput = {};
    api.setState('pageIndex', 0);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState("resultsFound", true);
    cdbInput = {
        count: 0,
        pageIndex: 0,
        searchTerm: api.state.searchTerm,
        selectedLocation: api.state.selectedLocation ? api.state.selectedLocation[0] : "",
        transactionInput: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionInput,
        catalogType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType,
        transactionType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionType,
        suppressPricing: api.state.requestEntityDetails.suppressPricing,
        account: api.state.requestEntityDetails.account,
        recommendation: api.state.recommendation,
        selectedCatalog: api.state.selectedCatalog,
        selectedCategory: api.state.selectedCategory,
        leafCategoryList: api.state.leafCategoryList,
        selectedCatalogHierarchy: api.state.selectedCatalog == "allCatalog" ? null : api.state.selectedCatalogHierarchy,
        inputEntityDetails: api.state.requestEntityDetails.inputEntityDetails,
        contextFilterChanges: api.state.contextFilterChanges

    };
    if (event.elementId == 'sort_order') {
        var sortOrderIcon = api.state.sortOrderIcon.includes('ascending') ? 'sort-descending-fill' : 'sort-ascending-fill';
        api.setState('sortOrderIcon', sortOrderIcon);

        var sortOrder = api.state.sortOrderIcon.includes('ascending') ? 'descending' : 'ascending';
        var pageFilters = api.state.pageFilters;
        pageFilters.sort.sortOrder = sortOrder;
        api.setState('pageFilters', pageFilters);

        cdbInput['sortOrder'] = api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder;
        cdbInput['sortBy'] = api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy;
    } else {
        cdbInput['sortBy'] = event.payload.item.id;
        cdbInput['sortOrder'] = api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder;
        
        var pageFilters = api.state.pageFilters;
        pageFilters.sort.sortBy = event.payload.item.id;
        api.setState('pageFilters', pageFilters);
    }
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>517c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d7443</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Sort Order/Sort By Clicked</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_517c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d7443</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

    {
        "message": "Select a minimum of {0} options"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        let msg;
        if (api.item.value.attributes.message) {
            const min = api.item.value.attributes.min.value;
            if (api.context.props.entityDetails['settings'] && api.context.props.entityDetails.settings['selectAllProductOptions'])
                msg = helpers.translateSync('Select a minimum of {0} options', [min]);
            else
                msg = api.item.value.attributes.message.displayValue;
        }
        return msg;
    }

}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:51:02</sys_created_on><sys_id>528cdb7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8d75</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>rel_grp_err_msg/text</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_528cdb7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8d75</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:51:02</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product catalog view default">497c1774e9270b944699741a8f7d74ef</macroponent><name>Handle card events</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    if (api.state.requestEntityDetails.inputEntityDetails['readonly'])
    return;
    const eventName = event.name;
    updateLastUsedNumber();
    switch (eventName) {
        case "SN_PRODUCT_CATALOG#ADD_BUTTON_CLICKED":
            addToCart(event);
            break;
        case "SN_PRODUCT_CATALOG#CUSTOMIZE_BUTTON_CLICKED":
            customize(event);
            break;
        case "SN_PRODUCT_CATALOG#MANAGE_BUTTON_CLICKED":
            manageInventory();
            break;
        case "SN_PRODUCT_CATALOG#CAPTURE_NEEDS_BUTTON_CLICKED":
            captureNeeds();
            break;
        case "SN_PRODUCT_CATALOG#CARD_CLICKED":
            if (api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionInput.table == "sn_lead_mgmt_core_lead")
                return;
            if(!api.state.requestEntityDetails.showCustomize)
                return;
            if (api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType == "PRODUCT_INVENTORY")
                manageInventory();
            else if (api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType == "NEEDS")
                captureNeeds();
            else
                customize();
            break;
        default:
            break;
    }

    function manageInventory() {
        let productData = {
            "inventoryId": event.context.item.value.productOfferingSysId.value
        };
        api.emit('SN_PRODUCT_CATALOG#MANAGE', {
            productData: productData,
            catalogType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType
        });
    }

    function captureNeeds() {
        var decisionTree = event.context.item.value.decisionTree.value;
        api.setState('decisionTree', decisionTree);
        var needsDetail = {
            needsTemplateId: event.context.item.value.productOfferingSysId.value,
            sourcePage: "PRODUCT_CATALOG",
            headerId: api.context.props.entityDetails.headerId
        };
        api.context.props.entityDetails.recommendation = '';
        api.setState('needsDetails', needsDetail);
        api.data.decision_tree_execution.refresh();
    }

    function addToCart() {
        let qtyValue = getQuantity();
        if (qtyValue < 0)
            return;
        let productData = {
            "productId": event.context.item.value.productOfferingSysId.value,
            "quantity": qtyValue,
            "contextFilterChanges": api.state.contextFilterChanges
        };
        if (!api.state.isTransactionManagerActive) {
            api.data.productCatalogAddDataBroker.execute({
                productData: productData,
                entityDetails: api.state.requestEntityDetails
            });
        }
        const itemQuantitySelected = api.state.itemQuantitySelected;
        itemQuantitySelected[event.context.item.value.productOfferingSysId.value] = 1;
        api.setState("itemQuantitySelected",itemQuantitySelected);
        let output = api.state.isTransactionManagerActive ? productData : event.context.item.value;
        api.emit('PRODUCT_CATALOG#ADD_TO_CART', {
            cartData: output
        });
    }

    function customize() {
        let quantityValue = getQuantity();
        let productData = {
            "productId": event.context.item.value.productOfferingSysId.value,
            "quantity": quantityValue > 0 ? quantityValue : 1,
            "contextFilterChanges": api.state.contextFilterChanges
        };
        api.emit('SN_PRODUCT_CATALOG#CUSTOMIZE', {
            productData: productData,
            catalogType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType
        });
    }

    function getQuantity(){
        return parseInt(api.state.itemQuantitySelected[event.context.item.value.productOfferingSysId.value]);
    }

    function updateLastUsedNumber() {
        let contextFilterChanges = api.state.contextFilterChanges;
        if (contextFilterChanges && contextFilterChanges.contextFields) {
            if (api.state.lastUsedNumber && (contextFilterChanges.contextFields.number && contextFilterChanges.contextFields.number.value == api.state.lastUsedNumber)) {
                delete contextFilterChanges.contextFields["number"];
                api.setState("contextFilterChanges", contextFilterChanges);
            } else {
                const lastUsedNumber = contextFilterChanges.contextFields["number"] ? contextFilterChanges.contextFields["number"].value : api.state.lastUsedNumber;
                api.setState("lastUsedNumber", lastUsedNumber);
            }
        }
    }

}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>4a7c5b74e9270b944699741a8f7d7464</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>related_products_checkbox_container/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_4a7c5b74e9270b944699741a8f7d7464</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:44</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Order Line Char Config default">317c1b74e9270b944699741a8f7d7437</macroponent><name>related_product_checkbox/readonly</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        var selectedRelationshipGroup = api.item.parent.value;
        var currentRelatedProducts = selectedRelationshipGroup.related_product;
        let checkedCount = 0;
        if (api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory.value == "1" || !selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.is_editable) {
            return true;
        };
        for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
            if (currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked) checkedCount++;
            currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = false;
        }
        if (checkedCount >= +selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.max.value) {
            for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
                if (!currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked)
                    currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = true;
            }
        }else if (checkedCount <= +selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.min.value ) {
            for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
                if (currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked)
                    currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = true;
            }
        }
        if (api.item.value.attributes.is_disabled)
            return true;
        return !api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.is_editable;
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>527c1f74e9270b944699741a8f7d7473</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>related_product_checkbox/readonly</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_527c1f74e9270b944699741a8f7d7473</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:46</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes>c029403043d71210ea13912a1bb8f228,3d59c03043d71210ea13912a1bb8f2eb,6299f45143d35210ea13912a1bb8f221,4ef88cfc43971210ea13912a1bb8f26f,c0b44fea431bd210ea13912a1bb8f273,6e7407dd43231210ea13912a1bb8f2ab,69f913e143e71210ea13912a1bb8f2a5</includes><macroponent display_value="product-configuration default">c88c5b701163cf94b0e48eebb0942138</macroponent><name>Config Reducer</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "{0} clone created"
    },
    {
        "message": "{0} clones created"
    },
    {
        "message": "Configuration split"
    },
    {
        "message": "Configuration deleted"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
async function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    const {
        emit: dispatch,
        setState,
        state,
        context,
        data
    } = api;
    const {
        'sn_prd_pm.updateStatesUtil': updateStatesInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigUtil': productConfigUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigTransformsUtil': productConfigTransformsUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigProcessResponseUtil': productConfigProcessResponseUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.constantsUtil': constantsUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.currentSelectionUtil': currentSelectionUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.attributeAdjustmentUtil': attributeAdjustmentUtilInclude
    } = imports;

    const {
        name,
        payload
    } = event;

    const {
        setStates
    } = updateStatesInclude();

    const {
        createCurrentSelection,
        updatePricesInCurrentSelection
    } = currentSelectionUtilInclude();

    const {
        configLoaded,
        userActionProductSelection,
        productHierarchyModified,
        userActionCharSelection,
        prepareConfigInstanceForPricing,
        parentQuantityUpdated,
        userActionProductQuantityChange,
        hideErrorContainer,
        updateMultiInstance,
        summaryActionClicked,
        resetConfigInstance,
        prepareConfigInstanceForOpenStatePricing,
        debounce,
        debounceCurrentAppState,
        updateObjectCharValueInConfigInstance,
        navigateToSelectedObjectChar,
        setSelectedObjectCharNode,
        addOrRemoveInstances,
        getTargetNodeRecursive
    } = productConfigUtilInclude();

    const {
        initiateConfigRulesStateCall,
        initiatePricingCall,
        initiateCurrencyCall,
        getNewInstanceComplexCharDb
    } = productConfigTransformsUtilInclude();

    const {
        receiveOpenStateResponse,
        receivePricingResponse,
        recieveCurrencyCallResponse,
        receiveValidationResponse
    } = productConfigProcessResponseUtilInclude();

    const {
        createAttributeAdjustments,
        updateAttributeAdjustments
    } = attributeAdjustmentUtilInclude();

    const {
        STATE_PROPS: {
            CONFIG_INSTANCE,
            CONFIG_SETTINGS,
            CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE,
            PRODUCT_HIERARCHY,
            CURRENT_APP_STATE,
            MODIFIED_NODES,
            PRICING_INSTANCE,
            PRICING_RESPONSE,
            SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC,
            SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC,
            COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED,
            ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD,
            SKIP_PRICING
            
        },
        APP_STATES: {
            ARRAY_CHAR_INSTANCE_CHANGED,
            INITIAL_CONFIG_DATA_LOADED,
            ON_LOAD_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_MODIFIED,
            HIERARCHY_PRICING_INITIATED,
            HIERARCHY_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHANGE_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_CHANGE_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            ON_LOAD_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_LOAD_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHAR_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHAR_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED,
            OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED
        }
    } = constantsUtilInclude();
    let outputValue = {};
    let value = {
        configInstance: null,
        currentSelectionInstance: null,
        currentAppState: null,
        productHierarchy: null
    };
   
    const currentPayload = payload.payload;
    const additionalPayload = payload.additionalPayload;
    if(!payload.eventName)
        payload.eventName = name;        
    switch (payload.eventName) {
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CONFIG_LOADED':
            var configInstance = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            if (Object.keys(configInstance).length > 0) resetConfigInstance(api);
            else {
                value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
                value[CONFIG_SETTINGS] = currentPayload.configSettings;
                value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = createCurrentSelection(api, value);
                value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE]['parentQuantity'] = currentPayload.configInstance.product.attributes.quantity.value;
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = {
                    selectedProductDetails: {
                        selectedProductId: currentPayload.configInstance.product.id,
                        selectedProductPath: currentPayload.configInstance.product.path
                    },
                    appState: INITIAL_CONFIG_DATA_LOADED,
                    errorState: {}
                };
                const defaultSelectedProduct = [];
                defaultSelectedProduct.push(currentPayload.configInstance.product.id);
                value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = {
                    hierarchy: currentPayload.productHierarchy,
                    selectedItems: [defaultSelectedProduct],
                    expandedItems: [defaultSelectedProduct]
                };
                configLoaded(api, value);
            }
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails = {
                selectedProductId: currentPayload.id,
                selectedProductPath: currentPayload.path,
                isCharacteristicNode: currentPayload.is_char,
                isCharacteristicGroup: currentPayload.is_char_group
            };
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_MODIFIED;
            await productHierarchyModified(api, helpers, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION#SUMMARY_ACTION_INITIATED':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = payload.eventName;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = payload.payload.currentSelectionInstance;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            await userActionProductSelection(api, value, {
                payload: currentPayload,
                modifiedValue: additionalPayload
            }, helpers);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CHAR_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : userActionCharSelection,
                value : value,
                payload : {
                    currentPayload: currentPayload,
                    additionalPayload: additionalPayload
                    }});
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRICING_INITIATED':
            value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentPayload));
            value[PRICING_INSTANCE] = [prepareConfigInstanceForPricing(api, value)];
            initiatePricingCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRICING_SUCEEDED':
            value[PRICING_RESPONSE] = currentPayload.output;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_LOAD_PRICING_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == HIERARCHY_PRICING_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = HIERARCHY_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED) {
                await createAttributeAdjustments(api, value, helpers);
            } else {
                if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState != ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED)
                    value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHANGE_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
                await updateAttributeAdjustments(api, value, helpers);
            }
            updatePricesInCurrentSelection(api, value);
            receivePricingResponse(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_INITIATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = currentPayload.currentAppState;
            value[MODIFIED_NODES] = currentPayload.modifiedNodes;
            value[COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED] = currentPayload[COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED];
            initiateConfigRulesStateCall(api, value, additionalPayload);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            let prodHrchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            let selectedObjChar = api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] ? api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] : api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC];
            const selectedNodeId = prodHrchy.selectedItems[0][prodHrchy.selectedItems[0].length - 1];
            const targetNode = getTargetNodeRecursive(selectedNodeId, prodHrchy.hierarchy[0], [], true);
            const skipPricing = (selectedObjChar && selectedObjChar.path == targetNode.path) 
                || value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ARRAY_CHAR_INSTANCE_CHANGED;
            if(!skipPricing)
                debounceCurrentAppState({api: api, value: value, helpers: helpers, timeout: 0, appState: ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED});
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED;
            await receiveOpenStateResponse(api, value, currentPayload.output, skipPricing, helpers);
            if(selectedObjChar && selectedObjChar.path == targetNode.path) {
                value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                    selectedProductPath: selectedObjChar.path
                };
                setSelectedObjectCharNode(api, value);
            }
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#VALIDATION_SUCEEDED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.output;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            if(value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_CHAR_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHAR_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED;
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED;
            if(!api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                value[SKIP_PRICING] = false;
            else value[SKIP_PRICING] = true;
            receiveValidationResponse(api,value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CURRENCY_FORMAT_REQUESTED':
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.currentSelectionInstance;
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
            initiateCurrencyCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CURRENCY_FORMAT_REQUEST_SUCEEDED':
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.output;
            recieveCurrencyCallResponse(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PARENT_QUANTITY_UPDATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : parentQuantityUpdated,
                value : value,
                payload : currentPayload });
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_QUANTITY_UPDATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : await userActionProductQuantityChange,
                value : value,
                payload : {
                    quantity: currentPayload,
                    productPath: additionalPayload.productPath,
                    productInstanceQtyUpdate: additionalPayload.productInstanceQtyUpdate
                }});
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#HIDE_ERROR_CONTAINER':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            hideErrorContainer(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#SUMMARY_ACTION_DISPATCH':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.action = payload.payload.action;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.selectedProductPath = payload.payload.sourcePath;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.numberOfInstances = payload.payload.numberOfInstance;
            await summaryActionClicked(api, helpers, value);
            let content;
            if (payload.payload.action == 'cloneInitiated') {
                const numberOfClones = payload.payload.numberOfInstance;
                if (String(numberOfClones) === '1') {
                    content = await helpers.translate('{0} clone created', numberOfClones);
                } else {
                    content = await helpers.translate('{0} clones created', numberOfClones);
                }
            } else if (payload.payload.action == 'splitInitiated') {
                content = await helpers.translate('Configuration split');
            } else {
                content = await helpers.translate('Configuration deleted');
            }
            api.emit("NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS", {
                items: [{
                    id: "summaryInfo",
                    status: "positive",
                    icon: "info-circle-outline",
                    content: content,
                    action: {
                        type: "dismiss",
                    }
                }]
            });
            helpers.timing.setTimeout(()=> {
            api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#CLEAR_NOTIFICATIONS');
        }, 3000);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED;
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED;
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRICING_INSTANCE] = prepareConfigInstanceForOpenStatePricing(currentPayload, value);
            initiatePricingCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OBJECT_CHAR_VALUE_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                modifiedChar: payload.modifiedChar,
                selectedCharOption: payload.selectedCharOption
            };
            updateObjectCharValueInConfigInstance(api, value);
            break;
        case "OBJECT_CHARACTERISTIC_EDIT_BTN_CLICKED":
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                selectedObjectChar: payload.objectChar,
                parentChar: payload.parentChar
            };
            navigateToSelectedObjectChar(api, value);
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                selectedProductPath: payload.objectChar.path
            };
            setSelectedObjectCharNode(api, value);
            break;
        case "CONTENT_TREE_SELECTED_ITEMS_SET":
            let prodHierarchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            prodHierarchy.selectedItems = payload.nodes;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = prodHierarchy;
            setState(api, value);
            break;
        case "CONTENT_TREE_EXPANDED_ITEMS_SET":
            let prdHierarchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            prdHierarchy.expandedItems = payload.nodes;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = prdHierarchy;
            setState(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_ADD_MORE_INITIATED":
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: payload.parentChar
            };
            getNewInstanceComplexCharDb(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_ADD_MORE":
            let selectedChar;
            if(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedChar = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            else if(!api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedChar = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            let configInst = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            let hierarchy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY]));
            value[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] = selectedChar;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = configInst;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = hierarchy;
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: currentPayload.output.parentChar,
                newInstanceData: currentPayload.output.data
            };
            addOrRemoveInstances(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_DELETE_CLICKED":
            let selectedCharc;
            if(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedCharc = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            else if(!api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedCharc = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            let configInst2 = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            let hierarchy2 = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY]));
            value[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] = selectedCharc;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = configInst2;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = hierarchy2;
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: payload.parentChar,
                charToRemove: payload.charToRemove
            };
            addOrRemoveInstances(api, value);
    }

}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>748c9b701163cf94b0e48eebb09421d2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Config Reducer</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_748c9b701163cf94b0e48eebb09421d2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:56</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        let msg;
        if (api.item.value.attributes.name.value == "Bundled Products" || api.item.value.attributes.name.value == "Optional Products") {
            msg = "";

                msg = helpers.translateSync('Select a minimum of {0} options', [min]);
            else
                msg = helpers.translateSync('Select a minimum of {0} options and a maximum of {1} options', [min, max]);
        }
        return msg;
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>f08cdb701163cf94b0e48eebb0942108</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>rel_grp_info_msg/text</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_f08cdb701163cf94b0e48eebb0942108</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:56</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
