<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product catalog view default">497c1774e9270b944699741a8f7d74ef</macroponent><name>On context form initialized</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    const formFields = api.data.record.form.fields;
    let contextValues = {};
    for(const key in formFields) {
        if(formFields[key].value)
            contextValues[key] = {
                field: key,
                value: formFields[key].value
            };
    }
    let contextFilterChanges = {};
    contextFilterChanges["contextFields"] = contextValues;
    contextFilterChanges["entity"] = api.state.lineContext.table;
    api.setState("contextFilterChanges", contextFilterChanges);
    const data = api.state.requestEntityDetails;
    if (api.context.props.entityDetails.recommendation) {
        api.setState('showSearch', false);
        return;
    }
    api.setState('showSearch', true);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState('selectedCategory', 'showAll');
    api.setState('categorySelected', [
        ["showAll"]
    ]);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    let cdbInput = {
        count: 0,
        pageIndex: 0,
        selectedCategory: "showAll",
        transactionInput: data.transactionInput,
        transactionType: data.transactionType,
        account: data.account,
        catalogType: data.catalogType,
        suppressPricing: data.suppressPricing,
        inputEntityDetails: data.inputEntityDetails,
        contextFilterChanges: contextFilterChanges,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy
    };
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>d97c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d74a3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>On context form initialized</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_d97c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d74a3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.state.configSettings['readonly']) return false;
    const data = api.item.value.characteristic_value.value;
    if (api.context.props.entityDetails['settings'] && api.context.props.entityDetails.settings['selectAllProductOptions'])

    if (!data && isMandatory != '0')
        return true;
    return false;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:51:02</sys_created_on><sys_id>d28c9b7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8dee</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>char_single_line_text/invalid</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_d28c9b7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8dee</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:51:02</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    
    if (api.item.value) {
        const charOptions = api.item.value.characteristic_options;
        const checkedCount = charOptions.filter(item => item.checked).length;
        const isCharMandatory = api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory && api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory.value === '1';
        return charOptions
            .filter(option => option.is_visible)
            .map(option => ({
                id: option.sys_id.value,
                label: option.label,
                disabled: !option.is_editable ||
                    (isCharMandatory &&
                        checkedCount === 1 &&
                        option.checked)
            }));
    }

}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:48</sys_created_on><sys_id>be7c5f74e9270b944699741a8f7d74ad</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>characteristic_dropdown/items</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_be7c5f74e9270b944699741a8f7d74ad</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:48</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

            parentSysId: api.context.props.entityDetails.headerId,

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Order Management Default copy">766c977010ef4b144699cdb60f0cc967</macroponent><name>clnbigwuiiaabbkaddbhhsntddzasjo/repeatWith</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    var arr = api.data.record.relatedLists;
    if (api?.data?.record?.form?.fields?.state?.value == 'draft') {
        var filteredArray = arr.filter(item => item.table != 'sn_ind_tmt_orm_order_task');
        return filteredArray;
    }
    return arr;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:32</sys_created_on><sys_id>cf6c5b7010ef4b144699cdb60f0cc93c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>clnbigwuiiaabbkaddbhhsntddzasjo/repeatWith</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_cf6c5b7010ef4b144699cdb60f0cc93c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:32</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>308c9b701163cf94b0e48eebb09421c8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>stylized_text_3/text</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_308c9b701163cf94b0e48eebb09421c8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:56</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    let ruleEngineError = api.state.configInstance.rule_engine_error;
    let currentAppState = api.state.currentAppState;
    let hasRuleEngineError = ruleEngineError && ruleEngineError != ""; 
    var onLoadAppState = ["onLoadPricingInitiated", "onChangePricingInitiated", "onLoadOpenStateInitiated", "onCharChangeOpenStateInitiated", "onProductChangeOpenStateInitiated"];
    let appInProcessingState = onLoadAppState.indexOf(currentAppState.appState) > -1;
    let productQtyInvalid = currentAppState['errorState'] && currentAppState['errorState']['productQtyInvalidMap'] ? Object.keys(currentAppState['errorState']['productQtyInvalidMap']).length > 0 : false;
    return hasRuleEngineError || appInProcessingState || productQtyInvalid;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>067c5b74e9270b944699741a8f7d74b5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>add_update_portal/disabled</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_067c5b74e9270b944699741a8f7d74b5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:45</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes>c029403043d71210ea13912a1bb8f228,3d59c03043d71210ea13912a1bb8f2eb,6299f45143d35210ea13912a1bb8f221,4ef88cfc43971210ea13912a1bb8f26f,c0b44fea431bd210ea13912a1bb8f273,6e7407dd43231210ea13912a1bb8f2ab,69f913e143e71210ea13912a1bb8f2a5</includes><macroponent display_value="Product Config Default">3d8c5b7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8dd5</macroponent><name>Config Reducer</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "{0} clone created"
    },
    {
        "message": "{0} clones created"
    },
    {
        "message": "Configuration split"
    },
    {
        "message": "Configuration deleted"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
async function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    const {
        emit: dispatch,
        setState,
        state,
        context,
        data
    } = api;
    const {
        'sn_prd_pm.updateStatesUtil': updateStatesInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigUtil': productConfigUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigTransformsUtil': productConfigTransformsUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigProcessResponseUtil': productConfigProcessResponseUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.constantsUtil': constantsUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.currentSelectionUtil': currentSelectionUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.attributeAdjustmentUtil': attributeAdjustmentUtilInclude
    } = imports;

    const {
        name,
        payload
    } = event;

    const {
        setStates
    } = updateStatesInclude();

    const {
        createCurrentSelection,
        updatePricesInCurrentSelection
    } = currentSelectionUtilInclude();

    const {
        configLoaded,
        userActionProductSelection,
        productHierarchyModified,
        userActionCharSelection,
        prepareConfigInstanceForPricing,
        parentQuantityUpdated,
        userActionProductQuantityChange,
        hideErrorContainer,
        updateMultiInstance,
        summaryActionClicked,
        resetConfigInstance,
        prepareConfigInstanceForOpenStatePricing,
        debounce,
        debounceCurrentAppState,
        updateObjectCharValueInConfigInstance,
        navigateToSelectedObjectChar,
        setSelectedObjectCharNode,
        addOrRemoveInstances,
        getTargetNodeRecursive
    } = productConfigUtilInclude();

    const {
        initiateConfigRulesStateCall,
        initiatePricingCall,
        initiateCurrencyCall,
        getNewInstanceComplexCharDb
    } = productConfigTransformsUtilInclude();

    const {
        receiveOpenStateResponse,
        receivePricingResponse,
        recieveCurrencyCallResponse,
        receiveValidationResponse
    } = productConfigProcessResponseUtilInclude();

    const {
        createAttributeAdjustments,
        updateAttributeAdjustments
    } = attributeAdjustmentUtilInclude();

    const {
        STATE_PROPS: {
            CONFIG_INSTANCE,
            CONFIG_SETTINGS,
            CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE,
            PRODUCT_HIERARCHY,
            CURRENT_APP_STATE,
            MODIFIED_NODES,
            PRICING_INSTANCE,
            PRICING_RESPONSE,
            SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC,
            SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC,
            COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED,
            ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD,
            SKIP_PRICING
            
        },
        APP_STATES: {
            ARRAY_CHAR_INSTANCE_CHANGED,
            INITIAL_CONFIG_DATA_LOADED,
            ON_LOAD_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_MODIFIED,
            HIERARCHY_PRICING_INITIATED,
            HIERARCHY_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHANGE_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_CHANGE_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            ON_LOAD_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_LOAD_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHAR_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHAR_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED,
            OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED
        }
    } = constantsUtilInclude();
    let outputValue = {};
    let value = {
        configInstance: null,
        currentSelectionInstance: null,
        currentAppState: null,
        productHierarchy: null
    };
   
    const currentPayload = payload.payload;
    const additionalPayload = payload.additionalPayload;
    if(!payload.eventName)
        payload.eventName = name;        
    switch (payload.eventName) {
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CONFIG_LOADED':
            var configInstance = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            if (Object.keys(configInstance).length > 0) resetConfigInstance(api);
            else {
                value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
                value[CONFIG_SETTINGS] = currentPayload.configSettings;
                value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = createCurrentSelection(api, value);
                value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE]['parentQuantity'] = currentPayload.configInstance.product.attributes.quantity.value;
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = {
                    selectedProductDetails: {
                        selectedProductId: currentPayload.configInstance.product.id,
                        selectedProductPath: currentPayload.configInstance.product.path
                    },
                    appState: INITIAL_CONFIG_DATA_LOADED,
                    errorState: {}
                };
                const defaultSelectedProduct = [];
                defaultSelectedProduct.push(currentPayload.configInstance.product.id);
                value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = {
                    hierarchy: currentPayload.productHierarchy,
                    selectedItems: [defaultSelectedProduct],
                    expandedItems: [defaultSelectedProduct]
                };
                configLoaded(api, value);
            }
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails = {
                selectedProductId: currentPayload.id,
                selectedProductPath: currentPayload.path,
                isCharacteristicNode: currentPayload.is_char,
                isCharacteristicGroup: currentPayload.is_char_group
            };
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_MODIFIED;
            await productHierarchyModified(api, helpers, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION#SUMMARY_ACTION_INITIATED':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = payload.eventName;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = payload.payload.currentSelectionInstance;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            await userActionProductSelection(api, value, {
                payload: currentPayload,
                modifiedValue: additionalPayload
            }, helpers);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CHAR_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : userActionCharSelection,
                value : value,
                payload : {
                    currentPayload: currentPayload,
                    additionalPayload: additionalPayload
                    }});
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRICING_INITIATED':
            value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentPayload));
            value[PRICING_INSTANCE] = [prepareConfigInstanceForPricing(api, value)];
            initiatePricingCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRICING_SUCEEDED':
            value[PRICING_RESPONSE] = currentPayload.output;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_LOAD_PRICING_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == HIERARCHY_PRICING_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = HIERARCHY_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED) {
                await createAttributeAdjustments(api, value, helpers);
            } else {
                if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState != ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED)
                    value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHANGE_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
                await updateAttributeAdjustments(api, value, helpers);
            }
            updatePricesInCurrentSelection(api, value);
            receivePricingResponse(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_INITIATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = currentPayload.currentAppState;
            value[MODIFIED_NODES] = currentPayload.modifiedNodes;
            value[COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED] = currentPayload[COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED];
            initiateConfigRulesStateCall(api, value, additionalPayload);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            let prodHrchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            let selectedObjChar = api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] ? api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] : api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC];
            const selectedNodeId = prodHrchy.selectedItems[0][prodHrchy.selectedItems[0].length - 1];
            const targetNode = getTargetNodeRecursive(selectedNodeId, prodHrchy.hierarchy[0], [], true);
            const skipPricing = (selectedObjChar && selectedObjChar.path == targetNode.path) 
                || value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ARRAY_CHAR_INSTANCE_CHANGED;
            if(!skipPricing)
                debounceCurrentAppState({api: api, value: value, helpers: helpers, timeout: 0, appState: ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED});
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED;
            await receiveOpenStateResponse(api, value, currentPayload.output, skipPricing, helpers);
            if(selectedObjChar && selectedObjChar.path == targetNode.path) {
                value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                    selectedProductPath: selectedObjChar.path
                };
                setSelectedObjectCharNode(api, value);
            }
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#VALIDATION_SUCEEDED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.output;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            if(value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_CHAR_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHAR_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED;
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED;
            if(!api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                value[SKIP_PRICING] = false;
            else value[SKIP_PRICING] = true;
            receiveValidationResponse(api,value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CURRENCY_FORMAT_REQUESTED':
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.currentSelectionInstance;
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
            initiateCurrencyCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CURRENCY_FORMAT_REQUEST_SUCEEDED':
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.output;
            recieveCurrencyCallResponse(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PARENT_QUANTITY_UPDATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : parentQuantityUpdated,
                value : value,
                payload : currentPayload });
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_QUANTITY_UPDATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : await userActionProductQuantityChange,
                value : value,
                payload : {
                    quantity: currentPayload,
                    productPath: additionalPayload.productPath,
                    productInstanceQtyUpdate: additionalPayload.productInstanceQtyUpdate
                }});
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#HIDE_ERROR_CONTAINER':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            hideErrorContainer(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#SUMMARY_ACTION_DISPATCH':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.action = payload.payload.action;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.selectedProductPath = payload.payload.sourcePath;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.numberOfInstances = payload.payload.numberOfInstance;
            await summaryActionClicked(api, helpers, value);
            let content;
            if (payload.payload.action == 'cloneInitiated') {
                const numberOfClones = payload.payload.numberOfInstance;
                if (String(numberOfClones) === '1') {
                    content = await helpers.translate('{0} clone created', numberOfClones);
                } else {
                    content = await helpers.translate('{0} clones created', numberOfClones);
                }
            } else if (payload.payload.action == 'splitInitiated') {
                content = await helpers.translate('Configuration split');
            } else {
                content = await helpers.translate('Configuration deleted');
            }
            api.emit("NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS", {
                items: [{
                    id: "summaryInfo",
                    status: "positive",
                    icon: "info-circle-outline",
                    content: content,
                    action: {
                        type: "dismiss",
                    }
                }]
            });
            helpers.timing.setTimeout(()=> {
            api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#CLEAR_NOTIFICATIONS');
        }, 3000);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED;
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED;
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRICING_INSTANCE] = prepareConfigInstanceForOpenStatePricing(currentPayload, value);
            initiatePricingCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OBJECT_CHAR_VALUE_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                modifiedChar: payload.modifiedChar,
                selectedCharOption: payload.selectedCharOption
            };
            updateObjectCharValueInConfigInstance(api, value);
            break;
        case "OBJECT_CHARACTERISTIC_EDIT_BTN_CLICKED":
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                selectedObjectChar: payload.objectChar,
                parentChar: payload.parentChar
            };
            navigateToSelectedObjectChar(api, value);
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                selectedProductPath: payload.objectChar.path
            };
            setSelectedObjectCharNode(api, value);
            break;
        case "CONTENT_TREE_SELECTED_ITEMS_SET":
            let prodHierarchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            prodHierarchy.selectedItems = payload.nodes;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = prodHierarchy;
            setState(api, value);
            break;
        case "CONTENT_TREE_EXPANDED_ITEMS_SET":
            let prdHierarchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            prdHierarchy.expandedItems = payload.nodes;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = prdHierarchy;
            setState(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_ADD_MORE_INITIATED":
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: payload.parentChar
            };
            getNewInstanceComplexCharDb(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_ADD_MORE":
            let selectedChar;
            if(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedChar = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            else if(!api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedChar = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            let configInst = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            let hierarchy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY]));
            value[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] = selectedChar;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = configInst;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = hierarchy;
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: currentPayload.output.parentChar,
                newInstanceData: currentPayload.output.data
            };
            addOrRemoveInstances(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_DELETE_CLICKED":
            let selectedCharc;
            if(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedCharc = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            else if(!api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedCharc = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            let configInst2 = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            let hierarchy2 = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY]));
            value[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] = selectedCharc;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = configInst2;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = hierarchy2;
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: payload.parentChar,
                charToRemove: payload.charToRemove
            };
            addOrRemoveInstances(api, value);
    }

}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:51:03</sys_created_on><sys_id>268cdb7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8dc6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Config Reducer</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_268cdb7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8dc6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:51:03</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Order Line Char Config default">317c1b74e9270b944699741a8f7d7437</macroponent><name>add_update_button/disabled</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    let ruleEngineError = api.state.configInstance.rule_engine_error;
    let currentAppState = api.state.currentAppState;
    let hasRuleEngineError = ruleEngineError && ruleEngineError != "";
    var onLoadAppState = ["onLoadPricingInitiated", "hierarchyPricingInitiated", "onChangePricingInitiated", "onLoadOpenStateInitiated", "onCharChangeOpenStateInitiated", "onProductChangeOpenStateInitiated", "openStatePricingInitiated"];
    let appInProcessingState = onLoadAppState.indexOf(currentAppState.appState) > -1;
    let productQtyInvalid = currentAppState['errorState'] && currentAppState['errorState']['productQtyInvalidMap'] ? Object.keys(currentAppState['errorState']['productQtyInvalidMap']).length > 0 : false;
    return hasRuleEngineError || appInProcessingState || productQtyInvalid;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:48</sys_created_on><sys_id>367c9f74e9270b944699741a8f7d7434</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>add_update_button/disabled</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_367c9f74e9270b944699741a8f7d7434</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:48</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product catalog view default">497c1774e9270b944699741a8f7d74ef</macroponent><name>Update Product Offerings</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    if (event.payload.item.id == api.state.selectedCategory)
        return;
    api.setState("showSearch", true);
    api.setState('productSelectionSelected', [
        []
    ]);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState("resultsFound", true);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    api.setState("leafCategoryList", null);
    api.setState('pageIndex', 0);
    const selectedCategory = event.payload.item.id;
    const selectedCatalog = api.state.selectedCatalog;
    let cdbInput = {
        count: 0,
        searchTerm: api.state.searchTerm,
        pageIndex: 0,
        transactionInput: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionInput,
        inputEntityDetails: api.state.requestEntityDetails.inputEntityDetails,
        catalogType: "PRODUCT_OFFERING",
        contextFilterChanges: api.state.contextFilterChanges,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy,
        aiSearchSuggestionId: api.state.aiSearchSuggestionId
    };
    if (selectedCatalog == 'allCatalog') {
        api.setState('selectedCatalog', selectedCategory);
        api.setState('selectedCategory', "showAll");
        api.setState('selectedCatalogHierarchy', null);
        api.setState('categorySelected', [
            ["showAll"]
        ]);
        cdbInput.selectedCatalog = selectedCategory;
        cdbInput.selectedCategory = "showAll";
    } else {
        api.setState('selectedCategory', selectedCategory);
        cdbInput.selectedCatalog = selectedCatalog;
        cdbInput.selectedCategory = selectedCategory;
        cdbInput.selectedCatalogHierarchy = api.state.selectedCatalogHierarchy;
    }
    let requestEntityDetails = api.state.requestEntityDetails;
    requestEntityDetails.catalogType = "PRODUCT_OFFERING";
    api.setState("requestEntityDetails", requestEntityDetails);
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>057c5774e9270b944699741a8f7d7443</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update Product Offerings</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_057c5774e9270b944699741a8f7d7443</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:41</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes>c029403043d71210ea13912a1bb8f228,3d59c03043d71210ea13912a1bb8f2eb,6299f45143d35210ea13912a1bb8f221,4ef88cfc43971210ea13912a1bb8f26f,c0b44fea431bd210ea13912a1bb8f273,6e7407dd43231210ea13912a1bb8f2ab,69f913e143e71210ea13912a1bb8f2a5</includes><macroponent display_value="Order Line Char Config default">317c1b74e9270b944699741a8f7d7437</macroponent><name>Config Reducer</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "{0} clone created"
    },
    {
        "message": "{0} clones created"
    },
    {
        "message": "Configuration split"
    },
    {
        "message": "Configuration deleted"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
async function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    const {
        emit: dispatch,
        setState,
        state,
        context,
        data
    } = api;
    const {
        'sn_prd_pm.updateStatesUtil': updateStatesInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigUtil': productConfigUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigTransformsUtil': productConfigTransformsUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.productConfigProcessResponseUtil': productConfigProcessResponseUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.constantsUtil': constantsUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.currentSelectionUtil': currentSelectionUtilInclude,
        'sn_prd_pm.attributeAdjustmentUtil': attributeAdjustmentUtilInclude
    } = imports;

    const {
        name,
        payload
    } = event;

    const {
        setStates
    } = updateStatesInclude();

    const {
        createCurrentSelection,
        updatePricesInCurrentSelection
    } = currentSelectionUtilInclude();

    const {
        configLoaded,
        userActionProductSelection,
        productHierarchyModified,
        userActionCharSelection,
        prepareConfigInstanceForPricing,
        parentQuantityUpdated,
        userActionProductQuantityChange,
        hideErrorContainer,
        updateMultiInstance,
        summaryActionClicked,
        resetConfigInstance,
        prepareConfigInstanceForOpenStatePricing,
        debounce,
        debounceCurrentAppState,
        updateObjectCharValueInConfigInstance,
        navigateToSelectedObjectChar,
        setSelectedObjectCharNode,
        addOrRemoveInstances,
        getTargetNodeRecursive
    } = productConfigUtilInclude();

    const {
        initiateConfigRulesStateCall,
        initiatePricingCall,
        initiateCurrencyCall,
        getNewInstanceComplexCharDb
    } = productConfigTransformsUtilInclude();

    const {
        receiveOpenStateResponse,
        receivePricingResponse,
        recieveCurrencyCallResponse,
        receiveValidationResponse
    } = productConfigProcessResponseUtilInclude();

    const {
        createAttributeAdjustments,
        updateAttributeAdjustments
    } = attributeAdjustmentUtilInclude();

    const {
        STATE_PROPS: {
            CONFIG_INSTANCE,
            CONFIG_SETTINGS,
            CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE,
            PRODUCT_HIERARCHY,
            CURRENT_APP_STATE,
            MODIFIED_NODES,
            PRICING_INSTANCE,
            PRICING_RESPONSE,
            SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC,
            SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC,
            COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED,
            ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD,
            SKIP_PRICING
            
        },
        APP_STATES: {
            ARRAY_CHAR_INSTANCE_CHANGED,
            INITIAL_CONFIG_DATA_LOADED,
            ON_LOAD_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_MODIFIED,
            HIERARCHY_PRICING_INITIATED,
            HIERARCHY_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHANGE_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_CHANGE_PRICING_SUCEEDED,
            ON_LOAD_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_LOAD_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHAR_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED,
            ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED,
            ON_CHAR_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED,
            OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_INITIATED,
            ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED
        }
    } = constantsUtilInclude();
    let outputValue = {};
    let value = {
        configInstance: null,
        currentSelectionInstance: null,
        currentAppState: null,
        productHierarchy: null
    };
   
    const currentPayload = payload.payload;
    const additionalPayload = payload.additionalPayload;
    if(!payload.eventName)
        payload.eventName = name;        
    switch (payload.eventName) {
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CONFIG_LOADED':
            var configInstance = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            if (Object.keys(configInstance).length > 0) resetConfigInstance(api);
            else {
                value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
                value[CONFIG_SETTINGS] = currentPayload.configSettings;
                value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = createCurrentSelection(api, value);
                value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE]['parentQuantity'] = currentPayload.configInstance.product.attributes.quantity.value;
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = {
                    selectedProductDetails: {
                        selectedProductId: currentPayload.configInstance.product.id,
                        selectedProductPath: currentPayload.configInstance.product.path
                    },
                    appState: INITIAL_CONFIG_DATA_LOADED,
                    errorState: {}
                };
                const defaultSelectedProduct = [];
                defaultSelectedProduct.push(currentPayload.configInstance.product.id);
                value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = {
                    hierarchy: currentPayload.productHierarchy,
                    selectedItems: [defaultSelectedProduct],
                    expandedItems: [defaultSelectedProduct]
                };
                configLoaded(api, value);
            }
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails = {
                selectedProductId: currentPayload.id,
                selectedProductPath: currentPayload.path,
                isCharacteristicNode: currentPayload.is_char,
                isCharacteristicGroup: currentPayload.is_char_group
            };
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = PRODUCT_HIERARCHY_MODIFIED;
            await productHierarchyModified(api, helpers, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION#SUMMARY_ACTION_INITIATED':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = payload.eventName;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = payload.payload.currentSelectionInstance;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            await userActionProductSelection(api, value, {
                payload: currentPayload,
                modifiedValue: additionalPayload
            }, helpers);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CHAR_SELECTION_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : userActionCharSelection,
                value : value,
                payload : {
                    currentPayload: currentPayload,
                    additionalPayload: additionalPayload
                    }});
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRICING_INITIATED':
            value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentPayload));
            value[PRICING_INSTANCE] = [prepareConfigInstanceForPricing(api, value)];
            initiatePricingCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRICING_SUCEEDED':
            value[PRICING_RESPONSE] = currentPayload.output;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_LOAD_PRICING_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == HIERARCHY_PRICING_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = HIERARCHY_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_LOAD_PRICING_SUCEEDED) {
                await createAttributeAdjustments(api, value, helpers);
            } else {
                if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState != ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED)
                    value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHANGE_PRICING_SUCEEDED;
                await updateAttributeAdjustments(api, value, helpers);
            }
            updatePricesInCurrentSelection(api, value);
            receivePricingResponse(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_INITIATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = currentPayload.currentAppState;
            value[MODIFIED_NODES] = currentPayload.modifiedNodes;
            value[COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED] = currentPayload[COMPLEX_CHAR_CHANGED];
            initiateConfigRulesStateCall(api, value, additionalPayload);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            let prodHrchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            let selectedObjChar = api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] ? api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] : api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC];
            const selectedNodeId = prodHrchy.selectedItems[0][prodHrchy.selectedItems[0].length - 1];
            const targetNode = getTargetNodeRecursive(selectedNodeId, prodHrchy.hierarchy[0], [], true);
            const skipPricing = (selectedObjChar && selectedObjChar.path == targetNode.path) 
                || value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ARRAY_CHAR_INSTANCE_CHANGED;
            if(!skipPricing)
                debounceCurrentAppState({api: api, value: value, helpers: helpers, timeout: 0, appState: ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED});
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_SUCEEDED;
            await receiveOpenStateResponse(api, value, currentPayload.output, skipPricing, helpers);
            if(selectedObjChar && selectedObjChar.path == targetNode.path) {
                value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                    selectedProductPath: selectedObjChar.path
                };
                setSelectedObjectCharNode(api, value);
            }
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#VALIDATION_SUCEEDED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.output;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            if(value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_CHAR_CHANGE_OPEN_STATE_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_CHAR_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED;
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_INITIATED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED;
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_VALIDATION_SUCEEDED;
            if(!api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                value[SKIP_PRICING] = false;
            else value[SKIP_PRICING] = true;
            receiveValidationResponse(api,value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CURRENCY_FORMAT_REQUESTED':
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.currentSelectionInstance;
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.configInstance;
            initiateCurrencyCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#CURRENCY_FORMAT_REQUEST_SUCEEDED':
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = currentPayload.output;
            recieveCurrencyCallResponse(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PARENT_QUANTITY_UPDATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : parentQuantityUpdated,
                value : value,
                payload : currentPayload });
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#PRODUCT_QUANTITY_UPDATED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            debounce({
                api : api,
                helpers : helpers,
                callback : await userActionProductQuantityChange,
                value : value,
                payload : {
                    quantity: currentPayload,
                    productPath: additionalPayload.productPath,
                    productInstanceQtyUpdate: additionalPayload.productInstanceQtyUpdate
                }});
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#HIDE_ERROR_CONTAINER':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            hideErrorContainer(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#SUMMARY_ACTION_DISPATCH':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.action = payload.payload.action;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.selectedProductPath = payload.payload.sourcePath;
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].selectedProductDetails.numberOfInstances = payload.payload.numberOfInstance;
            await summaryActionClicked(api, helpers, value);
            let content;
            if (payload.payload.action == 'cloneInitiated') {
                const numberOfClones = payload.payload.numberOfInstance;
                if (String(numberOfClones) === '1') {
                    content = await helpers.translate('{0} clone created', numberOfClones);
                } else {
                    content = await helpers.translate('{0} clones created', numberOfClones);
                }
            } else if (payload.payload.action == 'splitInitiated') {
                content = await helpers.translate('Configuration split');
            } else {
                content = await helpers.translate('Configuration deleted');
            }
            api.emit("NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS", {
                items: [{
                    id: "summaryInfo",
                    status: "positive",
                    icon: "info-circle-outline",
                    content: content,
                    action: {
                        type: "dismiss",
                    }
                }]
            });
            helpers.timing.setTimeout(()=> {
            api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#CLEAR_NOTIFICATIONS');
        }, 3000);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED':
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            if (value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState == ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED)
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = ON_PRODUCT_CHANGE_FOR_MULTI_INSTANCE_SUCEEDED;
            else
                value[CURRENT_APP_STATE].appState = OPEN_STATE_PRICING_INITIATED;
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[PRICING_INSTANCE] = prepareConfigInstanceForOpenStatePricing(currentPayload, value);
            initiatePricingCall(api, value);
            break;
        case 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIG#OBJECT_CHAR_VALUE_MODIFIED':
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                modifiedChar: payload.modifiedChar,
                selectedCharOption: payload.selectedCharOption
            };
            updateObjectCharValueInConfigInstance(api, value);
            break;
        case "OBJECT_CHARACTERISTIC_EDIT_BTN_CLICKED":
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                selectedObjectChar: payload.objectChar,
                parentChar: payload.parentChar
            };
            navigateToSelectedObjectChar(api, value);
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                selectedProductPath: payload.objectChar.path
            };
            setSelectedObjectCharNode(api, value);
            break;
        case "CONTENT_TREE_SELECTED_ITEMS_SET":
            let prodHierarchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            prodHierarchy.selectedItems = payload.nodes;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = prodHierarchy;
            setState(api, value);
            break;
        case "CONTENT_TREE_EXPANDED_ITEMS_SET":
            let prdHierarchy = api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY];
            prdHierarchy.expandedItems = payload.nodes;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = prdHierarchy;
            setState(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_ADD_MORE_INITIATED":
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: payload.parentChar
            };
            getNewInstanceComplexCharDb(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_ADD_MORE":
            let selectedChar;
            if(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedChar = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            else if(!api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedChar = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            let configInst = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            let hierarchy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY]));
            value[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] = selectedChar;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = configInst;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = hierarchy;
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: currentPayload.output.parentChar,
                newInstanceData: currentPayload.output.data
            };
            addOrRemoveInstances(api, value);
            break;
        case "ARRAY_CHAR_DELETE_CLICKED":
            let selectedCharc;
            if(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && !api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedCharc = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            else if(!api.state[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] && api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC])
                selectedCharc = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[SELECTED_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC]));
            let configInst2 = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[CONFIG_INSTANCE]));
            let hierarchy2 = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY]));
            value[SELECTED_ARRAY_OBJ_CHARACTERISTIC] = selectedCharc;
            value[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE] = api.state[CURRENT_SELECTION_INSTANCE];
            value[CURRENT_APP_STATE] = api.state[CURRENT_APP_STATE];
            value[CONFIG_INSTANCE] = configInst2;
            value[PRODUCT_HIERARCHY] = hierarchy2;
            value[ADDITIONAL_PAYLOAD] = {
                parentChar: payload.parentChar,
                charToRemove: payload.charToRemove
            };
            addOrRemoveInstances(api, value);
    }

}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>1e7cdb74e9270b944699741a8f7d74ba</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Config Reducer</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_1e7cdb74e9270b944699741a8f7d74ba</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:46</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-configuration default">c88c5b701163cf94b0e48eebb0942138</macroponent><name>date_time_picker_input/messages</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const obj = api.item.value;
    const errorMessage = obj.attributes.error_message;
    if (errorMessage && errorMessage.content) {
        let data = [{
            "icon": "circle-info-outline",
            "content": obj.attributes.error_message.content
        }];
        return data;
    }
    const infoMessage = obj.attributes.message;
    if (infoMessage && infoMessage.content) {
        let data = [{
            "icon": "circle-info-outline",
            "content": obj.attributes.message.content
        }];
        return data;
    }
    return []; 
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:55</sys_created_on><sys_id>2c8c9b701163cf94b0e48eebb094214c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>date_time_picker_input/messages</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_2c8c9b701163cf94b0e48eebb094214c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:55</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-configuration default">c88c5b701163cf94b0e48eebb0942138</macroponent><name>characteristic_radio_options/isHidden</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value.attributes) {
        if (api.item.value.attributes.input_type.value != "choice" && api.item.value.attributes.input_type.value != "yes_no") return true;
        else if (api.item.value.attributes.input_type.value == "choice" && api.item.value.attributes.choice_type.value == "dropdown") return true;
        else return !api.item.value.attributes.is_visible;
    }

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="product-configuration default">c88c5b701163cf94b0e48eebb0942138</macroponent><name>ConfigureProduct</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    let configInstance = api.state.configInstance;
    let tempConfigInstance = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(configInstance));
    let refreshId = parseInt(Math.ceil(Math.random() * Date.now()).toPrecision(16).toString().replace(".", ""));
    let escalationRefreshQueue = api.state.escalationRefreshQueue;
    escalationRefreshQueue.push(refreshId);
    api.setState('escalationRefreshQueue', escalationRefreshQueue);
    helpers.timing.setTimeout(() => {
        if (api.state.escalationRefreshQueue.length === 1) // Process only last request in queue
            api.emit('SN_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION#SEND_CONFIG_INSTANCE', {
                configInstance: tempConfigInstance
            });
        const index = escalationRefreshQueue.indexOf(refreshId);
        if (index > -1)
            escalationRefreshQueue.splice(index, 1); // Remove from queue
        api.setState('escalationRefreshQueue', escalationRefreshQueue);
    }, 1000);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:57</sys_created_on><sys_id>458cdb701163cf94b0e48eebb0942197</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ConfigureProduct</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_458cdb701163cf94b0e48eebb0942197</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:57</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    if (event.payload.value == api.state.pageIndex)
        return;
    api.setState('pageIndex', event.payload.value);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    let cdbInput = {
        count: api.state.totalCount,
        selectedLocation: api.state.selectedLocation ? api.state.selectedLocation[0] : "",
        searchTerm: api.state.searchTerm,
        pageIndex: event.payload.value,
        transactionInput: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionInput,
        catalogType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.catalogType,
        suppressPricing: api.state.requestEntityDetails.suppressPricing,
        recommendation: api.state.recommendation,
        selectedCatalog: api.state.selectedCatalog,
        selectedCategory: api.state.selectedCategory,
        selectedCatalogHierarchy: api.state.selectedCatalogHierarchy,
        leafCategoryList: api.state.leafCategoryList,
        transactionType: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionType,
        account: api.state.requestEntityDetails.account,
        inputEntityDetails: api.state.requestEntityDetails.inputEntityDetails,
        contextFilterChanges: api.state.contextFilterChanges,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy

    };
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>517c5774e9270b944699741a8f7d74d6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Pagination invoked</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_517c5774e9270b944699741a8f7d74d6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    let obj = Object.assign({}, api.state.itemQuantitySelected);
    let catalogData = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state.catalogData));
    const itemIndex = event.context.item.index;
    const inputQty = event.payload.fieldValue;
    const offeringSysId = event.payload.name;
    let parsedQty = parseInt(inputQty);
    if (isNaN(parsedQty) || parsedQty < 1) {
        obj[offeringSysId] = inputQty;
        catalogData[itemIndex].invalid.value = true;
    } else if (!isInputValid(inputQty)) {
        obj[offeringSysId] = inputQty;
        catalogData[itemIndex].invalid.value = true;
    } else {
        obj[offeringSysId] = parsedQty;
        catalogData[itemIndex].invalid.value = false;
    }
    api.setState('itemQuantitySelected', obj);
    api.setState("catalogData", catalogData);

    function isInputValid(inputQty) {
        const pattern = /^\+{0,1}[0]{0,1}[1-9]{1}[0-9]{0,}$/g;
        return pattern.test(inputQty);
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>9d7c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d74bd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update quantity</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_9d7c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d74bd</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product catalog view default">497c1774e9270b944699741a8f7d74ef</macroponent><name>Update Catalog Hierarchy</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    if (event.payload.item.id == api.state.selectedCatalog)
        return;
    const selectedCatalog = event.payload.item.id;
    const selectedCatalogLabel = event.payload.item.label;
    if (selectedCatalog == "allCatalog") {
        var categoryList = [];
        var defaultList = api.state.catalogList[0].children;
        var alphaList = api.state.catalogList[1].children;
        for (let item of defaultList) {
            if (item.id == "allCatalog")
                continue;
            categoryList.push({
                id: item.id,
                label: item.label
            });
        }
        for (let item of alphaList) {
            categoryList.push({
                id: item.id,
                label: item.label
            });
        }
        categoryList.sort((a, b) => a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
        api.setState("selectedCatalogHierarchy", categoryList);
    } else
        api.setState('selectedCatalogHierarchy', null);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    api.setState("productSelectionSelected", [
        []
    ]);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState("resultsFound", true);
    api.setState("leafCategoryList", null);
    api.setState('pageIndex', 0);
    api.setState('selectedCatalog', selectedCatalog);
    api.setState('selectedCatalogLabel', selectedCatalogLabel);
    api.setState('selectedCategory', "showAll");
    api.setState('categorySelected', [
        ["showAll"]
    ]);
    api.setState("showSearch", true);
    let cdbInput = {
        selectedCatalog: selectedCatalog,
        selectedCategory: "showAll",
        pageIndex: 0,
        count: 0,
        searchTerm: api.state.searchTerm,
        transactionInput: api.state.requestEntityDetails.transactionInput,
        suppressPricing: api.state.requestEntityDetails.suppressPricing,
        catalogType: "PRODUCT_OFFERING",
        inputEntityDetails: api.state.requestEntityDetails.inputEntityDetails,
        contextFilterChanges: api.state.contextFilterChanges,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy
    };
    let requestEntityDetails = api.state.requestEntityDetails;
    requestEntityDetails.catalogType = "PRODUCT_OFFERING";
    api.setState("requestEntityDetails", requestEntityDetails);
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    var action = api.data.order_review.orderAction;
    var selectedAction = event.payload.item.id;
    if (action == selectedAction || action.indexOf(selectedAction) > -1 || action == 'change' || action.indexOf('change') > -1) {
        api.emit('MACROPONENT_VIEWPORT_LOAD_REQUESTED', {
            viewportElementId: "viewport_1",
            route: "suspend-resume-disconnect-interceptor",
            fields: {
                "prdInvtId": api.context.props.sysId,
                "orderId": api.context.props.orderId,
                "action": event.payload.item.id,
                "invtState": api.data.order_review.invtState,
                "invtNumber": api.data.order_review.invtNumber,
                "invtName": api.data.order_review.invtName
            },
        });

        helpers.modal.open('modal_viewport_interceptor', {
            size: 'md',
            bare: true
        });
    } else {
        var message = `Can't create new line items when the order action is set at Disconnect, Resume, or Suspend.`;
        api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
            items: [{
                id: 'info',
                status: 'info',
                icon: 'circle-info-outline',
                content: message,
                action: {
                    type: 'dismiss'
                }
            }]
        });
        helpers.timing.setTimeout(() => {
            api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#CLEAR_NOTIFICATIONS');

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const product = api.item.value.attributes.product;
    if (product.instances) {
        return product.checked ? product.totalQuantity : 0;
    }
    let qty = product.attributes.selectedQuantity;
    const isChecked = product.checked;
    if (!qty) {
        const productQty = product.attributes.quantity.value || 1;
        product.attributes.selectedQuantity = {
            value: isChecked ? productQty : 0
        };
        qty = product.attributes.selectedQuantity;
    }
    return isChecked ? qty.value : 0;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>e67c1f74e9270b944699741a8f7d749e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>input_50/value</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_e67c1f74e9270b944699741a8f7d749e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:46</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

    helpers
}) {
    const obj = api.item.value;
    const errorMessage = obj.attributes.error_message;
    if (errorMessage && errorMessage.content) {
        let data = [{
            "icon": "circle-info-outline",
            "content": obj.attributes.error_message.content
        }];
        return data;
    }
    const infoMessage = obj.attributes.message;
    if (infoMessage && infoMessage.content) {
        let data = [{
            "icon": "circle-info-outline",
            "content": obj.attributes.message.content
        }];
        return data;
    }
    return []; 
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:51:05</sys_created_on><sys_id>cb8c5f7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8d20</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>decimal_char_input/messages</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_cb8c5f7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8d20</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:51:05</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
