                                                            "controllerElementId": null,
                                                            "inlineScript": "/**\n * @param {params} params\n * @param {api} params.api\n * @param {any} params.event\n */\nfunction evaluateEvent({\n api,\n event\n}) {\n return {\n propName: \"sideTabIndex\",\n value: getRequestTrackerIndex()\n };\n\n function getRequestTrackerIndex() {\n if (showRequestTracker()) {\n var tabs = event.payload.tabs;\n for (var index = 0; index < tabs.length; index++) {\n if (tabs[index].id == \"request-tracker\") return index;\n }\n }\n return api.state.sideTabIndex;\n }\n\n function showRequestTracker() {\n var extraParams = api.context.props.extraParams;\n if (extraParams != null) {\n var params = extraParams.split(',');\n return 'showMessage'.localeCompare(params[0]) == 0 ||\n 'showRequestTracker'.localeCompare(params[0]) == 0;\n }\n return false;\n }\n}",

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product catalog view default">497c1774e9270b944699741a8f7d74ef</macroponent><name>Set search placeholder</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "Search product display name, code or description"
    },
    {
        "message": "Search inventory name"
    },
    {
        "message": "Search service display name, code or description"
    },
    {
        "message": "Search needs name or description"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    let data = api.data.transactioncatalogdatabroker.output;
    if (data) {
        if (data.catalogType == "PRODUCT_OFFERING"){
            helpers.translate("Search product display name, code or description")
                .then((translatedText) => {
                    api.setState("searchPlaceholder", translatedText);
            });
        } else if (data.catalogType == "PRODUCT_INVENTORY"){
            helpers.translate("Search inventory name")
                .then((translatedText) => {
                    api.setState("searchPlaceholder", translatedText);
            });
        } else if (data.catalogType == "SERVICE_SPECIFICATION") {
            helpers.translate("Search service display name, code or description")
                .then((translatedText) => {
                    api.setState("searchPlaceholder", translatedText);
            });
        } else if (data.catalogType == "NEEDS") {
            helpers.translate("Search needs name or description")
                .then((translatedText) => {
                    api.setState("searchPlaceholder", translatedText);
            });
        }
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>117c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d74b7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set search placeholder</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_117c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d74b7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Order Line Char Config default">317c1b74e9270b944699741a8f7d7437</macroponent><name>input_50/readonly</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        if (!api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.is_editable)
            return true;
        if (api.context.props.entityDetails['settings'] && api.context.props.entityDetails.settings['selectAllProductOptions'] || api.item.value.attributes.product.instances)
            return true;
        var data = api.item.value.attributes;
        return (data.min_quantity.value == data.max_quantity.value) || !data.product.checked;
    }
    return false;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>1a7cdb74e9270b944699741a8f7d7452</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>input_50/readonly</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_1a7cdb74e9270b944699741a8f7d7452</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:46</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product Config Default">3d8c5b7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8dd5</macroponent><name>input_50/value</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const product = api.item.value.attributes.product;
    if (product.instances) {
        return product.checked ? product.totalQuantity : 0;
    }
    let qty = product.attributes.selectedQuantity;
    const isChecked = product.checked;
    if (!qty) {
        const productQty = product.attributes.quantity.value || 1;
        product.attributes.selectedQuantity = {
            value: isChecked ? productQty : 0
        };
        qty = product.attributes.selectedQuantity;
    }
    return isChecked ? qty.value : 0;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:51:03</sys_created_on><sys_id>268cdb7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8d8f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>input_50/value</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_268cdb7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8d8f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:51:03</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    let configInstance = api.state.configInstance;
    let tempConfigInstance = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(configInstance));
    let refreshId = parseInt(Math.ceil(Math.random() * Date.now()).toPrecision(16).toString().replace(".", ""));
    let escalationRefreshQueue = api.state.escalationRefreshQueue;
    escalationRefreshQueue.push(refreshId);
    api.setState('escalationRefreshQueue', escalationRefreshQueue);
    helpers.timing.setTimeout(() => {
        if (api.state.escalationRefreshQueue.length === 1) // Process only last request in queue
            api.emit('SN_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION#SEND_CONFIG_INSTANCE', {
                configInstance: tempConfigInstance
            });
        const index = escalationRefreshQueue.indexOf(refreshId);
        if (index > -1)
            escalationRefreshQueue.splice(index, 1); // Remove from queue
        api.setState('escalationRefreshQueue', escalationRefreshQueue);
    }, 1000);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>1e7c1f74e9270b944699741a8f7d7468</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ConfigureProduct</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_1e7c1f74e9270b944699741a8f7d7468</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:46</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

}) {
    const isProductSelected = api.item.value.attributes.product.checked;
    if (!isProductSelected)
        return false;
    if (api.item.value.attributes.product.instances)
        return false;
    const minQty = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.min_quantity.value);
    const maxQty = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.max_quantity.value);
    const qtyValue = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.value);
    const errorCondition = qtyValue < minQty || qtyValue > maxQty;
    const invalidCondition = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.invalid && api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.invalid.value;
    let data = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.message;
    let dataContent = data && data.content;
    return dataContent || (invalidCondition || errorCondition);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>027c9b74e9270b944699741a8f7d7430</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>label_value_38/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_027c9b74e9270b944699741a8f7d7430</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:45</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

    const minQty = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.min_quantity.value);
    const maxQty = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.max_quantity.value);
    const qtyValue = parseInt(api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.value);
    const errorCondition = qtyValue < minQty || qtyValue > maxQty;
    const invalidCondition = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.invalid && api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.invalid.value;
    let data = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.message;
    let dataContent = data && data.content;
    return !dataContent || (invalidCondition || errorCondition);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>167c1f74e9270b944699741a8f7d748d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>label_value_46/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_167c1f74e9270b944699741a8f7d748d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:46</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product catalog view default">497c1774e9270b944699741a8f7d74ef</macroponent><name>Set fresh catalog data</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    let data = api.data.transactioncatalogdatabroker.output;
    api.setState('requestEntityDetails', data);
    if (api.context.props.entityDetails.recommendation) {
        api.setState('showSearch', false);
        return;
    }
    api.setState('showSearch', true);
    api.setState("loadingItems", true);
    api.setState('selectedCategory', 'showAll');
    api.setState('categorySelected', [["showAll"]]);
    api.setState("totalCount", 0);
    api.setState('enableAISearchInCatalog', data.enableAISearchInCatalog);
    api.setState('catalogType', data.catalogType);
    api.setState('isTransactionManagerActive', data.isTransactionManagerActive);
    if(data.sortOptionsList){
        api.setState('sortOptionsList', data.sortOptionsList);
    }
    let cdbInput = {
        count: 0,
        pageIndex: 0,
        searchTerm: api.state.searchTerm,
        selectedCategory: "showAll",
        selectedCatalog: null,
        contextFilterChanges: api.state.contextFilterChanges,
        transactionInput: data.transactionInput,
        transactionType: data.transactionType,
        account: data.account,
        catalogType: data.catalogType,
        suppressPricing: data.suppressPricing,
        inputEntityDetails: data.inputEntityDetails,
        clearCatalogCache: true,
        sortOrder: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortOrder,
        sortBy: api.state.pageFilters.sort.sortBy,
        enableAdvanceConfiguration: data.enableAdvanceConfiguration
    };
    api.data.catalogdatabroker.execute({
        cdbInput: cdbInput
    });
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>517c5774e9270b944699741a8f7d7472</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set fresh catalog data</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_517c5774e9270b944699741a8f7d7472</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:41</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

  * @param {params} params
  * @param {api} params.api
  * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
  */
function evaluateProperty({api, helpers}) {
	  var prodChecked = Boolean(api.item.attributes.product.checked);
    if(!prodChecked) return true;
    var minQty = Number(api.item.value.attributes.min_quantity.value);
    var maxQty = Number(api.item.value.attributes.max_quantity.value);
    var qtyValue = Number(api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.value);
    var errorCondition = qtyValue < minQty || qtyValue > maxQty;
    let data = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.message;
    let dataContent = data && data.content;
   return !(errorCondition || dataContent);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:51:02</sys_created_on><sys_id>528c9b7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8df5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>stylized_text_13/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_528c9b7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8df5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:51:02</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Product catalog view default">497c1774e9270b944699741a8f7d74ef</macroponent><name>Update heading</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "All products"
    },
    {
        "message": "Products for \"Show all\""
    },
    {
        "message": "Product selection guide"
    },
    {
        "message": "Products for \"{0}\""
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    // if (event.payload.item && event.payload.item.id != '') {
    //     if (event.payload.item.id == api.state.selectedCatalog || event.payload.item.id == api.state.selectedCategory)
    //         return;
    // }
    const elementId = event.elementId;
    const itemId = event.payload.item && event.payload.item.id != '' ? event.payload.item.id : '';
    const selectedCatalog = api.state.selectedCatalog;
    const isRecommendationCategory = event.payload.value ? event.payload.value.recommendation : false;
    if (elementId == "catalog_dropdown" && itemId == "allCatalog") {
        helpers.translate("All products")
            .then((translatedText) => {
                api.setState("productHeading", translatedText);
            });
    } else if (elementId == "category_hierarchy" && selectedCatalog == "allCatalog") {
        helpers.translate('Products for "Show all"')
            .then((translatedText) => {
                api.setState("productHeading", translatedText);
            });
    } else if (elementId == "catalog_dropdown" && itemId != "allCatalog") {
        helpers.translate('Products for "Show all"')
            .then((translatedText) => {
                api.setState("productHeading", translatedText);
            });
    } else if (elementId == "product_selection_guide_tree" || isRecommendationCategory) {
        helpers.translate('Product selection guide')
            .then((translatedText) => {
                api.setState("productHeading", translatedText);
            });
    } else {
        const selectedCategory = event.payload.item.label;
        helpers.translate('Products for "{0}"', selectedCategory)
            .then((translatedText) => {
                api.setState("productHeading", translatedText);
            });
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>9d7c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d7428</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update heading</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_9d7c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d7428</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

    let data = api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.quantity.message;
    let dataContent = data && data.content;
    return !dataContent || (invalidCondition || errorCondition);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:51:05</sys_created_on><sys_id>cf8c5f7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8d12</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>label_value_46/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_cf8c5f7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8d12</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:51:05</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        var selectedRelationshipGroup = api.item.parent.value;
        var currentRelatedProducts = selectedRelationshipGroup.related_product;
        let checkedCount = 0;
        if (api.item.value.attributes.is_mandatory.value == "1" || !selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.is_editable) {
            return true;
        };
        for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
            if (currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked) checkedCount++;
            currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = false;
        }
        if (checkedCount >= +selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.max.value) {
            for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
                if (!currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked)
                    currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = true;
            }
        }else if (checkedCount <= +selectedRelationshipGroup.attributes.min.value ) {
            for (let i = 0; i < currentRelatedProducts.length; i++) {
                if (currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.product.checked)
                    currentRelatedProducts[i].attributes.is_disabled = true;
            }
        }
        if (api.item.value.attributes.is_disabled)
            return true;
        return !api.item.value.attributes.product.attributes.is_editable;
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:51:02</sys_created_on><sys_id>da8c9b7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8dc0</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>related_product_checkbox/readonly</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_da8c9b7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8dc0</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:51:02</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

    {
        "message": "Total monthly price"

    {
        "message": "Total annual price"

]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
  * @param {params} params
  * @param {api} params.api

  */
function evaluateProperty({api, helpers}) {
   if(api.item.value.total_price_label){
    if(api.item.value.total_price_label.indexOf("one-time") > -1){
      return helpers.translateSync("Total one-time price");
    } else if(api.item.value.total_price_label.indexOf("monthly") > -1){
      return helpers.translateSync("Total monthly price");
    } else {
      return helpers.translateSync("Total annual price");
    }
  }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:51:04</sys_created_on><sys_id>b28c1f7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8d6d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>label_value_21/label</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_b28c1f7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8d6d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:51:04</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        if (!api.item.value.is_editable) return true;
        var currentCharacteristic = api.item.parent.value;
        if (currentCharacteristic.attributes.is_mandatory && currentCharacteristic.attributes.is_mandatory.value == '1') {
            var currentCharacteristicOptions = currentCharacteristic.characteristic_options;
            const checkedCount = currentCharacteristicOptions.filter(item => item.checked).length;
            if (checkedCount == 1 && api.item.value.checked)
                return true;
        }

    helpers
}) {
    if (api.item.value) {
        let msg;
        if (api.item.value.attributes.name.value == "Bundled Products" || api.item.value.attributes.name.value == "Optional Products") {
            msg = "";
        } else {
            const min = api.item.value.attributes.min.value;
            const max = api.item.value.attributes.max.value;
            if (min == 0)
                msg = helpers.translateSync('Select a maximum of {0} options', [max]);
            else if (api.context.props.entityDetails['settings'] && api.context.props.entityDetails.settings['selectAllProductOptions'])
                msg = helpers.translateSync('Select a minimum of {0} options', [min]);
            else
                msg = helpers.translateSync('Select a minimum of {0} options and a maximum of {1} options', [min, max]);
        }
        return msg;
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:51:03</sys_created_on><sys_id>1a8cdb7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8d78</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>rel_grp_info_msg/text</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_1a8cdb7ce1af43d41f189be3489f8d78</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:51:03</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    var attributeAdjustments = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(api.state.attributeAdjustments));
    if (attributeAdjustments) {
        for (let i = 0; i < attributeAdjustments.length; i++) {
            attributeAdjustments[i].selected_products = attributeAdjustments[i].selected_products.filter((product) => product.adjustment_applied != null);
            attributeAdjustments[i].selected_chars = attributeAdjustments[i].selected_chars.filter((char) => char.adjustment_applied != null);
        }
    }
    attributeAdjustments = attributeAdjustments.filter((adjustmentsObj) => (adjustmentsObj.selected_products.length > 0 || adjustmentsObj.selected_chars.length > 0));
    return attributeAdjustments.length == 0;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:57</sys_created_on><sys_id>058cdb701163cf94b0e48eebb0942157</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>container_46/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_058cdb701163cf94b0e48eebb0942157</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:57</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

    {
        "message": "All products"
    },
    {
        "message": "Products for \"Show all\""
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    const data = event.payload.data.output;
    if (data.selectedCatalog === "allCatalog") {
        helpers.translate('All products')
            .then((translatedText) => {
                api.setState("productHeading", translatedText);
            });
    } else {
        if(api.state.selectedCategory === "showAll") {
                    helpers.translate('Products for "Show all"')
            .then((translatedText) => {
                api.setState("productHeading", translatedText);
            });
        }
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>197c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d7480</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update Heading For Eligibility</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_197c9774e9270b944699741a8f7d7480</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:42</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Default">677c13b4e9270b944699741a8f7d742e</macroponent><name>ConfigRuleAction</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    let commitInstance, entityDetails;
    let input = {
        action: '',
        lineId: '',
        lineTableName: '',
        ruleSessionId: '',
        configId: ''
    };
    let configInstance = api.state.configData.configInstance;
    commitInstance = api.data.productconfigurationdatabroker.output;
    entityDetails = api.context.props.entityDetails;
        if(typeof entityDetails == 'string')
        entityDetails = JSON.parse(entityDetails);
    input.ruleSessionId = configInstance.ruleSessionId;
    if (event.name == 'SN_PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION#RECEIVE_CANCEL') {
        input.action = 'ABORT';
        input.lineId = entityDetails ? entityDetails.lineId : '';
    } else if (event.elementId == 'productconfigurationdatabroker' &&
        event.name == 'DATA_FETCH_SUCCEEDED' &&
        commitInstance && Object.keys(commitInstance).length > 0) {
        input.action = 'COMMIT';
        input.lineId = commitInstance.rootLineIDs[0];
        input.configId = entityDetails && entityDetails.metadata ? entityDetails.metadata.sourceToTargetEntityId : '';
    }
    api.data.ruleActionDataBroker.execute(input);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 12:50:51</sys_created_on><sys_id>337c13b4e9270b944699741a8f7d7461</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ConfigRuleAction</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management" source="sn_app_orm_wksp">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configurable Workspace for Order Management">3885b51e5b2830102dff5e92dc81c7f1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_337c13b4e9270b944699741a8f7d7461</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 12:50:51</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
